translations.kjv: The beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God;
translations.ylt: A beginning of the good news of Jesus Christ, Son of God.
translations.web: The beginning of the Good News of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.

translations.kjv: As it is written in the prophets, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.
translations.ylt: As it hath been written in the prophets, `Lo, I send My messenger before thy face, who shall prepare thy way before thee,' --
translations.web: As it is written in the prophets, “Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you:

translations.kjv: The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.
translations.ylt: `A voice of one calling in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, straight make ye his paths,' --
translations.web: the voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make ready the way of the Lord! Make his paths straight!’”

translations.kjv: John did baptize in the wilderness, and preach the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins.
translations.ylt: John came baptizing in the wilderness, and proclaiming a baptism of reformation--to remission of sins,
translations.web: John came baptizing in the wilderness and preaching the baptism of repentance for forgiveness of sins.

translations.kjv: And there went out unto him all the land of Judea, and they of Jerusalem, and were all baptized of him in the river of Jordan, confessing their sins.
translations.ylt: and there were going forth to him all the region of Judea, and they of Jerusalem, and they were all baptized by him in the river Jordan, confessing their sins.
translations.web: All the country of Judea and all those of Jerusalem went out to him. They were baptized by him in the Jordan river, confessing their sins.

translations.kjv: And John was clothed with camel’s hair, and with a girdle of a skin about his loins; and he did eat locusts and wild honey;
translations.ylt: And John was clothed with camel's hair, and a girdle of skin around his loins, and eating locusts and honey of the field,
translations.web: John was clothed with camel’s hair and a leather belt around his waist. He ate locusts and wild honey.

translations.kjv: And preached, saying, There cometh one mightier than I after me, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to stoop down and unloose.
translations.ylt: and he proclaimed, saying, `He doth come--who is mightier than I--after me, of whom I am not worthy--having stooped down--to loose the latchet of his sandals;
translations.web: He preached, saying, “After me comes he who is mightier than I, the strap of whose sandals I am not worthy to stoop down and loosen.

translations.kjv: I indeed have baptized you with water: but he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost.
translations.ylt: I indeed did baptize you with water, but he shall baptize you with the Holy Spirit.'
translations.web: I baptized you in water, but he will baptize you in the Holy Spirit.”

translations.kjv: And it came to pass in those days, that Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized of John in Jordan.
translations.ylt: And it came to pass in those days, Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized by John at the Jordan;
translations.web: In those days, Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized by John in the Jordan.

translations.kjv: And straightway coming up out of the water, he saw the heavens opened, and the Spirit like a dove descending upon him:
translations.ylt: and immediately coming up from the water, he saw the heavens dividing, and the Spirit as a dove coming down upon him;
translations.web: Immediately coming up from the water, he saw the heavens parting and the Spirit descending on him like a dove.

translations.kjv: And there came a voice from heaven, saying, Thou art my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
translations.ylt: and a voice came out of the heavens, `Thou art My Son--the Beloved, in whom I did delight.'
translations.web: A voice came out of the sky, “You are my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.”

translations.kjv: And immediately the Spirit driveth him into the wilderness.
translations.ylt: And immediately doth the Spirit put him forth to the wilderness,
translations.web: Immediately the Spirit drove him out into the wilderness.

translations.kjv: And he was there in the wilderness forty days, tempted of Satan; and was with the wild beasts; and the angels ministered unto him.
translations.ylt: and he was there in the wilderness forty days, being tempted by the Adversary, and he was with the beasts, and the messengers were ministering to him.
translations.web: He was there in the wilderness forty days, tempted by Satan. He was with the wild animals; and the angels were serving him.

translations.kjv: Now after that John was put in prison, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the gospel of the kingdom of God,
translations.ylt: And after the delivering up of John, Jesus came to Galilee, proclaiming the good news of the reign of God,
translations.web: Now after John was taken into custody, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the Good News of God’s Kingdom,

translations.kjv: And saying, The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God is at hand: repent ye, and believe the gospel.
translations.ylt: and saying--`Fulfilled hath been the time, and the reign of God hath come nigh, reform ye, and believe in the good news.'
translations.web: and saying, “The time is fulfilled, and God’s Kingdom is at hand! Repent, and believe in the Good News.”

translations.kjv: Now as he walked by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew his brother casting a net into the sea: for they were fishers.
translations.ylt: And, walking by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon, and Andrew his brother, casting a drag into the sea, for they were fishers,
translations.web: Passing along by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew, the brother of Simon, casting a net into the sea, for they were fishermen.

translations.kjv: And Jesus said unto them, Come ye after me, and I will make you to become fishers of men.
translations.ylt: and Jesus said to them, `Come ye after me, and I shall make you to become fishers of men;'
translations.web: Jesus said to them, “Come after me, and I will make you into fishers for men.”

translations.kjv: And straightway they forsook their nets, and followed him.
translations.ylt: and immediately, having left their nets, they followed him.
translations.web: Immediately they left their nets, and followed him.

translations.kjv: And when he had gone a little further thence, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, who also were in the ship mending their nets.
translations.ylt: And having gone on thence a little, he saw James of Zebedee, and John his brother, and they were in the boat refitting the nets,
translations.web: Going on a little further from there, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, who were also in the boat mending the nets.

translations.kjv: And straightway he called them: and they left their father Zebedee in the ship with the hired servants, and went after him.
translations.ylt: and immediately he called them, and, having left their father Zebedee in the boat with the hired servants, they went away after him.
translations.web: Immediately he called them, and they left their father, Zebedee, in the boat with the hired servants, and went after him.

translations.kjv: And they went into Capernaum; and straightway on the sabbath day he entered into the synagogue, and taught.
translations.ylt: And they go on to Capernaum, and immediately, on the sabbaths, having gone into the synagogue, he was teaching,
translations.web: They went into Capernaum, and immediately on the Sabbath day he entered into the synagogue and taught.

translations.kjv: And they were astonished at his doctrine: for he taught them as one that had authority, and not as the scribes.
translations.ylt: and they were astonished at his teaching, for he was teaching them as having authority, and not as the scribes.
translations.web: They were astonished at his teaching, for he taught them as having authority, and not as the scribes.

translations.kjv: And there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit; and he cried out,
translations.ylt: And there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit, and he cried out,
translations.web: Immediately there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit, and he cried out,

translations.kjv: Saying, Let us alone; what have we to do with thee, thou Jesus of Nazareth? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art, the Holy One of God.
translations.ylt: saying, `Away! what--to us and to thee, Jesus the Nazarene? thou didst come to destroy us; I have known thee who thou art--the Holy One of God.'
translations.web: saying, “Ha! What do we have to do with you, Jesus, you Nazarene? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are: the Holy One of God!”

translations.kjv: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Hold thy peace, and come out of him.
translations.ylt: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, `Be silenced, and come forth out of him,'
translations.web: Jesus rebuked him, saying, “Be quiet, and come out of him!”

translations.kjv: And when the unclean spirit had torn him, and cried with a loud voice, he came out of him.
translations.ylt: and the unclean spirit having torn him, and having cried with a great voice, came forth out of him,
translations.web: The unclean spirit, convulsing him and crying with a loud voice, came out of him.

translations.kjv: And they were all amazed, insomuch that they questioned among themselves, saying, What thing is this? what new doctrine is this? for with authority commandeth he even the unclean spirits, and they do obey him.
translations.ylt: and they were all amazed, so as to reason among themselves, saying, `What is this? what new teaching is this? that with authority also the unclean spirits he commandeth, and they obey him!'
translations.web: They were all amazed, so that they questioned among themselves, saying, “What is this? What can this new doctrine be? For with authority he commands even the unclean spirits, and they obey him!”

translations.kjv: And immediately his fame spread abroad throughout all the region round about Galilee.
translations.ylt: And the fame of him went forth immediately to all the region, round about, of Galilee.
translations.web: The report of him went out immediately into all the region of Galilee and its surrounding area.

translations.kjv: And forthwith, when they were come out of the synagogue, they entered into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.
translations.ylt: And immediately, having come forth out of the synagogue, they went to the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John,
translations.web: Immediately, when they had come out of the synagogue, they came into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.

translations.kjv: But Simon’s wife’s mother lay sick of a fever, and anon they tell him of her.
translations.ylt: and the mother-in-law of Simon was lying fevered, and immediately they tell him about her,
translations.web: Now Simon’s wife’s mother lay sick with a fever, and immediately they told him about her.

translations.kjv: And he came and took her by the hand, and lifted her up; and immediately the fever left her, and she ministered unto them.
translations.ylt: and having come near, he raised her up, having laid hold of her hand, and the fever left her immediately, and she was ministering to them.
translations.web: He came and took her by the hand and raised her up. The fever left her immediately, and she served them.

translations.kjv: And at even, when the sun did set, they brought unto him all that were diseased, and them that were possessed with devils.
translations.ylt: And evening having come, when the sun did set, they brought unto him all who were ill, and who were demoniacs,
translations.web: At evening, when the sun had set, they brought to him all who were sick and those who were possessed by demons.

translations.kjv: And all the city was gathered together at the door.
translations.ylt: and the whole city was gathered together near the door,
translations.web: All the city was gathered together at the door.

translations.kjv: And he healed many that were sick of divers diseases, and cast out many devils; and suffered not the devils to speak, because they knew him.
translations.ylt: and he healed many who were ill of manifold diseases, and many demons he cast forth, and was not suffering the demons to speak, because they knew him.
translations.web: He healed many who were sick with various diseases and cast out many demons. He didn’t allow the demons to speak, because they knew him.

translations.kjv: And in the morning, rising up a great while before day, he went out, and departed into a solitary place, and there prayed.
translations.ylt: And very early, it being yet night, having risen, he went forth, and went away to a desert place, and was there praying;
translations.web: Early in the morning, while it was still dark, he rose up and went out, and departed into a deserted place, and prayed there.

translations.kjv: And Simon and they that were with him followed after him.
translations.ylt: and Simon and those with him went in quest of him,
translations.web: Simon and those who were with him searched for him.

translations.kjv: And when they had found him, they said unto him, All men seek for thee.
translations.ylt: and having found him, they say to him, --`All do seek thee;'
translations.web: They found him and told him, “Everyone is looking for you.”

translations.kjv: And he said unto them, Let us go into the next towns, that I may preach there also: for therefore came I forth.
translations.ylt: and he saith to them, `We may go to the next towns, that there also I may preach, for for this I came forth.'
translations.web: He said to them, “Let’s go elsewhere into the next towns, that I may preach there also, because I came out for this reason.”

translations.kjv: And he preached in their synagogues throughout all Galilee, and cast out devils.
translations.ylt: And he was preaching in their synagogues, in all Galilee, and is casting out the demons,
translations.web: He went into their synagogues throughout all Galilee, preaching and casting out demons.

translations.kjv: And there came a leper to him, beseeching him, and kneeling down to him, and saying unto him, If thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
translations.ylt: and there doth come to him a leper, calling on him, and kneeling to him, and saying to him--`If thou mayest will, thou art able to cleanse me.'
translations.web: A leper came to him, begging him, kneeling down to him, and saying to him, “If you want to, you can make me clean.”

translations.kjv: And Jesus, moved with compassion, put forth his hand, and touched him, and saith unto him, I will; be thou clean.
translations.ylt: And Jesus having been moved with compassion, having stretched forth the hand, touched him, and saith to him, `I will; be thou cleansed;'
translations.web: Being moved with compassion, he stretched out his hand, and touched him, and said to him, “I want to. Be made clean.”

translations.kjv: And as soon as he had spoken, immediately the leprosy departed from him, and he was cleansed.
translations.ylt: and he having spoken, immediately the leprosy went away from him, and he was cleansed.
translations.web: When he had said this, immediately the leprosy departed from him and he was made clean.

translations.kjv: And he straitly charged him, and forthwith sent him away;
translations.ylt: And having sternly charged him, immediately he put him forth,
translations.web: He strictly warned him and immediately sent him out,

translations.kjv: And saith unto him, See thou say nothing to any man: but go thy way, shew thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing those things which Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.
translations.ylt: and saith to him, `See thou mayest say nothing to any one, but go away, thyself shew to the priest, and bring near for thy cleansing the things Moses directed, for a testimony to them.'
translations.web: and said to him, “See that you say nothing to anybody, but go show yourself to the priest and offer for your cleansing the things which Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.”

translations.kjv: But he went out, and began to publish it much, and to blaze abroad the matter, insomuch that Jesus could no more openly enter into the city, but was without in desert places: and they came to him from every quarter.
translations.ylt: And he, having gone forth, began to proclaim much, and to spread abroad the thing, so that no more he was able openly to enter into the city, but he was without in desert places, and they were coming unto him from every quarter.
translations.web: But he went out, and began to proclaim it much, and to spread about the matter, so that Jesus could no more openly enter into a city, but was outside in desert places. People came to him from everywhere.

translations.kjv: And again he entered into Capernaum after some days; and it was noised that he was in the house.
translations.ylt: And again he entered into Capernaum, after some days, and it was heard that he is in the house,
translations.web: When he entered again into Capernaum after some days, it was heard that he was at home.

translations.kjv: And straightway many were gathered together, insomuch that there was no room to receive them, no, not so much as about the door: and he preached the word unto them.
translations.ylt: and immediately many were gathered together, so that there was no more room, not even at the door, and he was speaking to them the word.
translations.web: Immediately many were gathered together, so that there was no more room, not even around the door; and he spoke the word to them.

translations.kjv: And they come unto him, bringing one sick of the palsy, which was borne of four.
translations.ylt: And they come unto him, bringing a paralytic, borne by four,
translations.web: Four people came, carrying a paralytic to him.

translations.kjv: And when they could not come nigh unto him for the press, they uncovered the roof where he was: and when they had broken it up, they let down the bed wherein the sick of the palsy lay.
translations.ylt: and not being able to come near to him because of the multitude, they uncovered the roof where he was, and, having broken it up, they let down the couch on which the paralytic was lying,
translations.web: When they could not come near to him for the crowd, they removed the roof where he was. When they had broken it up, they let down the mat that the paralytic was lying on.

translations.kjv: When Jesus saw their faith, he said unto the sick of the palsy, Son, thy sins be forgiven thee.
translations.ylt: and Jesus having seen their faith, saith to the paralytic, `Child, thy sins have been forgiven thee.'
translations.web: Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, “Son, your sins are forgiven you.”

translations.kjv: But there were certain of the scribes sitting there, and reasoning in their hearts,
translations.ylt: And there were certain of the scribes there sitting, and reasoning in their hearts,
translations.web: But there were some of the scribes sitting there and reasoning in their hearts,

translations.kjv: Why doth this man thus speak blasphemies? who can forgive sins but God only?
translations.ylt: `Why doth this one thus speak evil words? who is able to forgive sins except one--God?'
translations.web: “Why does this man speak blasphemies like that? Who can forgive sins but God alone?”

translations.kjv: And immediately when Jesus perceived in his spirit that they so reasoned within themselves, he said unto them, Why reason ye these things in your hearts?
translations.ylt: And immediately Jesus, having known in his spirit that they thus reason in themselves, said to them, `Why these things reason ye in your hearts?
translations.web: Immediately Jesus, perceiving in his spirit that they so reasoned within themselves, said to them, “Why do you reason these things in your hearts?

translations.kjv: Whether is it easier to say to the sick of the palsy, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Arise, and take up thy bed, and walk?
translations.ylt: which is easier, to say to the paralytic, The sins have been forgiven to thee? or to say, Rise, and take up thy couch, and walk?
translations.web: Which is easier, to tell the paralytic, ‘Your sins are forgiven;’ or to say, ‘Arise, and take up your bed, and walk’?

translations.kjv: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins, (he saith to the sick of the palsy,)
translations.ylt: `And, that ye may know that the Son of Man hath authority on the earth to forgive sins--(he saith to the paralytic) --
translations.web: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins”—he said to the paralytic—

translations.kjv: I say unto thee, Arise, and take up thy bed, and go thy way into thine house.
translations.ylt: I say to thee, Rise, and take up thy couch, and go away to thy house;'
translations.web: “I tell you, arise, take up your mat, and go to your house.”

translations.kjv: And immediately he arose, took up the bed, and went forth before them all; insomuch that they were all amazed, and glorified God, saying, We never saw it on this fashion.
translations.ylt: and he rose immediately, and having taken up the couch, he went forth before all, so that all were astonished, and do glorify God, saying--`Never thus did we see.'
translations.web: He arose, and immediately took up the mat and went out in front of them all, so that they were all amazed and glorified God, saying, “We never saw anything like this!”

translations.kjv: And he went forth again by the sea side; and all the multitude resorted unto him, and he taught them.
translations.ylt: And he went forth again by the sea, and all the multitude was coming unto him, and he was teaching them,
translations.web: He went out again by the seaside. All the multitude came to him, and he taught them.

translations.kjv: And as he passed by, he saw Levi the son of Alpheus sitting at the receipt of custom, and said unto him, Follow me. And he arose and followed him.
translations.ylt: and passing by, he saw Levi of Alpheus sitting at the tax-office, and saith to him, `Be following me,' and he, having risen, did follow him.
translations.web: As he passed by, he saw Levi the son of Alphaeus sitting at the tax office. He said to him, “Follow me.” And he arose and followed him.

translations.kjv: And it came to pass, that, as Jesus sat at meat in his house, many publicans and sinners sat also together with Jesus and his disciples: for there were many, and they followed him.
translations.ylt: And it came to pass, in his reclining (at meat) in his house, that many tax-gatherers and sinners were reclining (at meat) with Jesus and his disciples, for there were many, and they followed him.
translations.web: He was reclining at the table in his house, and many tax collectors and sinners sat down with Jesus and his disciples, for there were many, and they followed him.

translations.kjv: And when the scribes and Pharisees saw him eat with publicans and sinners, they said unto his disciples, How is it that he eateth and drinketh with publicans and sinners?
translations.ylt: And the scribes and the Pharisees, having seen him eating with the tax-gatherers and sinners, said to his disciples, `Why--that with the tax-gatherers and sinners he doth eat and drink?'
translations.web: The scribes and the Pharisees, when they saw that he was eating with the sinners and tax collectors, said to his disciples, “Why is it that he eats and drinks with tax collectors and sinners?”

translations.kjv: When Jesus heard it, he saith unto them, They that are whole have no need of the physician, but they that are sick: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
translations.ylt: And Jesus, having heard, saith to them, `They who are strong have no need of a physician, but they who are ill; I came not to call righteous men, but sinners to reformation.'
translations.web: When Jesus heard it, he said to them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick. I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.”

translations.kjv: And the disciples of John and of the Pharisees used to fast: and they come and say unto him, Why do the disciples of John and of the Pharisees fast, but thy disciples fast not?
translations.ylt: And the disciples of John and those of the Pharisees were fasting, and they come and say to him, `Wherefore do the disciples of John and those of the Pharisees fast, and thy disciples do not fast?'
translations.web: John’s disciples and the Pharisees were fasting, and they came and asked him, “Why do John’s disciples and the disciples of the Pharisees fast, but your disciples don’t fast?”

translations.kjv: And Jesus said unto them, Can the children of the bridechamber fast, while the bridegroom is with them? as long as they have the bridegroom with them, they cannot fast.
translations.ylt: And Jesus said to them, `Are the sons of the bride-chamber able, while the bridegroom is with them, to fast? so long time as they have the bridegroom with them they are not able to fast;
translations.web: Jesus said to them, “Can the groomsmen fast while the bridegroom is with them? As long as they have the bridegroom with them, they can’t fast.

translations.kjv: But the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then shall they fast in those days.
translations.ylt: but days shall come when the bridegroom may be taken from them, and then they shall fast--in those days.
translations.web: But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast in that day.

translations.kjv: No man also seweth a piece of new cloth on an old garment: else the new piece that filled it up taketh away from the old, and the rent is made worse.
translations.ylt: `And no one a patch of undressed cloth doth sew on an old garment, and if not--the new filling it up doth take from the old and the rent doth become worse;
translations.web: No one sews a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment, or else the patch shrinks and the new tears away from the old, and a worse hole is made.

translations.kjv: And no man putteth new wine into old bottles: else the new wine doth burst the bottles, and the wine is spilled, and the bottles will be marred: but new wine must be put into new bottles.
translations.ylt: and no one doth put new wine into old skins, and if not--the new wine doth burst the skins, and the wine is poured out, and the skins will be destroyed; but new wine into new skins is to be put.'
translations.web: No one puts new wine into old wineskins; or else the new wine will burst the skins, and the wine pours out, and the skins will be destroyed; but they put new wine into fresh wineskins.”

translations.kjv: And it came to pass, that he went through the corn fields on the sabbath day; and his disciples began, as they went, to pluck the ears of corn.
translations.ylt: And it came to pass--he is going along on the sabbaths through the corn-fields--and his disciples began to make a way, plucking the ears,
translations.web: He was going on the Sabbath day through the grain fields; and his disciples began, as they went, to pluck the ears of grain.

translations.kjv: And the Pharisees said unto him, Behold, why do they on the sabbath day that which is not lawful?
translations.ylt: and the Pharisees said to him, `Lo, why do they on the sabbaths that which is not lawful?'
translations.web: The Pharisees said to him, “Behold, why do they do that which is not lawful on the Sabbath day?”

translations.kjv: And he said unto them, Have ye never read what David did, when he had need, and was an hungred, he, and they that were with him?
translations.ylt: And he said to them, `Did ye never read what David did, when he had need and was hungry, he and those with him?
translations.web: He said to them, “Did you never read what David did when he had need and was hungry—he, and those who were with him?

translations.kjv: How he went into the house of God in the days of Abiathar the high priest, and did eat the shewbread, which is not lawful to eat but for the priests, and gave also to them which were with him?
translations.ylt: how he went into the house of God, (at `Abiathar the chief priest,') and the loaves of the presentation did eat, which it is not lawful to eat, except to the priests, and he gave also to those who were with him?'
translations.web: How he entered into God’s house at the time of Abiathar the high priest, and ate the show bread, which is not lawful to eat except for the priests, and gave also to those who were with him?”

translations.kjv: And he said unto them, The sabbath was made for man, and not man for the sabbath:
translations.ylt: And he said to them, `The sabbath for man was made, not man for the sabbath,
translations.web: He said to them, “The Sabbath was made for man, not man for the Sabbath.

translations.kjv: Therefore the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath.
translations.ylt: so that the son of man is lord also of the sabbath.'
translations.web: Therefore the Son of Man is lord even of the Sabbath.”

translations.kjv: And he entered again into the synagogue; and there was a man there which had a withered hand.
translations.ylt: And he entered again into the synagogue, and there was there a man having the hand withered,
translations.web: He entered again into the synagogue, and there was a man there whose hand was withered.

translations.kjv: And they watched him, whether he would heal him on the sabbath day; that they might accuse him.
translations.ylt: and they were watching him, whether on the sabbaths he will heal him, that they might accuse him.
translations.web: They watched him, whether he would heal him on the Sabbath day, that they might accuse him.

translations.kjv: And he saith unto the man which had the withered hand, Stand forth.
translations.ylt: And he saith to the man having the hand withered, `Rise up in the midst.'
translations.web: He said to the man whose hand was withered, “Stand up.”

translations.kjv: And he saith unto them, Is it lawful to do good on the sabbath days, or to do evil? to save life, or to kill? But they held their peace.
translations.ylt: And he saith to them, `Is it lawful on the sabbaths to do good, or to do evil? life to save, or to kill?' but they were silent.
translations.web: He said to them, “Is it lawful on the Sabbath day to do good or to do harm? To save a life or to kill?” But they were silent.

translations.kjv: And when he had looked round about on them with anger, being grieved for the hardness of their hearts, he saith unto the man, Stretch forth thine hand. And he stretched it out: and his hand was restored whole as the other.
translations.ylt: And having looked round upon them with anger, being grieved for the hardness of their heart, he saith to the man, `Stretch forth thy hand;' and he stretched forth, and his hand was restored whole as the other;
translations.web: When he had looked around at them with anger, being grieved at the hardening of their hearts, he said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He stretched it out, and his hand was restored as healthy as the other.

translations.kjv: And the Pharisees went forth, and straightway took counsel with the Herodians against him, how they might destroy him.
translations.ylt: and the Pharisees having gone forth, immediately, with the Herodians, were taking counsel against him how they might destroy him.
translations.web: The Pharisees went out, and immediately conspired with the Herodians against him, how they might destroy him.

translations.kjv: But Jesus withdrew himself with his disciples to the sea: and a great multitude from Galilee followed him, and from Judea,
translations.ylt: And Jesus withdrew with his disciples unto the sea, and a great multitude from Galilee followed him, and from Judea,
translations.web: Jesus withdrew to the sea with his disciples; and a great multitude followed him from Galilee, from Judea,

translations.kjv: And from Jerusalem, and from Idumea, and from beyond Jordan; and they about Tyre and Sidon, a great multitude, when they had heard what great things he did, came unto him.
translations.ylt: and from Jerusalem, and from Idumea and beyond the Jordan; and they about Tyre and Sidon--a great multitude--having heard how great things he was doing, came unto him.
translations.web: from Jerusalem, from Idumaea, beyond the Jordan, and those from around Tyre and Sidon. A great multitude, hearing what great things he did, came to him.

translations.kjv: And he spake to his disciples, that a small ship should wait on him because of the multitude, lest they should throng him.
translations.ylt: And he said to his disciples that a little boat may wait on him, because of the multitude, that they may not press upon him,
translations.web: He spoke to his disciples that a little boat should stay near him because of the crowd, so that they wouldn’t press on him.

translations.kjv: For he had healed many; insomuch that they pressed upon him for to touch him, as many as had plagues.
translations.ylt: for he did heal many, so that they threw themselves on him, in order to touch him--as many as had plagues;
translations.web: For he had healed many, so that as many as had diseases pressed on him that they might touch him.

translations.kjv: And unclean spirits, when they saw him, fell down before him, and cried, saying, Thou art the Son of God.
translations.ylt: and the unclean spirits, when they were seeing him, were falling down before him, and were crying, saying--`Thou art the Son of God;'
translations.web: The unclean spirits, whenever they saw him, fell down before him and cried, “You are the Son of God!”

translations.kjv: And he straitly charged them that they should not make him known.
translations.ylt: and many times he was charging them that they might not make him manifest.
translations.web: He sternly warned them that they should not make him known.

translations.kjv: And he goeth up into a mountain, and calleth unto him whom he would: and they came unto him.
translations.ylt: And he goeth up to the mountain, and doth call near whom he willed, and they went away to him;
translations.web: He went up into the mountain and called to himself those whom he wanted, and they went to him.

translations.kjv: And he ordained twelve, that they should be with him, and that he might send them forth to preach,
translations.ylt: and he appointed twelve, that they may be with him, and that he may send them forth to preach,
translations.web: He appointed twelve, that they might be with him, and that he might send them out to preach

translations.kjv: And to have power to heal sicknesses, and to cast out devils:
translations.ylt: and to have power to heal the sicknesses, and to cast out the demons.
translations.web: and to have authority to heal sicknesses and to cast out demons:

translations.kjv: And Simon he surnamed Peter;
translations.ylt: And he put on Simon the name Peter;
translations.web: Simon (to whom he gave the name Peter);

translations.kjv: And James the son of Zebedee, and John the brother of James; and he surnamed them Boanerges, which is, The sons of thunder:
translations.ylt: and James of Zebedee, and John the brother of James, and he put on them names--Boanerges, that is, `Sons of thunder;'
translations.web: James the son of Zebedee; and John, the brother of James, (whom he called Boanerges, which means, Sons of Thunder);

translations.kjv: And Andrew, and Philip, and Bartholomew, and Matthew, and Thomas, and James the son of Alpheus, and Thaddeus, and Simon the Canaanite,
translations.ylt: and Andrew, and Philip, and Bartholomew, and Matthew, and Thomas, and James of Alpheus, and Thaddeus, and Simon the Cananite,
translations.web: Andrew; Philip; Bartholomew; Matthew; Thomas; James, the son of Alphaeus; Thaddaeus; Simon the Zealot;

translations.kjv: And Judas Iscariot, which also betrayed him: and they went into an house.
translations.ylt: and Judas Iscariot, who did also deliver him up; and they come into a house.
translations.web: and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him. Then he came into a house.

translations.kjv: And the multitude cometh together again, so that they could not so much as eat bread.
translations.ylt: And come together again doth a multitude, so that they are not able even to eat bread;
translations.web: The multitude came together again, so that they could not so much as eat bread.

translations.kjv: And when his friends heard of it, they went out to lay hold on him: for they said, He is beside himself.
translations.ylt: and his friends having heard, went forth to lay hold on him, for they said that he was beside himself,
translations.web: When his friends heard it, they went out to seize him; for they said, “He is insane.”

translations.kjv: And the scribes which came down from Jerusalem said, He hath Beelzebub, and by the prince of the devils casteth he out devils.
translations.ylt: and the scribes who are from Jerusalem having come down, said--`He hath Beelzeboul,' and--`By the ruler of the demons he doth cast out the demons.'
translations.web: The scribes who came down from Jerusalem said, “He has Beelzebul,” and, “By the prince of the demons he casts out the demons.”

translations.kjv: And he called them unto him, and said unto them in parables, How can Satan cast out Satan?
translations.ylt: And, having called them near, in similes he said to them, `How is the Adversary able to cast out the Adversary?
translations.web: He summoned them and said to them in parables, “How can Satan cast out Satan?

translations.kjv: And if a kingdom be divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.
translations.ylt: and if a kingdom against itself be divided, that kingdom cannot be made to stand;
translations.web: If a kingdom is divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.

translations.kjv: And if a house be divided against itself, that house cannot stand.
translations.ylt: and if a house against itself be divided, that house cannot be made to stand;
translations.web: If a house is divided against itself, that house cannot stand.

translations.kjv: And if Satan rise up against himself, and be divided, he cannot stand, but hath an end.
translations.ylt: and if the Adversary did rise against himself, and hath been divided, he cannot be made to stand, but hath an end.
translations.web: If Satan has risen up against himself, and is divided, he can’t stand, but has an end.

translations.kjv: No man can enter into a strong man’s house, and spoil his goods, except he will first bind the strong man; and then he will spoil his house.
translations.ylt: `No one is able the vessels of the strong man--having entered into his house--to spoil, if first he may not bind the strong man, and then his house he will spoil.
translations.web: But no one can enter into the house of the strong man to plunder unless he first binds the strong man; then he will plunder his house.

translations.kjv: Verily I say unto you, All sins shall be forgiven unto the sons of men, and blasphemies wherewith soever they shall blaspheme:
translations.ylt: `Verily I say to you, that all the sins shall be forgiven to the sons of men, and evil speakings with which they might speak evil,
translations.web: “Most certainly I tell you, all sins of the descendants of man will be forgiven, including their blasphemies with which they may blaspheme;

translations.kjv: But he that shall blaspheme against the Holy Ghost hath never forgiveness, but is in danger of eternal damnation:
translations.ylt: but whoever may speak evil in regard to the Holy Spirit hath not forgiveness--to the age, but is in danger of age-during judgment;'
translations.web: but whoever may blaspheme against the Holy Spirit never has forgiveness, but is subject to eternal condemnation.”

translations.kjv: Because they said, He hath an unclean spirit.
translations.ylt: because they said, `He hath an unclean spirit.'
translations.web: —because they said, “He has an unclean spirit.”

translations.kjv: There came then his brethren and his mother, and, standing without, sent unto him, calling him.
translations.ylt: Then come do his brethren and mother, and standing without, they sent unto him, calling him,
translations.web: His mother and his brothers came, and standing outside, they sent to him, calling him.

translations.kjv: And the multitude sat about him, and they said unto him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren without seek for thee.
translations.ylt: and a multitude was sitting about him, and they said to him, `Lo, thy mother and thy brethren without do seek thee.'
translations.web: A multitude was sitting around him, and they told him, “Behold, your mother, your brothers, and your sisters are outside looking for you.”

translations.kjv: And he answered them, saying, Who is my mother, or my brethren?
translations.ylt: And he answered them, saying, `Who is my mother, or my brethren?'
translations.web: He answered them, “Who are my mother and my brothers?”

translations.kjv: And he looked round about on them which sat about him, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren!
translations.ylt: And having looked round in a circle to those sitting about him, he saith, `Lo, my mother and my brethren!
translations.web: Looking around at those who sat around him, he said, “Behold, my mother and my brothers!

translations.kjv: For whosoever shall do the will of God, the same is my brother, and my sister, and mother.
translations.ylt: for whoever may do the will of God, he is my brother, and my sister, and mother.'
translations.web: For whoever does the will of God is my brother, my sister, and mother.”

translations.kjv: And he began again to teach by the sea side: and there was gathered unto him a great multitude, so that he entered into a ship, and sat in the sea; and the whole multitude was by the sea on the land.
translations.ylt: And again he began to teach by the sea, and there was gathered unto him a great multitude, so that he, having gone into the boat, sat in the sea, and all the multitude was near the sea, on the land,
translations.web: Again he began to teach by the seaside. A great multitude was gathered to him, so that he entered into a boat in the sea and sat down. All the multitude were on the land by the sea.

translations.kjv: And he taught them many things by parables, and said unto them in his doctrine,
translations.ylt: and he taught them many things in similes, and he said to them in his teaching:
translations.web: He taught them many things in parables, and told them in his teaching,

translations.kjv: Hearken; Behold, there went out a sower to sow:
translations.ylt: `Hearken, lo, the sower went forth to sow;
translations.web: “Listen! Behold, the farmer went out to sow.

translations.kjv: And it came to pass, as he sowed, some fell by the way side, and the fowls of the air came and devoured it up.
translations.ylt: and it came to pass, in the sowing, some fell by the way, and the fowls of the heaven did come and devour it;
translations.web: As he sowed, some seed fell by the road, and the birds came and devoured it.

translations.kjv: And some fell on stony ground, where it had not much earth; and immediately it sprang up, because it had no depth of earth:
translations.ylt: and other fell upon the rocky ground, where it had not much earth, and immediately it sprang forth, because of not having depth of earth,
translations.web: Others fell on the rocky ground, where it had little soil, and immediately it sprang up, because it had no depth of soil.

translations.kjv: But when the sun was up, it was scorched; and because it had no root, it withered away.
translations.ylt: and the sun having risen, it was scorched, and because of not having root it did wither;
translations.web: When the sun had risen, it was scorched; and because it had no root, it withered away.

translations.kjv: And some fell among thorns, and the thorns grew up, and choked it, and it yielded no fruit.
translations.ylt: and other fell toward the thorns, and the thorns did come up, and choke it, and fruit it gave not;
translations.web: Others fell among the thorns, and the thorns grew up and choked it, and it yielded no fruit.

translations.kjv: And other fell on good ground, and did yield fruit that sprang up and increased; and brought forth, some thirty, and some sixty, and some an hundred.
translations.ylt: and other fell to the good ground, and was giving fruit, coming up and increasing, and it bare, one thirty-fold, and one sixty, and one an hundred.'
translations.web: Others fell into the good ground and yielded fruit, growing up and increasing. Some produced thirty times, some sixty times, and some one hundred times as much.”

translations.kjv: And he said unto them, He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
translations.ylt: And he said to them, `He who is having ears to hear--let him hear.'
translations.web: He said, “Whoever has ears to hear, let him hear.”

translations.kjv: And when he was alone, they that were about him with the twelve asked of him the parable.
translations.ylt: And when he was alone, those about him, with the twelve, did ask him of the simile,
translations.web: When he was alone, those who were around him with the twelve asked him about the parables.

translations.kjv: And he said unto them, Unto you it is given to know the mystery of the kingdom of God: but unto them that are without, all these things are done in parables:
translations.ylt: and he said to them, `To you it hath been given to know the secret of the reign of God, but to those who are without, in similes are all the things done;
translations.web: He said to them, “To you is given the mystery of God’s Kingdom, but to those who are outside, all things are done in parables,

translations.kjv: That seeing they may see, and not perceive; and hearing they may hear, and not understand; lest at any time they should be converted, and their sins should be forgiven them.
translations.ylt: that seeing they may see and not perceive, and hearing they may hear and not understand, lest they may turn, and the sins may be forgiven them.'
translations.web: that ‘seeing they may see and not perceive, and hearing they may hear and not understand, lest perhaps they should turn again, and their sins should be forgiven them.’”

translations.kjv: And he said unto them, Know ye not this parable? and how then will ye know all parables?
translations.ylt: And he saith to them, `Have ye not known this simile? and how shall ye know all the similes?
translations.web: He said to them, “Don’t you understand this parable? How will you understand all of the parables?

translations.kjv: The sower soweth the word.
translations.ylt: He who is sowing doth sow the word;
translations.web: The farmer sows the word.

translations.kjv: And these are they by the way side, where the word is sown; but when they have heard, Satan cometh immediately, and taketh away the word that was sown in their hearts.
translations.ylt: and these are they by the way where the word is sown: and whenever they may hear, immediately cometh the Adversary, and he taketh away the word that hath been sown in their hearts.
translations.web: The ones by the road are the ones where the word is sown; and when they have heard, immediately Satan comes and takes away the word which has been sown in them.

translations.kjv: And these are they likewise which are sown on stony ground; who, when they have heard the word, immediately receive it with gladness;
translations.ylt: `And these are they, in like manner, who on the rocky ground are sown: who, whenever they may hear the word, immediately with joy do receive it,
translations.web: These in the same way are those who are sown on the rocky places, who, when they have heard the word, immediately receive it with joy.

translations.kjv: And have no root in themselves, and so endure but for a time: afterward, when affliction or persecution ariseth for the word’s sake, immediately they are offended.
translations.ylt: and have not root in themselves, but are temporary; afterward tribulation or persecution having come because of the word, immediately they are stumbled.
translations.web: They have no root in themselves, but are short-lived. When oppression or persecution arises because of the word, immediately they stumble.

translations.kjv: And these are they which are sown among thorns; such as hear the word,
translations.ylt: `And these are they who toward the thorns are sown: these are they who are hearing the word,
translations.web: Others are those who are sown among the thorns. These are those who have heard the word,

translations.kjv: And the cares of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, and the lusts of other things entering in, choke the word, and it becometh unfruitful.
translations.ylt: and the anxieties of this age, and the deceitfulness of the riches, and the desires concerning the other things, entering in, choke the word, and it becometh unfruitful.
translations.web: and the cares of this age, and the deceitfulness of riches, and the lusts of other things entering in choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.

translations.kjv: And these are they which are sown on good ground; such as hear the word, and receive it, and bring forth fruit, some thirtyfold, some sixty, and some an hundred.
translations.ylt: `And these are they who on the good ground have been sown: who do hear the word, and receive, and do bear fruit, one thirty-fold, and one sixty, and one an hundred.'
translations.web: Those which were sown on the good ground are those who hear the word, accept it, and bear fruit, some thirty times, some sixty times, and some one hundred times.”

translations.kjv: And he said unto them, Is a candle brought to be put under a bushel, or under a bed? and not to be set on a candlestick?
translations.ylt: And he said to them, `Doth the lamp come that under the measure it may be put, or under the couch--not that it may be put on the lamp-stand?
translations.web: He said to them, “Is a lamp brought to be put under a basket or under a bed? Isn’t it put on a stand?

translations.kjv: For there is nothing hid, which shall not be manifested; neither was any thing kept secret, but that it should come abroad.
translations.ylt: for there is not anything hid that may not be manifested, nor was anything kept hid but that it may come to light.
translations.web: For there is nothing hidden except that it should be made known, neither was anything made secret but that it should come to light.

translations.kjv: If any man have ears to hear, let him hear.
translations.ylt: If any hath ears to hear--let him hear.'
translations.web: If any man has ears to hear, let him hear.”

translations.kjv: And he said unto them, Take heed what ye hear: with what measure ye mete, it shall be measured to you: and unto you that hear shall more be given.
translations.ylt: And he said to them, `Take heed what ye hear; in what measure ye measure, it shall be measured to you; and to you who hear it shall be added;
translations.web: He said to them, “Take heed what you hear. With whatever measure you measure, it will be measured to you; and more will be given to you who hear.

translations.kjv: For he that hath, to him shall be given: and he that hath not, from him shall be taken even that which he hath.
translations.ylt: for whoever may have, there shall be given to him, and whoever hath not, also that which he hath shall be taken from him.'
translations.web: For whoever has, to him more will be given; and he who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away from him.”

translations.kjv: And he said, So is the kingdom of God, as if a man should cast seed into the ground;
translations.ylt: And he said, `Thus is the reign of God: as if a man may cast the seed on the earth,
translations.web: He said, “God’s Kingdom is as if a man should cast seed on the earth,

translations.kjv: And should sleep, and rise night and day, and the seed should spring and grow up, he knoweth not how.
translations.ylt: and may sleep, and may rise night and day, and the seed spring up and grow, he hath not known how;
translations.web: and should sleep and rise night and day, and the seed should spring up and grow, though he doesn’t know how.

translations.kjv: For the earth bringeth forth fruit of herself; first the blade, then the ear, after that the full corn in the ear.
translations.ylt: for of itself doth the earth bear fruit, first a blade, afterwards an ear, afterwards full corn in the ear;
translations.web: For the earth bears fruit by itself: first the blade, then the ear, then the full grain in the ear.

translations.kjv: But when the fruit is brought forth, immediately he putteth in the sickle, because the harvest is come.
translations.ylt: and whenever the fruit may yield itself, immediately he doth send forth the sickle, because the harvest hath come.'
translations.web: But when the fruit is ripe, immediately he puts in the sickle, because the harvest has come.”

translations.kjv: And he said, Whereunto shall we liken the kingdom of God? or with what comparison shall we compare it?
translations.ylt: And he said, `To what may we liken the reign of God, or in what simile may we compare it?
translations.web: He said, “How will we liken God’s Kingdom? Or with what parable will we illustrate it?

translations.kjv: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, is less than all the seeds that be in the earth:
translations.ylt: As a grain of mustard, which, whenever it may be sown on the earth, is less than any of the seeds that are on the earth;
translations.web: It’s like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, though it is less than all the seeds that are on the earth,

translations.kjv: But when it is sown, it groweth up, and becometh greater than all herbs, and shooteth out great branches; so that the fowls of the air may lodge under the shadow of it.
translations.ylt: and whenever it may be sown, it cometh up, and doth become greater than any of the herbs, and doth make great branches, so that under its shade the fowls of the heaven are able to rest.'
translations.web: yet when it is sown, grows up and becomes greater than all the herbs, and puts out great branches, so that the birds of the sky can lodge under its shadow.”

translations.kjv: And with many such parables spake he the word unto them, as they were able to hear it.
translations.ylt: And with many such similes he was speaking to them the word, as they were able to hear,
translations.web: With many such parables he spoke the word to them, as they were able to hear it.

translations.kjv: But without a parable spake he not unto them: and when they were alone, he expounded all things to his disciples.
translations.ylt: and without a simile he was not speaking to them, and by themselves, to his disciples he was expounding all.
translations.web: Without a parable he didn’t speak to them; but privately to his own disciples he explained everything.

translations.kjv: And the same day, when the even was come, he saith unto them, Let us pass over unto the other side.
translations.ylt: And he saith to them on that day, evening having come, `We may pass over to the other side;'
translations.web: On that day, when evening had come, he said to them, “Let’s go over to the other side.”

translations.kjv: And when they had sent away the multitude, they took him even as he was in the ship. And there were also with him other little ships.
translations.ylt: and having let away the multitude, they take him up as he was in the boat, and other little boats also were with him.
translations.web: Leaving the multitude, they took him with them, even as he was, in the boat. Other small boats were also with him.

translations.kjv: And there arose a great storm of wind, and the waves beat into the ship, so that it was now full.
translations.ylt: And there cometh a great storm of wind, and the waves were beating on the boat, so that it is now being filled,
translations.web: A big wind storm arose, and the waves beat into the boat, so much that the boat was already filled.

translations.kjv: And he was in the hinder part of the ship, asleep on a pillow: and they awake him, and say unto him, Master, carest thou not that we perish?
translations.ylt: and he himself was upon the stern, upon the pillow sleeping, and they wake him up, and say to him, `Teacher, art thou not caring that we perish?'
translations.web: He himself was in the stern, asleep on the cushion; and they woke him up and asked him, “Teacher, don’t you care that we are dying?”

translations.kjv: And he arose, and rebuked the wind, and said unto the sea, Peace, be still. And the wind ceased, and there was a great calm.
translations.ylt: And having waked up, he rebuked the wind, and said to the sea, `Peace, be stilled;' and the wind did lull, and there was a great calm:
translations.web: He awoke and rebuked the wind, and said to the sea, “Peace! Be still!” The wind ceased and there was a great calm.

translations.kjv: And he said unto them, Why are ye so fearful? how is it that ye have no faith?
translations.ylt: and he said to them, `Why are ye so fearful? how have ye not faith?'
translations.web: He said to them, “Why are you so afraid? How is it that you have no faith?”

translations.kjv: And they feared exceedingly, and said one to another, What manner of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?
translations.ylt: and they feared a great fear, and said one to another, `Who, then, is this, that even the wind and the sea do obey him?'
translations.web: They were greatly afraid and said to one another, “Who then is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?”

translations.kjv: And they came over unto the other side of the sea, into the country of the Gadarenes.
translations.ylt: And they came to the other side of the sea, to the region of the Gadarenes,
translations.web: They came to the other side of the sea, into the country of the Gadarenes.

translations.kjv: And when he was come out of the ship, immediately there met him out of the tombs a man with an unclean spirit,
translations.ylt: and he having come forth out of the boat, immediately there met him out of the tombs a man with an unclean spirit,
translations.web: When he had come out of the boat, immediately a man with an unclean spirit met him out of the tombs.

translations.kjv: Who had his dwelling among the tombs; and no man could bind him, no, not with chains:
translations.ylt: who had his dwelling in the tombs, and not even with chains was any one able to bind him,
translations.web: He lived in the tombs. Nobody could bind him any more, not even with chains,

translations.kjv: Because that he had been often bound with fetters and chains, and the chains had been plucked asunder by him, and the fetters broken in pieces: neither could any man tame him.
translations.ylt: because that he many times with fetters and chains had been bound, and pulled in pieces by him had been the chains, and the fetters broken in pieces, and none was able to tame him,
translations.web: because he had been often bound with fetters and chains, and the chains had been torn apart by him, and the fetters broken in pieces. Nobody had the strength to tame him.

translations.kjv: And always, night and day, he was in the mountains, and in the tombs, crying, and cutting himself with stones.
translations.ylt: and always, night and day, in the mountains, and in the tombs he was, crying and cutting himself with stones.
translations.web: Always, night and day, in the tombs and in the mountains, he was crying out, and cutting himself with stones.

translations.kjv: But when he saw Jesus afar off, he ran and worshipped him,
translations.ylt: And, having seen Jesus from afar, he ran and bowed before him,
translations.web: When he saw Jesus from afar, he ran and bowed down to him,

translations.kjv: And cried with a loud voice, and said, What have I to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of the most high God? I adjure thee by God, that thou torment me not.
translations.ylt: and having called with a loud voice, he said, `What--to me and to thee, Jesus, Son of God the Most High? I adjure thee by God, mayest thou not afflict me!'
translations.web: and crying out with a loud voice, he said, “What have I to do with you, Jesus, you Son of the Most High God? I adjure you by God, don’t torment me.”

translations.kjv: For he said unto him, Come out of the man, thou unclean spirit.
translations.ylt: (for he said to him, `Come forth, spirit unclean, out of the man,')
translations.web: For he said to him, “Come out of the man, you unclean spirit!”

translations.kjv: And he asked him, What is thy name? And he answered, saying, My name is Legion: for we are many.
translations.ylt: and he was questioning him, `What is thy name?' and he answered, saying, `Legion is my name, because we are many;'
translations.web: He asked him, “What is your name?” He said to him, “My name is Legion, for we are many.”

translations.kjv: And he besought him much that he would not send them away out of the country.
translations.ylt: and he was calling on him much, that he may not send them out of the region.
translations.web: He begged him much that he would not send them away out of the country.

translations.kjv: Now there was there nigh unto the mountains a great herd of swine feeding.
translations.ylt: And there was there, near the mountains, a great herd of swine feeding,
translations.web: Now on the mountainside there was a great herd of pigs feeding.

translations.kjv: And all the devils besought him, saying, Send us into the swine, that we may enter into them.
translations.ylt: and all the demons did call upon him, saying, `Send us to the swine, that into them we may enter;'
translations.web: All the demons begged him, saying, “Send us into the pigs, that we may enter into them.”

translations.kjv: And forthwith Jesus gave them leave. And the unclean spirits went out, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the sea, (they were about two thousand;) and were choked in the sea.
translations.ylt: and immediately Jesus gave them leave, and having come forth, the unclean spirits did enter into the swine, and the herd did rush down the steep place to the sea--and they were about two thousand--and they were choked in the sea.
translations.web: At once Jesus gave them permission. The unclean spirits came out and entered into the pigs. The herd of about two thousand rushed down the steep bank into the sea, and they were drowned in the sea.

translations.kjv: And they that fed the swine fled, and told it in the city, and in the country. And they went out to see what it was that was done.
translations.ylt: And those feeding the swine did flee, and told in the city, and in the fields, and they came forth to see what it is that hath been done;
translations.web: Those who fed the pigs fled, and told it in the city and in the country. The people came to see what it was that had happened.

translations.kjv: And they come to Jesus, and see him that was possessed with the devil, and had the legion, sitting, and clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid.
translations.ylt: and they come unto Jesus, and see the demoniac, sitting, and clothed, and right-minded--him having had the legion--and they were afraid;
translations.web: They came to Jesus, and saw him who had been possessed by demons sitting, clothed, and in his right mind, even him who had the legion; and they were afraid.

translations.kjv: And they that saw it told them how it befell to him that was possessed with the devil, and also concerning the swine.
translations.ylt: and those having seen it, declared to them how it had come to pass to the demoniac, and about the swine;
translations.web: Those who saw it declared to them what happened to him who was possessed by demons, and about the pigs.

translations.kjv: And they began to pray him to depart out of their coasts.
translations.ylt: and they began to call upon him to go away from their borders.
translations.web: They began to beg him to depart from their region.

translations.kjv: And when he was come into the ship, he that had been possessed with the devil prayed him that he might be with him.
translations.ylt: And he having gone into the boat, the demoniac was calling on him that he may be with him,
translations.web: As he was entering into the boat, he who had been possessed by demons begged him that he might be with him.

translations.kjv: Howbeit Jesus suffered him not, but saith unto him, Go home to thy friends, and tell them how great things the Lord hath done for thee, and hath had compassion on thee.
translations.ylt: and Jesus did not suffer him, but saith to him, `Go away to thy house, unto thine own friends, and tell them how great things the Lord did to thee, and dealt kindly with thee;
translations.web: He didn’t allow him, but said to him, “Go to your house, to your friends, and tell them what great things the Lord has done for you and how he had mercy on you.”

translations.kjv: And he departed, and began to publish in Decapolis how great things Jesus had done for him: and all men did marvel.
translations.ylt: and he went away, and began to proclaim in the Decapolis how great things Jesus did to him, and all were wondering.
translations.web: He went his way, and began to proclaim in Decapolis how Jesus had done great things for him, and everyone marveled.

translations.kjv: And when Jesus was passed over again by ship unto the other side, much people gathered unto him: and he was nigh unto the sea.
translations.ylt: And Jesus having passed over in the boat again to the other side, there was gathered a great multitude to him, and he was near the sea,
translations.web: When Jesus had crossed back over in the boat to the other side, a great multitude was gathered to him; and he was by the sea.

translations.kjv: And, behold, there cometh one of the rulers of the synagogue, Jairus by name; and when he saw him, he fell at his feet,
translations.ylt: and lo, there doth come one of the chiefs of the synagogue, by name Jairus, and having seen him, he doth fall at his feet,
translations.web: Behold, one of the rulers of the synagogue, Jairus by name, came; and seeing him, he fell at his feet

translations.kjv: And besought him greatly, saying, My little daughter lieth at the point of death: I pray thee, come and lay thy hands on her, that she may be healed; and she shall live.
translations.ylt: and he was calling upon him much, saying--`My little daughter is at the last extremity--that having come, thou mayest lay on her thy hands, so that she may be saved, and she shall live;'
translations.web: and begged him much, saying, “My little daughter is at the point of death. Please come and lay your hands on her, that she may be made healthy, and live.”

translations.kjv: And Jesus went with him; and much people followed him, and thronged him.
translations.ylt: and he went away with him. And there was following him a great multitude, and they were thronging him,
translations.web: He went with him, and a great multitude followed him, and they pressed upon him on all sides.

translations.kjv: And a certain woman, which had an issue of blood twelve years,
translations.ylt: and a certain woman, having an issue of blood twelve years,
translations.web: A certain woman who had a discharge of blood for twelve years,

translations.kjv: And had suffered many things of many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was nothing bettered, but rather grew worse,
translations.ylt: and many things having suffered under many physicians, and having spent all that she had, and having profited nothing, but rather having come to the worse,
translations.web: and had suffered many things by many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was no better, but rather grew worse,

translations.kjv: When she had heard of Jesus, came in the press behind, and touched his garment.
translations.ylt: having heard about Jesus, having come in the multitude behind, she touched his garment,
translations.web: having heard the things concerning Jesus, came up behind him in the crowd and touched his clothes.

translations.kjv: For she said, If I may touch but his clothes, I shall be whole.
translations.ylt: for she said--`If even his garments I may touch, I shall be saved;'
translations.web: For she said, “If I just touch his clothes, I will be made well.”

translations.kjv: And straightway the fountain of her blood was dried up; and she felt in her body that she was healed of that plague.
translations.ylt: and immediately was the fountain of her blood dried up, and she knew in the body that she hath been healed of the plague.
translations.web: Immediately the flow of her blood was dried up, and she felt in her body that she was healed of her affliction.

translations.kjv: And Jesus, immediately knowing in himself that virtue had gone out of him, turned him about in the press, and said, Who touched my clothes?
translations.ylt: And immediately Jesus having known in himself that out of him power had gone forth, having turned about in the multitude, said, `Who did touch my garments?'
translations.web: Immediately Jesus, perceiving in himself that the power had gone out from him, turned around in the crowd and asked, “Who touched my clothes?”

translations.kjv: And his disciples said unto him, Thou seest the multitude thronging thee, and sayest thou, Who touched me?
translations.ylt: and his disciples said to him, `Thou seest the multitude thronging thee, and thou sayest, `Who did touch me!'
translations.web: His disciples said to him, “You see the multitude pressing against you, and you say, ‘Who touched me?’”

translations.kjv: And he looked round about to see her that had done this thing.
translations.ylt: And he was looking round to see her who did this,
translations.web: He looked around to see her who had done this thing.

translations.kjv: But the woman fearing and trembling, knowing what was done in her, came and fell down before him, and told him all the truth.
translations.ylt: and the woman, having been afraid, and trembling, knowing what was done on her, came, and fell down before him, and told him all the truth,
translations.web: But the woman, fearing and trembling, knowing what had been done to her, came and fell down before him, and told him all the truth.

translations.kjv: And he said unto her, Daughter, thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace, and be whole of thy plague.
translations.ylt: and he said to her, `Daughter, thy faith hath saved thee; go away in peace, and be whole from thy plague.'
translations.web: He said to her, “Daughter, your faith has made you well. Go in peace, and be cured of your disease.”

translations.kjv: While he yet spake, there came from the ruler of the synagogue’s house certain which said, Thy daughter is dead: why troublest thou the Master any further?
translations.ylt: As he is yet speaking, there come from the chief of the synagogue's house, certain, saying--`Thy daughter did die, why still dost thou harass the Teacher?'
translations.web: While he was still speaking, people came from the synagogue ruler’s house, saying, “Your daughter is dead. Why bother the Teacher any more?”

translations.kjv: As soon as Jesus heard the word that was spoken, he saith unto the ruler of the synagogue, Be not afraid, only believe.
translations.ylt: And Jesus immediately, having heard the word that is spoken, saith to the chief of the synagogue, `Be not afraid, only believe.'
translations.web: But Jesus, when he heard the message spoken, immediately said to the ruler of the synagogue, “Don’t be afraid, only believe.”

translations.kjv: And he suffered no man to follow him, save Peter, and James, and John the brother of James.
translations.ylt: And he did not suffer any one to follow with him, except Peter, and James, and John the brother of James;
translations.web: He allowed no one to follow him except Peter, James, and John the brother of James.

translations.kjv: And he cometh to the house of the ruler of the synagogue, and seeth the tumult, and them that wept and wailed greatly.
translations.ylt: and he cometh to the house of the chief of the synagogue, and seeth a tumult, much weeping and wailing;
translations.web: He came to the synagogue ruler’s house, and he saw an uproar, weeping, and great wailing.

translations.kjv: And when he was come in, he saith unto them, Why make ye this ado, and weep? the damsel is not dead, but sleepeth.
translations.ylt: and having gone in he saith to them, `Why do ye make a tumult, and weep? the child did not die, but doth sleep;
translations.web: When he had entered in, he said to them, “Why do you make an uproar and weep? The child is not dead, but is asleep.”

translations.kjv: And they laughed him to scorn. But when he had put them all out, he taketh the father and the mother of the damsel, and them that were with him, and entereth in where the damsel was lying.
translations.ylt: and they were laughing at him. And he, having put all forth, doth take the father of the child, and the mother, and those with him, and goeth in where the child is lying,
translations.web: They ridiculed him. But he, having put them all out, took the father of the child, her mother, and those who were with him, and went in where the child was lying.

translations.kjv: And he took the damsel by the hand, and said unto her, Talitha cumi; which is, being interpreted, Damsel, I say unto thee, arise.
translations.ylt: and, having taken the hand of the child, he saith to her, `Talitha cumi;' which is, being interpreted, `Damsel (I say to thee), arise.'
translations.web: Taking the child by the hand, he said to her, “Talitha cumi!” which means, being interpreted, “Girl, I tell you, get up!”

translations.kjv: And straightway the damsel arose, and walked; for she was of the age of twelve years. And they were astonished with a great astonishment.
translations.ylt: And immediately the damsel arose, and was walking, for she was twelve years old; and they were amazed with a great amazement,
translations.web: Immediately the girl rose up and walked, for she was twelve years old. They were amazed with great amazement.

translations.kjv: And he charged them straitly that no man should know it; and commanded that something should be given her to eat.
translations.ylt: and he charged them much, that no one may know this thing, and he said that there be given to her to eat.
translations.web: He strictly ordered them that no one should know this, and commanded that something should be given to her to eat.

translations.kjv: And he went out from thence, and came into his own country; and his disciples follow him.
translations.ylt: And he went forth thence, and came to his own country, and his disciples do follow him,
translations.web: He went out from there. He came into his own country, and his disciples followed him.

translations.kjv: And when the sabbath day was come, he began to teach in the synagogue: and many hearing him were astonished, saying, From whence hath this man these things? and what wisdom is this which is given unto him, that even such mighty works are wrought by his hands?
translations.ylt: and sabbath having come, he began in the synagogue to teach, and many hearing were astonished, saying, `Whence hath this one these things? and what the wisdom that was given to him, that also such mighty works through his hands are done?
translations.web: When the Sabbath had come, he began to teach in the synagogue, and many hearing him were astonished, saying, “Where did this man get these things?” and, “What is the wisdom that is given to this man, that such mighty works come about by his hands?

translations.kjv: Is not this the carpenter, the son of Mary, the brother of James, and Joses, and of Juda, and Simon? and are not his sisters here with us? And they were offended at him.
translations.ylt: Is not this the carpenter, the son of Mary, and brother of James, and Joses, and Judas, and Simon? and are not his sisters here with us?' --and they were being stumbled at him.
translations.web: Isn’t this the carpenter, the son of Mary and brother of James, Joses, Judah, and Simon? Aren’t his sisters here with us?” So they were offended at him.

translations.kjv: But Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, but in his own country, and among his own kin, and in his own house.
translations.ylt: And Jesus said to them--`A prophet is not without honour, except in his own country, and among his kindred, and in his own house;'
translations.web: Jesus said to them, “A prophet is not without honor, except in his own country, and among his own relatives, and in his own house.”

translations.kjv: And he could there do no mighty work, save that he laid his hands upon a few sick folk, and healed them.
translations.ylt: and he was not able there any mighty work to do, except on a few infirm people having put hands he did heal them;
translations.web: He could do no mighty work there, except that he laid his hands on a few sick people and healed them.

translations.kjv: And he marvelled because of their unbelief. And he went round about the villages, teaching.
translations.ylt: and he wondered because of their unbelief. And he was going round the villages, in a circle, teaching,
translations.web: He marveled because of their unbelief. He went around the villages teaching.

translations.kjv: And he called unto him the twelve, and began to send them forth by two and two; and gave them power over unclean spirits;
translations.ylt: and he doth call near the twelve, and he began to send them forth two by two, and he was giving them power over the unclean spirits,
translations.web: He called to himself the twelve, and began to send them out two by two; and he gave them authority over the unclean spirits.

translations.kjv: And commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, save a staff only; no scrip, no bread, no money in their purse:
translations.ylt: and he commanded them that they may take nothing for the way, except a staff only--no scrip, no bread, no brass in the girdle,
translations.web: He commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, except a staff only: no bread, no wallet, no money in their purse,

translations.kjv: But be shod with sandals; and not put on two coats.
translations.ylt: but having been shod with sandals, and ye may not put on two coats.
translations.web: but to wear sandals, and not put on two tunics.

translations.kjv: And he said unto them, In what place soever ye enter into an house, there abide till ye depart from that place.
translations.ylt: And he said to them, `Whenever ye may enter into a house, there remain till ye may depart thence,
translations.web: He said to them, “Wherever you enter into a house, stay there until you depart from there.

translations.kjv: And whosoever shall not receive you, nor hear you, when ye depart thence, shake off the dust under your feet for a testimony against them. Verily I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment, than for that city.
