translations.ylt: and as many as may not receive you, nor hear you, going out thence, shake off the dust that is under your feet for a testimony to them; verily I say to you, It shall be more tolerable for Sodom or Gomorrah in a day of judgment than for that city.'
translations.web: Whoever will not receive you nor hear you, as you depart from there, shake off the dust that is under your feet for a testimony against them. Assuredly, I tell you, it will be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city!”

translations.kjv: And they went out, and preached that men should repent.
translations.ylt: And having gone forth they were preaching that men might reform,
translations.web: They went out and preached that people should repent.

translations.kjv: And they cast out many devils, and anointed with oil many that were sick, and healed them.
translations.ylt: and many demons they were casting out, and they were anointing with oil many infirm, and they were healing them.
translations.web: They cast out many demons, and anointed many with oil who were sick and healed them.

translations.kjv: And king Herod heard of him; (for his name was spread abroad:) and he said, That John the Baptist was risen from the dead, and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him.
translations.ylt: And the king Herod heard, (for his name became public,) and he said--`John the Baptist out of the dead was raised, and because of this the mighty powers are working in him.'
translations.web: King Herod heard this, for his name had become known, and he said, “John the Baptizer has risen from the dead, and therefore these powers are at work in him.”

translations.kjv: Others said, That it is Elias. And others said, That it is a prophet, or as one of the prophets.
translations.ylt: Others said--`It is Elijah,' and others said--`It is a prophet, or as one of the prophets.'
translations.web: But others said, “He is Elijah.” Others said, “He is a prophet, or like one of the prophets.”

translations.kjv: But when Herod heard thereof, he said, It is John, whom I beheaded: he is risen from the dead.
translations.ylt: And Herod having heard, said--`He whom I did behead--John--this is he; he was raised out of the dead.'
translations.web: But Herod, when he heard this, said, “This is John, whom I beheaded. He has risen from the dead.”

translations.kjv: For Herod himself had sent forth and laid hold upon John, and bound him in prison for Herodias’ sake, his brother Philip’s wife: for he had married her.
translations.ylt: For Herod himself, having sent forth, did lay hold on John, and bound him in the prison, because of Herodias the wife of Philip his brother, because he married her,
translations.web: For Herod himself had sent out and arrested John and bound him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife, for he had married her.

translations.kjv: For John had said unto Herod, It is not lawful for thee to have thy brother’s wife.
translations.ylt: for John said to Herod--`It is not lawful to thee to have the wife of thy brother;'
translations.web: For John had said to Herod, “It is not lawful for you to have your brother’s wife.”

translations.kjv: Therefore Herodias had a quarrel against him, and would have killed him; but she could not:
translations.ylt: and Herodias was having a quarrel with him, and was willing to kill him, and was not able,
translations.web: Herodias set herself against him and desired to kill him, but she couldn’t,

translations.kjv: For Herod feared John, knowing that he was a just man and an holy, and observed him; and when he heard him, he did many things, and heard him gladly.
translations.ylt: for Herod was fearing John, knowing him a man righteous and holy, and was keeping watch over him, and having heard him, was doing many things, and hearing him gladly.
translations.web: for Herod feared John, knowing that he was a righteous and holy man, and kept him safe. When he heard him, he did many things, and he heard him gladly.

translations.kjv: And when a convenient day was come, that Herod on his birthday made a supper to his lords, high captains, and chief estates of Galilee;
translations.ylt: And a seasonable day having come, when Herod on his birthday was making a supper to his great men, and to the chiefs of thousands, and to the first men of Galilee,
translations.web: Then a convenient day came when Herod on his birthday made a supper for his nobles, the high officers, and the chief men of Galilee.

translations.kjv: And when the daughter of the said Herodias came in, and danced, and pleased Herod and them that sat with him, the king said unto the damsel, Ask of me whatsoever thou wilt, and I will give it thee.
translations.ylt: and the daughter of that Herodias having come in, and having danced, and having pleased Herod and those reclining (at meat) with him, the king said to the damsel, `Ask of me whatever thou wilt, and I will give to thee,'
translations.web: When the daughter of Herodias herself came in and danced, she pleased Herod and those sitting with him. The king said to the young lady, “Ask me whatever you want, and I will give it to you.”

translations.kjv: And he sware unto her, Whatsoever thou shalt ask of me, I will give it thee, unto the half of my kingdom.
translations.ylt: and he sware to her--`Whatever thou mayest ask me, I will give to thee--unto the half of my kingdom.'
translations.web: He swore to her, “Whatever you ask of me, I will give you, up to half of my kingdom.”

translations.kjv: And she went forth, and said unto her mother, What shall I ask? And she said, The head of John the Baptist.
translations.ylt: And she, having gone forth, said to her mother, `What shall I ask for myself?' and she said, `The head of John the Baptist;'
translations.web: She went out and said to her mother, “What shall I ask?” She said, “The head of John the Baptizer.”

translations.kjv: And she came in straightway with haste unto the king, and asked, saying, I will that thou give me by and by in a charger the head of John the Baptist.
translations.ylt: and having come in immediately with haste unto the king, she asked, saying, `I will that thou mayest give me presently, upon a plate, the head of John the Baptist.'
translations.web: She came in immediately with haste to the king and requested, “I want you to give me right now the head of John the Baptizer on a platter.”

translations.kjv: And the king was exceeding sorry; yet for his oath’s sake, and for their sakes which sat with him, he would not reject her.
translations.ylt: And the king--made very sorrowful--because of the oaths and of those reclining (at meat) with him, would not put her away,
translations.web: The king was exceedingly sorry, but for the sake of his oaths and of his dinner guests, he didn’t wish to refuse her.

translations.kjv: And immediately the king sent an executioner, and commanded his head to be brought: and he went and beheaded him in the prison,
translations.ylt: and immediately the king having sent a guardsman, did command his head to be brought,
translations.web: Immediately the king sent out a soldier of his guard and commanded to bring John’s head; and he went and beheaded him in the prison,

translations.kjv: And brought his head in a charger, and gave it to the damsel: and the damsel gave it to her mother.
translations.ylt: and he having gone, beheaded him in the prison, and brought his head upon a plate, and did give it to the damsel, and the damsel did give it to her mother;
translations.web: and brought his head on a platter, and gave it to the young lady; and the young lady gave it to her mother.

translations.kjv: And when his disciples heard of it, they came and took up his corpse, and laid it in a tomb.
translations.ylt: and having heard, his disciples came and took up his corpse, and laid it in the tomb.
translations.web: When his disciples heard this, they came and took up his corpse and laid it in a tomb.

translations.kjv: And the apostles gathered themselves together unto Jesus, and told him all things, both what they had done, and what they had taught.
translations.ylt: And the apostles are gathered together unto Jesus, and they told him all, and how many things they did, and how many things they taught,
translations.web: The apostles gathered themselves together to Jesus, and they told him all things, whatever they had done, and whatever they had taught.

translations.kjv: And he said unto them, Come ye yourselves apart into a desert place, and rest a while: for there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.
translations.ylt: and he said to them, `Come ye yourselves apart to a desert place, and rest a little,' for those coming and those going were many, and not even to eat had they opportunity,
translations.web: He said to them, “Come away into a deserted place, and rest awhile.” For there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.

translations.kjv: And they departed into a desert place by ship privately.
translations.ylt: and they went away to a desert place, in the boat, by themselves.
translations.web: They went away in the boat to a deserted place by themselves.

translations.kjv: And the people saw them departing, and many knew him, and ran afoot thither out of all cities, and outwent them, and came together unto him.
translations.ylt: And the multitudes saw them going away, and many recognised him, and by land from all the cities they ran thither, and went before them, and came together to him,
translations.web: They saw them going, and many recognized him and ran there on foot from all the cities. They arrived before them and came together to him.

translations.kjv: And Jesus, when he came out, saw much people, and was moved with compassion toward them, because they were as sheep not having a shepherd: and he began to teach them many things.
translations.ylt: and having come forth, Jesus saw a great multitude, and was moved with compassion on them, that they were as sheep not having a shepherd, and he began to teach many things.
translations.web: Jesus came out, saw a great multitude, and he had compassion on them because they were like sheep without a shepherd; and he began to teach them many things.

translations.kjv: And when the day was now far spent, his disciples came unto him, and said, This is a desert place, and now the time is far passed:
translations.ylt: And now the hour being advanced, his disciples having come near to him, say, --`The place is desolate, and the hour is now advanced,
translations.web: When it was late in the day, his disciples came to him and said, “This place is deserted, and it is late in the day.

translations.kjv: Send them away, that they may go into the country round about, and into the villages, and buy themselves bread: for they have nothing to eat.
translations.ylt: let them away, that, having gone away to the surrounding fields and villages, they may buy to themselves loaves, for what they may eat they have not.'
translations.web: Send them away, that they may go into the surrounding country and villages and buy themselves bread, for they have nothing to eat.”

translations.kjv: He answered and said unto them, Give ye them to eat. And they say unto him, Shall we go and buy two hundred pennyworth of bread, and give them to eat?
translations.ylt: And he answering said to them, `Give ye them to eat,' and they say to him, `Having gone away, may we buy two hundred denaries' worth of loaves, and give to them to eat?'
translations.web: But he answered them, “You give them something to eat.” They asked him, “Shall we go and buy two hundred denarii worth of bread and give them something to eat?”

translations.kjv: He saith unto them, How many loaves have ye? go and see. And when they knew, they say, Five, and two fishes.
translations.ylt: And he saith to them, `How many loaves have ye? go and see;' and having known, they say, `Five, and two fishes.'
translations.web: He said to them, “How many loaves do you have? Go see.” When they knew, they said, “Five, and two fish.”

translations.kjv: And he commanded them to make all sit down by companies upon the green grass.
translations.ylt: And he commanded them to make all recline in companies upon the green grass,
translations.web: He commanded them that everyone should sit down in groups on the green grass.

translations.kjv: And they sat down in ranks, by hundreds, and by fifties.
translations.ylt: and they sat down in squares, by hundreds, and by fifties.
translations.web: They sat down in ranks, by hundreds and by fifties.

translations.kjv: And when he had taken the five loaves and the two fishes, he looked up to heaven, and blessed, and brake the loaves, and gave them to his disciples to set before them; and the two fishes divided he among them all.
translations.ylt: And having taken the five loaves and the two fishes, having looked up to the heaven, he blessed, and brake the loaves, and was giving to his disciples, that they may set before them, and the two fishes divided he to all,
translations.web: He took the five loaves and the two fish; and looking up to heaven, he blessed and broke the loaves, and he gave to his disciples to set before them, and he divided the two fish among them all.

translations.kjv: And they did all eat, and were filled.
translations.ylt: and they did all eat, and were filled,
translations.web: They all ate and were filled.

translations.kjv: And they took up twelve baskets full of the fragments, and of the fishes.
translations.ylt: and they took up of broken pieces twelve hand-baskets full, and of the fishes,
translations.web: They took up twelve baskets full of broken pieces and also of the fish.

translations.kjv: And they that did eat of the loaves were about five thousand men.
translations.ylt: and those eating of the loaves were about five thousand men.
translations.web: Those who ate the loaves were five thousand men.

translations.kjv: And straightway he constrained his disciples to get into the ship, and to go to the other side before unto Bethsaida, while he sent away the people.
translations.ylt: And immediately he constrained his disciples to go into the boat, and to go before to the other side, unto Bethsaida, till he may let the multitude away,
translations.web: Immediately he made his disciples get into the boat and go ahead to the other side, to Bethsaida, while he himself sent the multitude away.

translations.kjv: And when he had sent them away, he departed into a mountain to pray.
translations.ylt: and having taken leave of them, he went away to the mountain to pray.
translations.web: After he had taken leave of them, he went up the mountain to pray.

translations.kjv: And when even was come, the ship was in the midst of the sea, and he alone on the land.
translations.ylt: And evening having come, the boat was in the midst of the sea, and he alone upon the land;
translations.web: When evening had come, the boat was in the middle of the sea, and he was alone on the land.

translations.kjv: And he saw them toiling in rowing; for the wind was contrary unto them: and about the fourth watch of the night he cometh unto them, walking upon the sea, and would have passed by them.
translations.ylt: and he saw them harassed in the rowing, for the wind was against them, and about the fourth watch of the night he doth come to them walking on the sea, and wished to pass by them.
translations.web: Seeing them distressed in rowing, for the wind was contrary to them, about the fourth watch of the night he came to them, walking on the sea; and he would have passed by them,

translations.kjv: But when they saw him walking upon the sea, they supposed it had been a spirit, and cried out:
translations.ylt: And they having seen him walking on the sea, thought it to be an apparition, and cried out,
translations.web: but they, when they saw him walking on the sea, supposed that it was a ghost, and cried out;

translations.kjv: For they all saw him, and were troubled. And immediately he talked with them, and saith unto them, Be of good cheer: it is I; be not afraid.
translations.ylt: for they all saw him, and were troubled, and immediately he spake with them, and saith to them, `Take courage, I am he, be not afraid.'
translations.web: for they all saw him and were troubled. But he immediately spoke with them and said to them, “Cheer up! It is I! Don’t be afraid.”

translations.kjv: And he went up unto them into the ship; and the wind ceased: and they were sore amazed in themselves beyond measure, and wondered.
translations.ylt: And he went up unto them to the boat, and the wind lulled, and greatly out of measure were they amazed in themselves, and were wondering,
translations.web: He got into the boat with them; and the wind ceased, and they were very amazed among themselves, and marveled;

translations.kjv: For they considered not the miracle of the loaves: for their heart was hardened.
translations.ylt: for they understood not concerning the loaves, for their heart hath been hard.
translations.web: for they hadn’t understood about the loaves, but their hearts were hardened.

translations.kjv: And when they had passed over, they came into the land of Gennesaret, and drew to the shore.
translations.ylt: And having passed over, they came upon the land of Gennesaret, and drew to the shore,
translations.web: When they had crossed over, they came to land at Gennesaret and moored to the shore.

translations.kjv: And when they were come out of the ship, straightway they knew him,
translations.ylt: and they having come forth out of the boat, immediately having recognised him,
translations.web: When they had come out of the boat, immediately the people recognized him,

translations.kjv: And ran through that whole region round about, and began to carry about in beds those that were sick, where they heard he was.
translations.ylt: having run about through all that region round about, they began upon the couches to carry about those ill, where they were hearing that he is,
translations.web: and ran around that whole region, and began to bring those who were sick on their mats to where they heard he was.

translations.kjv: And whithersoever he entered, into villages, or cities, or country, they laid the sick in the streets, and besought him that they might touch if it were but the border of his garment: and as many as touched him were made whole.
translations.ylt: and wherever he was going, to villages, or cities, or fields, in the market-places they were laying the infirm, and were calling upon him, that they may touch if it were but the fringe of his garment, and as many as were touching him were saved.
translations.web: Wherever he entered—into villages, or into cities, or into the country—they laid the sick in the marketplaces and begged him that they might just touch the fringe of his garment; and as many as touched him were made well.

translations.kjv: Then came together unto him the Pharisees, and certain of the scribes, which came from Jerusalem.
translations.ylt: And gathered together unto him are the Pharisees, and certain of the scribes, having come from Jerusalem,
translations.web: Then the Pharisees and some of the scribes gathered together to him, having come from Jerusalem.

translations.kjv: And when they saw some of his disciples eat bread with defiled, that is to say, with unwashen, hands, they found fault.
translations.ylt: and having seen certain of his disciples with defiled hands--that is, unwashed--eating bread, they found fault;
translations.web: Now when they saw some of his disciples eating bread with defiled, that is unwashed, hands, they found fault.

translations.kjv: For the Pharisees, and all the Jews, except they wash their hands oft, eat not, holding the tradition of the elders.
translations.ylt: for the Pharisees, and all the Jews, if they do not wash the hands to the wrist, do not eat, holding the tradition of the elders,
translations.web: (For the Pharisees and all the Jews don’t eat unless they wash their hands and forearms, holding to the tradition of the elders.

translations.kjv: And when they come from the market, except they wash, they eat not. And many other things there be, which they have received to hold, as the washing of cups, and pots, brasen vessels, and of tables.
translations.ylt: and, coming from the market-place, if they do not baptize themselves, they do not eat; and many other things there are that they received to hold, baptisms of cups, and pots, and brazen vessels, and couches.
translations.web: They don’t eat when they come from the marketplace unless they bathe themselves, and there are many other things which they have received to hold to: washings of cups, pitchers, bronze vessels, and couches.)

translations.kjv: Then the Pharisees and scribes asked him, Why walk not thy disciples according to the tradition of the elders, but eat bread with unwashen hands?
translations.ylt: Then question him do the Pharisees and the scribes, `Wherefore do thy disciples not walk according to the tradition of the elders, but with unwashed hands do eat the bread?'
translations.web: The Pharisees and the scribes asked him, “Why don’t your disciples walk according to the tradition of the elders, but eat their bread with unwashed hands?”

translations.kjv: He answered and said unto them, Well hath Esaias prophesied of you hypocrites, as it is written, This people honoureth me with their lips, but their heart is far from me.
translations.ylt: and he answering said to them--`Well did Isaiah prophesy concerning you, hypocrites, as it hath been written, This people with the lips doth honour Me, and their heart is far from Me;
translations.web: He answered them, “Well did Isaiah prophesy of you hypocrites, as it is written, ‘This people honors me with their lips, but their heart is far from me.

translations.kjv: Howbeit in vain do they worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men.
translations.ylt: and in vain do they worship Me, teaching teachings, commands of men;
translations.web: They worship me in vain, teaching as doctrines the commandments of men.’

translations.kjv: For laying aside the commandment of God, ye hold the tradition of men, as the washing of pots and cups: and many other such like things ye do.
translations.ylt: for, having put away the command of God, ye hold the tradition of men, baptisms of pots and cups; and many other such like things ye do.'
translations.web: “For you set aside the commandment of God, and hold tightly to the tradition of men—the washing of pitchers and cups, and you do many other such things.”

translations.kjv: And he said unto them, Full well ye reject the commandment of God, that ye may keep your own tradition.
translations.ylt: And he said to them, `Well do ye put away the command of God that your tradition ye may keep;
translations.web: He said to them, “Full well do you reject the commandment of God, that you may keep your tradition.

translations.kjv: For Moses said, Honour thy father and thy mother; and, Whoso curseth father or mother, let him die the death:
translations.ylt: for Moses said, Honour thy father and thy mother; and, He who is speaking evil of father or mother--let him die the death;
translations.web: For Moses said, ‘Honor your father and your mother;’ and, ‘He who speaks evil of father or mother, let him be put to death.’

translations.kjv: But ye say, If a man shall say to his father or mother, It is Corban, that is to say, a gift, by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me; he shall be free.
translations.ylt: and ye say, If a man may say to father or to mother, Korban (that is, a gift), is whatever thou mayest be profited out of mine,
translations.web: But you say, ‘If a man tells his father or his mother, “Whatever profit you might have received from me is Corban,”’” that is to say, given to God,

translations.kjv: And ye suffer him no more to do ought for his father or his mother;
translations.ylt: and no more do ye suffer him to do anything for his father or for his mother,
translations.web: “then you no longer allow him to do anything for his father or his mother,

translations.kjv: Making the word of God of none effect through your tradition, which ye have delivered: and many such like things do ye.
translations.ylt: setting aside the word of God for your tradition that ye delivered; and many such like things ye do.'
translations.web: making void the word of God by your tradition which you have handed down. You do many things like this.”

translations.kjv: And when he had called all the people unto him, he said unto them, Hearken unto me every one of you, and understand:
translations.ylt: And having called near all the multitude, he said to them, `Hearken to me, ye all, and understand;
translations.web: He called all the multitude to himself and said to them, “Hear me, all of you, and understand.

translations.kjv: There is nothing from without a man, that entering into him can defile him: but the things which come out of him, those are they that defile the man.
translations.ylt: there is nothing from without the man entering into him that is able to defile him, but the things coming out from him, those are the things defiling the man.
translations.web: There is nothing from outside of the man that going into him can defile him; but the things which proceed out of the man are those that defile the man.

translations.kjv: And when he was entered into the house from the people, his disciples asked him concerning the parable.
translations.ylt: And when he entered into a house from the multitude, his disciples were questioning him about the simile,
translations.web: When he had entered into a house away from the multitude, his disciples asked him about the parable.

translations.kjv: And he saith unto them, Are ye so without understanding also? Do ye not perceive, that whatsoever thing from without entereth into the man, it cannot defile him;
translations.ylt: and he saith to them, `So also ye are without understanding! Do ye not perceive that nothing from without entering into the man is able to defile him?
translations.web: He said to them, “Are you also without understanding? Don’t you perceive that whatever goes into the man from outside can’t defile him,

translations.kjv: Because it entereth not into his heart, but into the belly, and goeth out into the draught, purging all meats?
translations.ylt: because it doth not enter into his heart, but into the belly, and into the drain it doth go out, purifying all the meats.'
translations.web: because it doesn’t go into his heart, but into his stomach, then into the latrine, making all foods clean?”

translations.kjv: And he said, That which cometh out of the man, that defileth the man.
translations.ylt: And he said--`That which is coming out from the man, that doth defile the man;
translations.web: He said, “That which proceeds out of the man, that defiles the man.

translations.kjv: For from within, out of the heart of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, fornications, murders,
translations.ylt: for from within, out of the heart of men, the evil reasonings do come forth, adulteries, whoredoms, murders,
translations.web: For from within, out of the hearts of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, sexual sins, murders, thefts,

translations.kjv: Thefts, covetousness, wickedness, deceit, lasciviousness, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, foolishness:
translations.ylt: thefts, covetous desires, wickedness, deceit, arrogance, an evil eye, evil speaking, pride, foolishness;
translations.web: covetings, wickedness, deceit, lustful desires, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, and foolishness.

translations.kjv: All these evil things come from within, and defile the man.
translations.ylt: all these evils do come forth from within, and they defile the man.'
translations.web: All these evil things come from within and defile the man.”

translations.kjv: And from thence he arose, and went into the borders of Tyre and Sidon, and entered into an house, and would have no man know it: but he could not be hid.
translations.ylt: And from thence having risen, he went away to the borders of Tyre and Sidon, and having entered into the house, he wished none to know, and he was not able to be hid,
translations.web: From there he arose and went away into the borders of Tyre and Sidon. He entered into a house and didn’t want anyone to know it, but he couldn’t escape notice.

translations.kjv: For a certain woman, whose young daughter had an unclean spirit, heard of him, and came and fell at his feet:
translations.ylt: for a woman having heard about him, whose little daughter had an unclean spirit, having come, fell at his feet, --
translations.web: For a woman whose little daughter had an unclean spirit, having heard of him, came and fell down at his feet.

translations.kjv: The woman was a Greek, a Syrophenician by nation; and she besought him that he would cast forth the devil out of her daughter.
translations.ylt: and the woman was a Greek, a Syro-Phenician by nation--and was asking him, that the demon he may cast forth out of her daughter.
translations.web: Now the woman was a Greek, a Syrophoenician by race. She begged him that he would cast the demon out of her daughter.

translations.kjv: But Jesus said unto her, Let the children first be filled: for it is not meet to take the children’s bread, and to cast it unto the dogs.
translations.ylt: And Jesus said to her, `Suffer first the children to be filled, for it is not good to take the children's bread, and to cast it to the little dogs.'
translations.web: But Jesus said to her, “Let the children be filled first, for it is not appropriate to take the children’s bread and throw it to the dogs.”

translations.kjv: And she answered and said unto him, Yes, Lord: yet the dogs under the table eat of the children’s crumbs.
translations.ylt: And she answered and saith to him, `Yes, sir; for the little dogs also under the table do eat of the children's crumbs.'
translations.web: But she answered him, “Yes, Lord. Yet even the dogs under the table eat the children’s crumbs.”

translations.kjv: And he said unto her, For this saying go thy way; the devil is gone out of thy daughter.
translations.ylt: And he said to her, `Because of this word go; the demon hath gone forth out of thy daughter;'
translations.web: He said to her, “For this saying, go your way. The demon has gone out of your daughter.”

translations.kjv: And when she was come to her house, she found the devil gone out, and her daughter laid upon the bed.
translations.ylt: and having come away to her house, she found the demon gone forth, and the daughter laid upon the couch.
translations.web: She went away to her house, and found the child having been laid on the bed, with the demon gone out.

translations.kjv: And again, departing from the coasts of Tyre and Sidon, he came unto the sea of Galilee, through the midst of the coasts of Decapolis.
translations.ylt: And again, having gone forth from the coasts of Tyre and Sidon, he came unto the sea of Galilee, through the midst of the coasts of Decapolis,
translations.web: Again he departed from the borders of Tyre and Sidon, and came to the sea of Galilee through the middle of the region of Decapolis.

translations.kjv: And they bring unto him one that was deaf, and had an impediment in his speech; and they beseech him to put his hand upon him.
translations.ylt: and they bring to him a deaf, stuttering man, and they call on him that he may put the hand on him.
translations.web: They brought to him one who was deaf and had an impediment in his speech. They begged him to lay his hand on him.

translations.kjv: And he took him aside from the multitude, and put his fingers into his ears, and he spit, and touched his tongue;
translations.ylt: And having taken him away from the multitude by himself, he put his fingers to his ears, and having spit, he touched his tongue,
translations.web: He took him aside from the multitude privately and put his fingers into his ears; and he spat and touched his tongue.

translations.kjv: And looking up to heaven, he sighed, and saith unto him, Ephphatha, that is, Be opened.
translations.ylt: and having looked to the heaven, he sighed, and saith to him, `Ephphatha,' that is, `Be thou opened;'
translations.web: Looking up to heaven, he sighed, and said to him, “Ephphatha!” that is, “Be opened!”

translations.kjv: And straightway his ears were opened, and the string of his tongue was loosed, and he spake plain.
translations.ylt: and immediately were his ears opened, and the string of his tongue was loosed, and he was speaking plain.
translations.web: Immediately his ears were opened, and the impediment of his tongue was released, and he spoke clearly.

translations.kjv: And he charged them that they should tell no man: but the more he charged them, so much the more a great deal they published it;
translations.ylt: And he charged them that they may tell no one, but the more he was charging them, the more abundantly they were proclaiming it,
translations.web: He commanded them that they should tell no one, but the more he commanded them, so much the more widely they proclaimed it.

translations.kjv: And were beyond measure astonished, saying, He hath done all things well: he maketh both the deaf to hear, and the dumb to speak.
translations.ylt: and they were being beyond measure astonished, saying, `Well hath he done all things; both the deaf he doth make to hear, and the dumb to speak.'
translations.web: They were astonished beyond measure, saying, “He has done all things well. He makes even the deaf hear and the mute speak!”

translations.kjv: In those days the multitude being very great, and having nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples unto him, and saith unto them,
translations.ylt: In those days the multitude being very great, and not having what they may eat, Jesus having called near his disciples, saith to them,
translations.web: In those days, when there was a very great multitude, and they had nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples to himself and said to them,

translations.kjv: I have compassion on the multitude, because they have now been with me three days, and have nothing to eat:
translations.ylt: `I have compassion upon the multitude, because now three days they do continue with me, and they have not what they may eat;
translations.web: “I have compassion on the multitude, because they have stayed with me now three days and have nothing to eat.

translations.kjv: And if I send them away fasting to their own houses, they will faint by the way: for divers of them came from far.
translations.ylt: and if I shall let them away fasting to their home, they will faint in the way, for certain of them are come from far.'
translations.web: If I send them away fasting to their home, they will faint on the way, for some of them have come a long way.”

translations.kjv: And his disciples answered him, From whence can a man satisfy these men with bread here in the wilderness?
translations.ylt: And his disciples answered him, `Whence shall any one be able these here to feed with bread in a wilderness?'
translations.web: His disciples answered him, “From where could one satisfy these people with bread here in a deserted place?”

translations.kjv: And he asked them, How many loaves have ye? And they said, Seven.
translations.ylt: And he was questioning them, `How many loaves have ye?' and they said, `Seven.'
translations.web: He asked them, “How many loaves do you have?” They said, “Seven.”

translations.kjv: And he commanded the people to sit down on the ground: and he took the seven loaves, and gave thanks, and brake, and gave to his disciples to set before them; and they did set them before the people.
translations.ylt: And he commanded the multitude to sit down upon the ground, and having taken the seven loaves, having given thanks, he brake, and was giving to his disciples that they may set before them; and they did set before the multitude.
translations.web: He commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground, and he took the seven loaves. Having given thanks, he broke them and gave them to his disciples to serve, and they served the multitude.

translations.kjv: And they had a few small fishes: and he blessed, and commanded to set them also before them.
translations.ylt: And they had a few small fishes, and having blessed, he said to set them also before them;
translations.web: They also had a few small fish. Having blessed them, he said to serve these also.

translations.kjv: So they did eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets.
translations.ylt: and they did eat and were filled, and they took up that which was over of broken pieces--seven baskets;
translations.web: They ate and were filled. They took up seven baskets of broken pieces that were left over.

translations.kjv: And they that had eaten were about four thousand: and he sent them away.
translations.ylt: and those eating were about four thousand. And he let them away,
translations.web: Those who had eaten were about four thousand. Then he sent them away.

translations.kjv: And straightway he entered into a ship with his disciples, and came into the parts of Dalmanutha.
translations.ylt: and immediately having entered into the boat with his disciples, he came to the parts of Dalmanutha,
translations.web: Immediately he entered into the boat with his disciples and came into the region of Dalmanutha.

translations.kjv: And the Pharisees came forth, and began to question with him, seeking of him a sign from heaven, tempting him.
translations.ylt: and the Pharisees came forth, and began to dispute with him, seeking from him a sign from the heaven, tempting him;
translations.web: The Pharisees came out and began to question him, seeking from him a sign from heaven and testing him.

translations.kjv: And he sighed deeply in his spirit, and saith, Why doth this generation seek after a sign? verily I say unto you, There shall no sign be given unto this generation.
translations.ylt: and having sighed deeply in his spirit, he saith, `Why doth this generation seek after a sign? Verily I say to you, no sign shall be given to this generation.'
translations.web: He sighed deeply in his spirit and said, “Why does this generation seek a sign? Most certainly I tell you, no sign will be given to this generation.”

translations.kjv: And he left them, and entering into the ship again departed to the other side.
translations.ylt: And having left them, having entered again into the boat, he went away to the other side;
translations.web: He left them, and again entering into the boat, departed to the other side.

translations.kjv: Now the disciples had forgotten to take bread, neither had they in the ship with them more than one loaf.
translations.ylt: and they forgot to take loaves, and except one loaf they had nothing with them in the boat,
translations.web: They forgot to take bread; and they didn’t have more than one loaf in the boat with them.

translations.kjv: And he charged them, saying, Take heed, beware of the leaven of the Pharisees, and of the leaven of Herod.
translations.ylt: and he was charging them, saying, `Take heed, beware of the leaven of the Pharisees, and of the leaven of Herod,'
translations.web: He warned them, saying, “Take heed: beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and the yeast of Herod.”

translations.kjv: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, It is because we have no bread.
translations.ylt: and they were reasoning with one another, saying--`Because we have no loaves.'
translations.web: They reasoned with one another, saying, “It’s because we have no bread.”

translations.kjv: And when Jesus knew it, he saith unto them, Why reason ye, because ye have no bread? perceive ye not yet, neither understand? have ye your heart yet hardened?
translations.ylt: And Jesus having known, saith to them, `Why do ye reason, because ye have no loaves? do ye not yet perceive, nor understand, yet have ye your heart hardened?
translations.web: Jesus, perceiving it, said to them, “Why do you reason that it’s because you have no bread? Don’t you perceive yet or understand? Is your heart still hardened?

translations.kjv: Having eyes, see ye not? and having ears, hear ye not? and do ye not remember?
translations.ylt: Having eyes, do ye not see? and having ears, do ye not hear? and do ye not remember?
translations.web: Having eyes, don’t you see? Having ears, don’t you hear? Don’t you remember?

translations.kjv: When I brake the five loaves among five thousand, how many baskets full of fragments took ye up? They say unto him, Twelve.
translations.ylt: When the five loaves I did brake to the five thousand, how many hand-baskets full of broken pieces took ye up?' they say to him, `Twelve.'
translations.web: When I broke the five loaves among the five thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up?” They told him, “Twelve.”

translations.kjv: And when the seven among four thousand, how many baskets full of fragments took ye up? And they said, Seven.
translations.ylt: `And when the seven to the four thousand, how many hand-baskets full of broken pieces took ye up?' and they said, `Seven.'
translations.web: “When the seven loaves fed the four thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up?” They told him, “Seven.”

translations.kjv: And he said unto them, How is it that ye do not understand?
translations.ylt: And he said to them, `How do ye not understand?'
translations.web: He asked them, “Don’t you understand yet?”

translations.kjv: And he cometh to Bethsaida; and they bring a blind man unto him, and besought him to touch him.
translations.ylt: And he cometh to Bethsaida, and they bring to him one blind, and call upon him that he may touch him,
translations.web: He came to Bethsaida. They brought a blind man to him and begged him to touch him.

translations.kjv: And he took the blind man by the hand, and led him out of the town; and when he had spit on his eyes, and put his hands upon him, he asked him if he saw ought.
translations.ylt: and having taken the hand of the blind man, he led him forth without the village, and having spit on his eyes, having put his hands on him, he was questioning him if he doth behold anything:
translations.web: He took hold of the blind man by the hand, and brought him out of the village. When he had spat on his eyes, and laid his hands on him, he asked him if he saw anything.

translations.kjv: And he looked up, and said, I see men as trees, walking.
translations.ylt: and he, having looked up, said, `I behold men, as I see trees, walking.'
translations.web: He looked up, and said, “I see men, but I see them like walking trees.”

translations.kjv: After that he put his hands again upon his eyes, and made him look up: and he was restored, and saw every man clearly.
translations.ylt: Afterwards again he put his hands on his eyes, and made him look up, and he was restored, and discerned all things clearly,
translations.web: Then again he laid his hands on his eyes. He looked intently, and was restored, and saw everyone clearly.

translations.kjv: And he sent him away to his house, saying, Neither go into the town, nor tell it to any in the town.
translations.ylt: and he sent him away to his house, saying, `Neither to the village mayest thou go, nor tell it to any in the village.'
translations.web: He sent him away to his house, saying, “Don’t enter into the village, nor tell anyone in the village.”

translations.kjv: And Jesus went out, and his disciples, into the towns of Cesarea Philippi: and by the way he asked his disciples, saying unto them, Whom do men say that I am?
translations.ylt: And Jesus went forth, and his disciples, to the villages of Caesarea Philippi, and in the way he was questioning his disciples, saying to them, `Who do men say me to be?'
translations.web: Jesus went out, with his disciples, into the villages of Caesarea Philippi. On the way he asked his disciples, “Who do men say that I am?”

translations.kjv: And they answered, John the Baptist: but some say, Elias; and others, One of the prophets.
translations.ylt: And they answered, `John the Baptist, and others Elijah, but others one of the prophets.'
translations.web: They told him, “John the Baptizer, and others say Elijah, but others, one of the prophets.”

translations.kjv: And he saith unto them, But whom say ye that I am? And Peter answereth and saith unto him, Thou art the Christ.
translations.ylt: And he saith to them, `And ye--who do ye say me to be?' and Peter answering saith to him, `Thou art the Christ.'
translations.web: He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?” Peter answered, “You are the Christ.”

translations.kjv: And he charged them that they should tell no man of him.
translations.ylt: And he strictly charged them that they may tell no one about it,
translations.web: He commanded them that they should tell no one about him.

translations.kjv: And he began to teach them, that the Son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected of the elders, and of the chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.
translations.ylt: and began to teach them, that it behoveth the Son of Man to suffer many things, and to be rejected by the elders, and chief priests, and scribes, and to be killed, and after three days to rise again;
translations.web: He began to teach them that the Son of Man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders, the chief priests, and the scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.

translations.kjv: And he spake that saying openly. And Peter took him, and began to rebuke him.
translations.ylt: and openly he was speaking the word. And Peter having taken him aside, began to rebuke him,
translations.web: He spoke to them openly. Peter took him and began to rebuke him.

translations.kjv: But when he had turned about and looked on his disciples, he rebuked Peter, saying, Get thee behind me, Satan: for thou savourest not the things that be of God, but the things that be of men.
translations.ylt: and he, having turned, and having looked on his disciples, rebuked Peter, saying, `Get behind me, Adversary, because thou dost not mind the things of God, but the things of men.'
translations.web: But he, turning around and seeing his disciples, rebuked Peter, and said, “Get behind me, Satan! For you have in mind not the things of God, but the things of men.”

translations.kjv: And when he had called the people unto him with his disciples also, he said unto them, Whosoever will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
translations.ylt: And having called near the multitude, with his disciples, he said to them, `Whoever doth will to come after me--let him disown himself, and take up his cross, and follow me;
translations.web: He called the multitude to himself with his disciples and said to them, “Whoever wants to come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.

translations.kjv: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it; but whosoever shall lose his life for my sake and the gospel’s, the same shall save it.
translations.ylt: for whoever may will to save his life shall lose it; and whoever may lose his life for my sake and for the good news' sake, he shall save it;
translations.web: For whoever wants to save his life will lose it; and whoever will lose his life for my sake and the sake of the Good News will save it.

translations.kjv: For what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul?
translations.ylt: for what shall it profit a man, if he may gain the whole world, and forfeit his life?
translations.web: For what does it profit a man to gain the whole world and forfeit his life?

translations.kjv: Or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?
translations.ylt: Or what shall a man give as an exchange for his life?
translations.web: For what will a man give in exchange for his life?

translations.kjv: Whosoever therefore shall be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation; of him also shall the Son of man be ashamed, when he cometh in the glory of his Father with the holy angels.
translations.ylt: for whoever may be ashamed of me, and of my words, in this adulterous and sinful generation, the Son of Man also shall be ashamed of him, when he may come in the glory of his Father, with the holy messengers.'
translations.web: For whoever will be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the Son of Man also will be ashamed of him when he comes in his Father’s glory with the holy angels.”

translations.kjv: And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That there be some of them that stand here, which shall not taste of death, till they have seen the kingdom of God come with power.
translations.ylt: And he said to them, `Verily I say to you, That there are certain of those standing here, who may not taste of death till they see the reign of God having come in power.'
translations.web: He said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, there are some standing here who will in no way taste death until they see God’s Kingdom come with power.”

translations.kjv: And after six days Jesus taketh with him Peter, and James, and John, and leadeth them up into an high mountain apart by themselves: and he was transfigured before them.
translations.ylt: And after six days doth Jesus take Peter, and James, and John, and bringeth them up to a high mount by themselves, alone, and he was transfigured before them,
translations.web: After six days Jesus took with him Peter, James, and John, and brought them up onto a high mountain privately by themselves, and he was changed into another form in front of them.

translations.kjv: And his raiment became shining, exceeding white as snow; so as no fuller on earth can white them.
translations.ylt: and his garments became glittering, white exceedingly, as snow, so as a fuller upon the earth is not able to whiten them.
translations.web: His clothing became glistening, exceedingly white, like snow, such as no launderer on earth can whiten them.

translations.kjv: And there appeared unto them Elias with Moses: and they were talking with Jesus.
translations.ylt: And there appeared to them Elijah with Moses, and they were talking with Jesus.
translations.web: Elijah and Moses appeared to them, and they were talking with Jesus.

translations.kjv: And Peter answered and said to Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.
translations.ylt: And Peter answering saith to Jesus, `Rabbi, it is good to us to be here; and we may make three booths, for thee one, and for Moses one, and for Elijah one:'
translations.web: Peter answered Jesus, “Rabbi, it is good for us to be here. Let’s make three tents: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”

translations.kjv: For he wist not what to say; for they were sore afraid.
translations.ylt: for he was not knowing what he might say, for they were greatly afraid.
translations.web: For he didn’t know what to say, for they were very afraid.

translations.kjv: And there was a cloud that overshadowed them: and a voice came out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son: hear him.
translations.ylt: And there came a cloud overshadowing them, and there came a voice out of the cloud, saying, `This is My Son--the Beloved, hear ye him;'
translations.web: A cloud came, overshadowing them, and a voice came out of the cloud, “This is my beloved Son. Listen to him.”

translations.kjv: And suddenly, when they had looked round about, they saw no man any more, save Jesus only with themselves.
translations.ylt: and suddenly, having looked around, they saw no one any more, but Jesus only with themselves.
translations.web: Suddenly looking around, they saw no one with them any more, except Jesus only.

translations.kjv: And as they came down from the mountain, he charged them that they should tell no man what things they had seen, till the Son of man were risen from the dead.
translations.ylt: And as they are coming down from the mount, he charged them that they may declare to no one the things that they saw, except when the Son of Man may rise out of the dead;
translations.web: As they were coming down from the mountain, he commanded them that they should tell no one what things they had seen, until after the Son of Man had risen from the dead.

translations.kjv: And they kept that saying with themselves, questioning one with another what the rising from the dead should mean.
translations.ylt: and the thing they kept to themselves, questioning together what the rising out of the dead is.
translations.web: They kept this saying to themselves, questioning what the “rising from the dead” meant.

translations.kjv: And they asked him, saying, Why say the scribes that Elias must first come?
translations.ylt: And they were questioning him, saying, that the scribes say that Elijah it behoveth to come first.
translations.web: They asked him, saying, “Why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?”

translations.kjv: And he answered and told them, Elias verily cometh first, and restoreth all things; and how it is written of the Son of man, that he must suffer many things, and be set at nought.
translations.ylt: And he answering said to them, `Elijah indeed, having come first, doth restore all things; and how hath it been written concerning the Son of Man, that many things he may suffer, and be set at nought?
translations.web: He said to them, “Elijah indeed comes first, and restores all things. How is it written about the Son of Man, that he should suffer many things and be despised?

translations.kjv: But I say unto you, That Elias is indeed come, and they have done unto him whatsoever they listed, as it is written of him.
translations.ylt: But I say to you, That also Elijah hath come, and they did to him what they willed, as it hath been written of him.'
translations.web: But I tell you that Elijah has come, and they have also done to him whatever they wanted to, even as it is written about him.”

translations.kjv: And when he came to his disciples, he saw a great multitude about them, and the scribes questioning with them.
translations.ylt: And having come unto the disciples, he saw a great multitude about them, and scribes questioning with them,
translations.web: Coming to the disciples, he saw a great multitude around them, and scribes questioning them.

translations.kjv: And straightway all the people, when they beheld him, were greatly amazed, and running to him saluted him.
translations.ylt: and immediately, all the multitude having seen him, were amazed, and running near, were saluting him.
translations.web: Immediately all the multitude, when they saw him, were greatly amazed, and running to him, greeted him.

translations.kjv: And he asked the scribes, What question ye with them?
translations.ylt: And he questioned the scribes, `What dispute ye with them?'
translations.web: He asked the scribes, “What are you asking them?”

translations.kjv: And one of the multitude answered and said, Master, I have brought unto thee my son, which hath a dumb spirit;
translations.ylt: and one out of the multitude answering said, `Teacher, I brought my son unto thee, having a dumb spirit;
translations.web: One of the multitude answered, “Teacher, I brought to you my son, who has a mute spirit;

translations.kjv: And wheresoever he taketh him, he teareth him: and he foameth, and gnasheth with his teeth, and pineth away: and I spake to thy disciples that they should cast him out; and they could not.
translations.ylt: and wherever it doth seize him, it doth tear him, and he foameth, and gnasheth his teeth, and pineth away; and I spake to thy disciples that they may cast it out, and they were not able.'
translations.web: and wherever it seizes him, it throws him down; and he foams at the mouth, grinds his teeth, and becomes rigid. I asked your disciples to cast it out, and they weren’t able.”

translations.kjv: He answereth him, and saith, O faithless generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him unto me.
translations.ylt: And he answering him, said, `O generation unbelieving, till when shall I be with you? till when shall I suffer you? bring him unto me;'
translations.web: He answered him, “Unbelieving generation, how long shall I be with you? How long shall I bear with you? Bring him to me.”

translations.kjv: And they brought him unto him: and when he saw him, straightway the spirit tare him; and he fell on the ground, and wallowed foaming.
translations.ylt: and they brought him unto him, and he having seen him, immediately the spirit tare him, and he, having fallen upon the earth, was wallowing--foaming.
translations.web: They brought him to him, and when he saw him, immediately the spirit convulsed him and he fell on the ground, wallowing and foaming at the mouth.

translations.kjv: And he asked his father, How long is it ago since this came unto him? And he said, Of a child.
translations.ylt: And he questioned his father, `How long time is it since this came to him?' and he said, `From childhood,
translations.web: He asked his father, “How long has it been since this has been happening to him?” He said, “From childhood.

translations.kjv: And ofttimes it hath cast him into the fire, and into the waters, to destroy him: but if thou canst do any thing, have compassion on us, and help us.
translations.ylt: and many times also it cast him into fire, and into water, that it might destroy him; but if thou art able to do anything, help us, having compassion on us.'
translations.web: Often it has cast him both into the fire and into the water to destroy him. But if you can do anything, have compassion on us and help us.”

translations.kjv: Jesus said unto him, If thou canst believe, all things are possible to him that believeth.
translations.ylt: And Jesus said to him, `If thou art able to believe! all things are possible to the one that is believing;'
translations.web: Jesus said to him, “If you can believe, all things are possible to him who believes.”

translations.kjv: And straightway the father of the child cried out, and said with tears, Lord, I believe; help thou mine unbelief.
translations.ylt: and immediately the father of the child, having cried out, with tears said, `I believe, sir; be helping mine unbelief.'
translations.web: Immediately the father of the child cried out with tears, “I believe. Help my unbelief!”

translations.kjv: When Jesus saw that the people came running together, he rebuked the foul spirit, saying unto him, Thou dumb and deaf spirit, I charge thee, come out of him, and enter no more into him.
translations.ylt: Jesus having seen that a multitude doth run together, rebuked the unclean spirit, saying to it, `Spirit--dumb and deaf--I charge thee, come forth out of him, and no more thou mayest enter into him;'
translations.web: When Jesus saw that a multitude came running together, he rebuked the unclean spirit, saying to him, “You mute and deaf spirit, I command you, come out of him, and never enter him again!”

translations.kjv: And the spirit cried, and rent him sore, and came out of him: and he was as one dead; insomuch that many said, He is dead.
translations.ylt: and having cried, and rent him much, it came forth, and he became as dead, so that many said that he was dead,
translations.web: After crying out and convulsing him greatly, it came out of him. The boy became like one dead, so much that most of them said, “He is dead.”

translations.kjv: But Jesus took him by the hand, and lifted him up; and he arose.
translations.ylt: but Jesus, having taken him by the hand, lifted him up, and he arose.
translations.web: But Jesus took him by the hand and raised him up; and he arose.

translations.kjv: And when he was come into the house, his disciples asked him privately, Why could not we cast him out?
translations.ylt: And he having come into the house, his disciples were questioning him by himself--`Why were we not able to cast it forth?'
translations.web: When he had come into the house, his disciples asked him privately, “Why couldn’t we cast it out?”

translations.kjv: And he said unto them, This kind can come forth by nothing, but by prayer and fasting.
translations.ylt: And he said to them, `This kind is able to come forth with nothing except with prayer and fasting.'
translations.web: He said to them, “This kind can come out by nothing but by prayer and fasting.”

translations.kjv: And they departed thence, and passed through Galilee; and he would not that any man should know it.
translations.ylt: And having gone forth thence, they were passing through Galilee, and he did not wish that any may know,
translations.web: They went out from there and passed through Galilee. He didn’t want anyone to know it,

translations.kjv: For he taught his disciples, and said unto them, The Son of man is delivered into the hands of men, and they shall kill him; and after that he is killed, he shall rise the third day.
translations.ylt: for he was teaching his disciples, and he said to them, `The Son of Man is being delivered to the hands of men, and they shall kill him, and having been killed the third day he shall rise,'
translations.web: for he was teaching his disciples, and said to them, “The Son of Man is being handed over to the hands of men, and they will kill him; and when he is killed, on the third day he will rise again.”

translations.kjv: But they understood not that saying, and were afraid to ask him.
translations.ylt: but they were not understanding the saying, and they were afraid to question him.
translations.web: But they didn’t understand the saying, and were afraid to ask him.

translations.kjv: And he came to Capernaum: and being in the house he asked them, What was it that ye disputed among yourselves by the way?
translations.ylt: And he came to Capernaum, and being in the house, he was questioning them, `What were ye reasoning in the way among yourselves?'
translations.web: He came to Capernaum, and when he was in the house he asked them, “What were you arguing among yourselves on the way?”

translations.kjv: But they held their peace: for by the way they had disputed among themselves, who should be the greatest.
translations.ylt: and they were silent, for with one another they did reason in the way who is greater;
translations.web: But they were silent, for they had disputed with one another on the way about who was the greatest.

translations.kjv: And he sat down, and called the twelve, and saith unto them, If any man desire to be first, the same shall be last of all, and servant of all.
translations.ylt: and having sat down he called the twelve, and he saith to them, `If any doth will to be first, he shall be last of all, and minister of all.'
translations.web: He sat down and called the twelve; and he said to them, “If any man wants to be first, he shall be last of all, and servant of all.”

translations.kjv: And he took a child, and set him in the midst of them: and when he had taken him in his arms, he said unto them,
translations.ylt: And having taken a child, he set him in the midst of them, and having taken him in his arms, said to them,
translations.web: He took a little child and set him in the middle of them. Taking him in his arms, he said to them,

translations.kjv: Whosoever shall receive one of such children in my name, receiveth me: and whosoever shall receive me, receiveth not me, but him that sent me.
translations.ylt: `Whoever may receive one of such children in my name, doth receive me, and whoever may receive me, doth not receive me, but Him who sent me.'
translations.web: “Whoever receives one such little child in my name receives me; and whoever receives me, doesn’t receive me, but him who sent me.”

translations.kjv: And John answered him, saying, Master, we saw one casting out devils in thy name, and he followeth not us: and we forbad him, because he followeth not us.
translations.ylt: And John did answer him, saying, `Teacher, we saw a certain one in thy name casting out demons, who doth not follow us, and we forbade him, because he doth not follow us.'
translations.web: John said to him, “Teacher, we saw someone who doesn’t follow us casting out demons in your name; and we forbade him, because he doesn’t follow us.”

translations.kjv: But Jesus said, Forbid him not: for there is no man which shall do a miracle in my name, that can lightly speak evil of me.
translations.ylt: And Jesus said, `Forbid him not, for there is no one who shall do a mighty work in my name, and shall be able readily to speak evil of me:
translations.web: But Jesus said, “Don’t forbid him, for there is no one who will do a mighty work in my name and be able quickly to speak evil of me.

translations.kjv: For he that is not against us is on our part.
translations.ylt: for he who is not against us is for us;
translations.web: For whoever is not against us is on our side.

translations.kjv: For whosoever shall give you a cup of water to drink in my name, because ye belong to Christ, verily I say unto you, he shall not lose his reward.
translations.ylt: for whoever may give you to drink a cup of water in my name, because ye are Christ's, verily I say to you, he may not lose his reward;
translations.web: For whoever will give you a cup of water to drink in my name because you are Christ’s, most certainly I tell you, he will in no way lose his reward.

translations.kjv: And whosoever shall offend one of these little ones that believe in me, it is better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and he were cast into the sea.
translations.ylt: and whoever may cause to stumble one of the little ones believing in me, better is it for him if a millstone is hanged about his neck, and he hath been cast into the sea.
translations.web: “Whoever will cause one of these little ones who believe in me to stumble, it would be better for him if he were thrown into the sea with a millstone hung around his neck.

translations.kjv: And if thy hand offend thee, cut it off: it is better for thee to enter into life maimed, than having two hands to go into hell, into the fire that never shall be quenched:
translations.ylt: `And if thy hand may cause thee to stumble, cut it off; it is better for thee maimed to enter into the life, than having the two hands, to go away to the gehenna, to the fire--the unquenchable--
translations.web: If your hand causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is better for you to enter into life maimed, rather than having your two hands to go into Gehenna, into the unquenchable fire,

translations.kjv: And if thy foot offend thee, cut it off: it is better for thee to enter halt into life, than having two feet to be cast into hell, into the fire that never shall be quenched:
translations.ylt: `And if thy foot may cause thee to stumble, cut it off; it is better for thee to enter into the life lame, than having the two feet to be cast to the gehenna, to the fire--the unquenchable--
translations.web: If your foot causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is better for you to enter into life lame, rather than having your two feet to be cast into Gehenna, into the fire that will never be quenched—

translations.kjv: And if thine eye offend thee, pluck it out: it is better for thee to enter into the kingdom of God with one eye, than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire:
translations.ylt: And if thine eye may cause thee to stumble, cast it out; it is better for thee one-eyed to enter into the reign of God, than having two eyes, to be cast to the gehenna of the fire--
translations.web: If your eye causes you to stumble, throw it out. It is better for you to enter into God’s Kingdom with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into the Gehenna of fire,

translations.kjv: Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.
translations.ylt: where their worm is not dying, and the fire is not being quenched;
translations.web: ‘where their worm doesn’t die, and the fire is not quenched.’

translations.kjv: For every one shall be salted with fire, and every sacrifice shall be salted with salt.
translations.ylt: for every one with fire shall be salted, and every sacrifice with salt shall be salted.
translations.web: For everyone will be salted with fire, and every sacrifice will be seasoned with salt.

translations.kjv: Salt is good: but if the salt have lost his saltness, wherewith will ye season it? Have salt in yourselves, and have peace one with another.
translations.ylt: The salt is good, but if the salt may become saltless, in what will ye season it? Have in yourselves salt, and have peace in one another.'
translations.web: Salt is good, but if the salt has lost its saltiness, with what will you season it? Have salt in yourselves, and be at peace with one another.”

translations.kjv: And he arose from thence, and cometh into the coasts of Judea by the farther side of Jordan: and the people resort unto him again; and, as he was wont, he taught them again.
translations.ylt: And having risen thence, he doth come to the coasts of Judea, through the other side of the Jordan, and again do multitudes come together unto him, and, as he had been accustomed, again he was teaching them.
translations.web: He arose from there and came into the borders of Judea and beyond the Jordan. Multitudes came together to him again. As he usually did, he was again teaching them.

translations.kjv: And the Pharisees came to him, and asked him, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife? tempting him.
translations.ylt: And the Pharisees, having come near, questioned him, if it is lawful for a husband to put away a wife, tempting him,
translations.web: Pharisees came to him testing him, and asked him, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife?”

translations.kjv: And he answered and said unto them, What did Moses command you?
translations.ylt: and he answering said to them, `What did Moses command you?'
translations.web: He answered, “What did Moses command you?”

translations.kjv: And they said, Moses suffered to write a bill of divorcement, and to put her away.
translations.ylt: and they said, `Moses suffered to write a bill of divorce, and to put away.'
translations.web: They said, “Moses allowed a certificate of divorce to be written, and to divorce her.”

translations.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto them, For the hardness of your heart he wrote you this precept.
translations.ylt: And Jesus answering said to them, `For the stiffness of your heart he wrote you this command,
translations.web: But Jesus said to them, “For your hardness of heart, he wrote you this commandment.

translations.kjv: But from the beginning of the creation God made them male and female.
translations.ylt: but from the beginning of the creation, a male and a female God did make them;
translations.web: But from the beginning of the creation, God made them male and female.

translations.kjv: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and cleave to his wife;
translations.ylt: on this account shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall cleave unto his wife,
translations.web: For this cause a man will leave his father and mother, and will join to his wife,

translations.kjv: And they twain shall be one flesh: so then they are no more twain, but one flesh.
translations.ylt: and they shall be--the two--for one flesh; so that they are no more two, but one flesh;
translations.web: and the two will become one flesh, so that they are no longer two, but one flesh.

translations.kjv: What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.
translations.ylt: what therefore God did join together, let not man put asunder.'
translations.web: What therefore God has joined together, let no man separate.”

translations.kjv: And in the house his disciples asked him again of the same matter.
translations.ylt: And in the house again his disciples of the same thing questioned him,
translations.web: In the house, his disciples asked him again about the same matter.

translations.kjv: And he saith unto them, Whosoever shall put away his wife, and marry another, committeth adultery against her.
translations.ylt: and he saith to them, `Whoever may put away his wife, and may marry another, doth commit adultery against her;
translations.web: He said to them, “Whoever divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery against her.

translations.kjv: And if a woman shall put away her husband, and be married to another, she committeth adultery.
translations.ylt: and if a woman may put away her husband, and is married to another, she committeth adultery.'
translations.web: If a woman herself divorces her husband and marries another, she commits adultery.”

translations.kjv: And they brought young children to him, that he should touch them: and his disciples rebuked those that brought them.
translations.ylt: And they were bringing to him children, that he might touch them, and the disciples were rebuking those bringing them,
translations.web: They were bringing to him little children, that he should touch them, but the disciples rebuked those who were bringing them.

translations.kjv: But when Jesus saw it, he was much displeased, and said unto them, Suffer the little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.
translations.ylt: and Jesus having seen, was much displeased, and he said to them, `Suffer the children to come unto me, and forbid them not, for of such is the reign of God;
translations.web: But when Jesus saw it, he was moved with indignation and said to them, “Allow the little children to come to me! Don’t forbid them, for God’s Kingdom belongs to such as these.

translations.kjv: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child, he shall not enter therein.
translations.ylt: verily I say to you, whoever may not receive the reign of God, as a child--he may not enter into it;'
translations.web: Most certainly I tell you, whoever will not receive God’s Kingdom like a little child, he will in no way enter into it.”

translations.kjv: And he took them up in his arms, put his hands upon them, and blessed them.
translations.ylt: and having taken them in his arms, having put his hands upon them, he was blessing them.
translations.web: He took them in his arms and blessed them, laying his hands on them.

translations.kjv: And when he was gone forth into the way, there came one running, and kneeled to him, and asked him, Good Master, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?
translations.ylt: And as he is going forth into the way, one having run and having kneeled to him, was questioning him, `Good teacher, what may I do, that life age-during I may inherit?'
translations.web: As he was going out into the way, one ran to him, knelt before him, and asked him, “Good Teacher, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?”

translations.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? there is none good but one, that is, God.
translations.ylt: And Jesus said to him, `Why me dost thou call good? no one is good except One--God;
translations.web: Jesus said to him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good except one—God.

translations.kjv: Thou knowest the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Defraud not, Honour thy father and mother.
translations.ylt: the commands thou hast known: Thou mayest not commit adultery, Thou mayest do no murder, Thou mayest not steal, Thou mayest not bear false witness, Thou mayest not defraud, Honour thy father and mother.'
translations.web: You know the commandments: ‘Do not murder,’ ‘Do not commit adultery,’ ‘Do not steal,’ ‘Do not give false testimony,’ ‘Do not defraud,’ ‘Honor your father and mother.’”

translations.kjv: And he answered and said unto him, Master, all these have I observed from my youth.
translations.ylt: And he answering said to him, `Teacher, all these did I keep from my youth.'
translations.web: He said to him, “Teacher, I have observed all these things from my youth.”

translations.kjv: Then Jesus beholding him loved him, and said unto him, One thing thou lackest: go thy way, sell whatsoever thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, take up the cross, and follow me.
translations.ylt: And Jesus having looked upon him, did love him, and said to him, `One thing thou dost lack; go away, whatever thou hast--sell, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven, and come, be following me, having taken up the cross.'
translations.web: Jesus looking at him loved him, and said to him, “One thing you lack. Go, sell whatever you have and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow me, taking up the cross.”

translations.kjv: And he was sad at that saying, and went away grieved: for he had great possessions.
translations.ylt: And he--gloomy at the word--went away sorrowing, for he was having many possessions.
translations.web: But his face fell at that saying, and he went away sorrowful, for he was one who had great possessions.

translations.kjv: And Jesus looked round about, and saith unto his disciples, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!
translations.ylt: And Jesus having looked round, saith to his disciples, `How hardly shall they who have riches enter into the reign of God!'
translations.web: Jesus looked around and said to his disciples, “How difficult it is for those who have riches to enter into God’s Kingdom!”

translations.kjv: And the disciples were astonished at his words. But Jesus answereth again, and saith unto them, Children, how hard is it for them that trust in riches to enter into the kingdom of God!
translations.ylt: And the disciples were astonished at his words, and Jesus again answering saith to them, `Children, how hard is it to those trusting on the riches to enter into the reign of God!
translations.web: The disciples were amazed at his words. But Jesus answered again, “Children, how hard it is for those who trust in riches to enter into God’s Kingdom!

translations.kjv: It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.
translations.ylt: It is easier for a camel through the eye of the needle to enter, than for a rich man to enter into the reign of God.'
translations.web: It is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.”

translations.kjv: And they were astonished out of measure, saying among themselves, Who then can be saved?
translations.ylt: And they were astonished beyond measure, saying unto themselves, `And who is able to be saved?'
translations.web: They were exceedingly astonished, saying to him, “Then who can be saved?”

translations.kjv: And Jesus looking upon them saith, With men it is impossible, but not with God: for with God all things are possible.
translations.ylt: And Jesus, having looked upon them, saith, `With men it is impossible, but not with God; for all things are possible with God.'
translations.web: Jesus, looking at them, said, “With men it is impossible, but not with God, for all things are possible with God.”

translations.kjv: Then Peter began to say unto him, Lo, we have left all, and have followed thee.
translations.ylt: And Peter began to say to him, `Lo, we left all, and we followed thee.'
