translations.web: Peter began to tell him, “Behold, we have left all and have followed you.”

translations.kjv: And Jesus answered and said, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my sake, and the gospel’s,
translations.ylt: And Jesus answering said, `Verily I say to you, there is no one who left house, or brothers, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or fields, for my sake, and for the good news',
translations.web: Jesus said, “Most certainly I tell you, there is no one who has left house, or brothers, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or land, for my sake, and for the sake of the Good News,

translations.kjv: But he shall receive an hundredfold now in this time, houses, and brethren, and sisters, and mothers, and children, and lands, with persecutions; and in the world to come eternal life.
translations.ylt: who may not receive an hundredfold now in this time, houses, and brothers, and sisters, and mothers, and children, and fields, with persecutions, and in the age that is coming, life age-during;
translations.web: but he will receive one hundred times more now in this time: houses, brothers, sisters, mothers, children, and land, with persecutions; and in the age to come eternal life.

translations.kjv: But many that are first shall be last; and the last first.
translations.ylt: and many first shall be last, and the last first.'
translations.web: But many who are first will be last, and the last first.”

translations.kjv: And they were in the way going up to Jerusalem; and Jesus went before them: and they were amazed; and as they followed, they were afraid. And he took again the twelve, and began to tell them what things should happen unto him,
translations.ylt: And they were in the way going up to Jerusalem, and Jesus was going before them, and they were amazed, and following they were afraid. And having again taken the twelve, he began to tell them the things about to happen to him,
translations.web: They were on the way, going up to Jerusalem; and Jesus was going in front of them, and they were amazed; and those who followed were afraid. He again took the twelve, and began to tell them the things that were going to happen to him.

translations.kjv: Saying, Behold, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man shall be delivered unto the chief priests, and unto the scribes; and they shall condemn him to death, and shall deliver him to the Gentiles:
translations.ylt: --`Lo, we go up to Jerusalem, and the Son of Man shall be delivered to the chief priests, and to the scribes, and they shall condemn him to death, and shall deliver him to the nations,
translations.web: “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem. The Son of Man will be delivered to the chief priests and the scribes. They will condemn him to death, and will deliver him to the Gentiles.

translations.kjv: And they shall mock him, and shall scourge him, and shall spit upon him, and shall kill him: and the third day he shall rise again.
translations.ylt: and they shall mock him, and scourge him, and spit on him, and kill him, and the third day he shall rise again.'
translations.web: They will mock him, spit on him, scourge him, and kill him. On the third day he will rise again.”

translations.kjv: And James and John, the sons of Zebedee, come unto him, saying, Master, we would that thou shouldest do for us whatsoever we shall desire.
translations.ylt: And there come near to him James and John, the sons of Zebedee, saying, `Teacher, we wish that whatever we may ask for ourselves, thou mayest do for us;'
translations.web: James and John, the sons of Zebedee, came near to him, saying, “Teacher, we want you to do for us whatever we will ask.”

translations.kjv: And he said unto them, What would ye that I should do for you?
translations.ylt: and he said to them, `What do ye wish me to do for you?'
translations.web: He said to them, “What do you want me to do for you?”

translations.kjv: They said unto him, Grant unto us that we may sit, one on thy right hand, and the other on thy left hand, in thy glory.
translations.ylt: and they said to him, `Grant to us that, one on thy right hand and one on thy left, we may sit in thy glory;'
translations.web: They said to him, “Grant to us that we may sit, one at your right hand and one at your left hand, in your glory.”

translations.kjv: But Jesus said unto them, Ye know not what ye ask: can ye drink of the cup that I drink of? and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?
translations.ylt: and Jesus said to them, `Ye have not known what ye ask; are ye able to drink of the cup that I drink of, and with the baptism that I am baptized with--to be baptized?'
translations.web: But Jesus said to them, “You don’t know what you are asking. Are you able to drink the cup that I drink, and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?”

translations.kjv: And they said unto him, We can. And Jesus said unto them, Ye shall indeed drink of the cup that I drink of; and with the baptism that I am baptized withal shall ye be baptized:
translations.ylt: And they said to him, `We are able;' and Jesus said to them, `Of the cup indeed that I drink of, ye shall drink, and with the baptism that I am baptized with, ye shall be baptized;
translations.web: They said to him, “We are able.” Jesus said to them, “You shall indeed drink the cup that I drink, and you shall be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with;

translations.kjv: But to sit on my right hand and on my left hand is not mine to give; but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared.
translations.ylt: but to sit on my right and on my left, is not mine to give, but--to those for whom it hath been prepared.'
translations.web: but to sit at my right hand and at my left hand is not mine to give, but for whom it has been prepared.”

translations.kjv: And when the ten heard it, they began to be much displeased with James and John.
translations.ylt: And the ten having heard, began to be much displeased at James and John,
translations.web: When the ten heard it, they began to be indignant toward James and John.

translations.kjv: But Jesus called them to him, and saith unto them, Ye know that they which are accounted to rule over the Gentiles exercise lordship over them; and their great ones exercise authority upon them.
translations.ylt: but Jesus having called them near, saith to them, `Ye have known that they who are considered to rule the nations do exercise lordship over them, and their great ones do exercise authority upon them;
translations.web: Jesus summoned them and said to them, “You know that they who are recognized as rulers over the nations lord it over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them.

translations.kjv: But so shall it not be among you: but whosoever will be great among you, shall be your minister:
translations.ylt: but not so shall it be among you; but whoever may will to become great among you, he shall be your minister,
translations.web: But it shall not be so among you, but whoever wants to become great among you shall be your servant.

translations.kjv: And whosoever of you will be the chiefest, shall be servant of all.
translations.ylt: and whoever of you may will to become first, he shall be servant of all;
translations.web: Whoever of you wants to become first among you shall be bondservant of all.

translations.kjv: For even the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.
translations.ylt: for even the Son of Man came not to be ministered to, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.'
translations.web: For the Son of Man also came not to be served but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”

translations.kjv: And they came to Jericho: and as he went out of Jericho with his disciples and a great number of people, blind Bartimeus, the son of Timeus, sat by the highway side begging.
translations.ylt: And they come to Jericho, and as he is going forth from Jericho, with his disciples and a great multitude, a son of Timaeus--Bartimaeus the blind--was sitting beside the way begging,
translations.web: They came to Jericho. As he went out from Jericho with his disciples and a great multitude, the son of Timaeus, Bartimaeus, a blind beggar, was sitting by the road.

translations.kjv: And when he heard that it was Jesus of Nazareth, he began to cry out, and say, Jesus, thou Son of David, have mercy on me.
translations.ylt: and having heard that it is Jesus the Nazarene, he began to cry out, and to say, `The Son of David--Jesus! deal kindly with me;'
translations.web: When he heard that it was Jesus the Nazarene, he began to cry out and say, “Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on me!”

translations.kjv: And many charged him that he should hold his peace: but he cried the more a great deal, Thou Son of David, have mercy on me.
translations.ylt: and many were rebuking him, that he might keep silent, but the more abundantly he cried out, `Son of David, deal kindly with me.'
translations.web: Many rebuked him, that he should be quiet, but he cried out much more, “You son of David, have mercy on me!”

translations.kjv: And Jesus stood still, and commanded him to be called. And they call the blind man, saying unto him, Be of good comfort, rise; he calleth thee.
translations.ylt: And Jesus having stood, he commanded him to be called, and they call the blind man, saying to him, `Take courage, rise, he doth call thee;'
translations.web: Jesus stood still and said, “Call him.” They called the blind man, saying to him, “Cheer up! Get up. He is calling you!”

translations.kjv: And he, casting away his garment, rose, and came to Jesus.
translations.ylt: and he, having cast away his garment, having risen, did come unto Jesus.
translations.web: He, casting away his cloak, sprang up, and came to Jesus.

translations.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto him, What wilt thou that I should do unto thee? The blind man said unto him, Lord, that I might receive my sight.
translations.ylt: And answering, Jesus saith to him, `What wilt thou I may do to thee?' and the blind man said to him, `Rabboni, that I may see again;'
translations.web: Jesus asked him, “What do you want me to do for you?” The blind man said to him, “Rabboni, that I may see again.”

translations.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Go thy way; thy faith hath made thee whole. And immediately he received his sight, and followed Jesus in the way.
translations.ylt: and Jesus said to him, `Go, thy faith hath saved thee:' and immediately he saw again, and was following Jesus in the way.
translations.web: Jesus said to him, “Go your way. Your faith has made you well.” Immediately he received his sight and followed Jesus on the way.

translations.kjv: And when they came nigh to Jerusalem, unto Bethphage and Bethany, at the mount of Olives, he sendeth forth two of his disciples,
translations.ylt: And when they come nigh to Jerusalem, to Bethphage, and Bethany, unto the mount of the Olives, he sendeth forth two of his disciples,
translations.web: When they came near to Jerusalem, to Bethsphage and Bethany, at the Mount of Olives, he sent two of his disciples

translations.kjv: And saith unto them, Go your way into the village over against you: and as soon as ye be entered into it, ye shall find a colt tied, whereon never man sat; loose him, and bring him.
translations.ylt: and saith to them, `Go away to the village that is over-against you, and immediately, entering into it, ye shall find a colt tied, on which no one of men hath sat, having loosed it, bring it:
translations.web: and said to them, “Go your way into the village that is opposite you. Immediately as you enter into it, you will find a young donkey tied, on which no one has sat. Untie him and bring him.

translations.kjv: And if any man say unto you, Why do ye this? say ye that the Lord hath need of him; and straightway he will send him hither.
translations.ylt: and if any one may say to you, Why do ye this? say ye that the lord hath need of it, and immediately he will send it hither.'
translations.web: If anyone asks you, ‘Why are you doing this?’ say, ‘The Lord needs him;’ and immediately he will send him back here.”

translations.kjv: And they went their way, and found the colt tied by the door without in a place where two ways met; and they loose him.
translations.ylt: And they went away, and found the colt tied at the door without, by the two ways, and they loose it,
translations.web: They went away, and found a young donkey tied at the door outside in the open street, and they untied him.

translations.kjv: And certain of them that stood there said unto them, What do ye, loosing the colt?
translations.ylt: and certain of those standing there said to them, `What do ye--loosing the colt?'
translations.web: Some of those who stood there asked them, “What are you doing, untying the young donkey?”

translations.kjv: And they said unto them even as Jesus had commanded: and they let them go.
translations.ylt: and they said to them as Jesus commanded, and they suffered them.
translations.web: They said to them just as Jesus had said, and they let them go.

translations.kjv: And they brought the colt to Jesus, and cast their garments on him; and he sat upon him.
translations.ylt: And they brought the colt unto Jesus, and did cast upon it their garments, and he sat upon it,
translations.web: They brought the young donkey to Jesus and threw their garments on it, and Jesus sat on it.

translations.kjv: And many spread their garments in the way: and others cut down branches off the trees, and strawed them in the way.
translations.ylt: and many did spread their garments in the way, and others were cutting down branches from the trees, and were strewing in the way.
translations.web: Many spread their garments on the way, and others were cutting down branches from the trees and spreading them on the road.

translations.kjv: And they that went before, and they that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna; Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord:
translations.ylt: And those going before and those following were crying out, saying, `Hosanna! blessed is he who is coming in the name of the Lord;
translations.web: Those who went in front and those who followed cried out, “Hosanna! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!

translations.kjv: Blessed be the kingdom of our father David, that cometh in the name of the Lord: Hosanna in the highest.
translations.ylt: blessed is the coming reign, in the name of the Lord, of our father David; Hosanna in the highest.'
translations.web: Blessed is the kingdom of our father David that is coming in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!”

translations.kjv: And Jesus entered into Jerusalem, and into the temple: and when he had looked round about upon all things, and now the eventide was come, he went out unto Bethany with the twelve.
translations.ylt: And Jesus entered into Jerusalem, and into the temple, and having looked round on all things, it being now evening, he went forth to Bethany with the twelve.
translations.web: Jesus entered into the temple in Jerusalem. When he had looked around at everything, it being now evening, he went out to Bethany with the twelve.

translations.kjv: And on the morrow, when they were come from Bethany, he was hungry:
translations.ylt: And on the morrow, they having come forth from Bethany, he hungered,
translations.web: The next day, when they had come out from Bethany, he was hungry.

translations.kjv: And seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came, if haply he might find any thing thereon: and when he came to it, he found nothing but leaves; for the time of figs was not yet.
translations.ylt: and having seen a fig-tree afar off having leaves, he came, if perhaps he shall find anything in it, and having come to it, he found nothing except leaves, for it was not a time of figs,
translations.web: Seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came to see if perhaps he might find anything on it. When he came to it, he found nothing but leaves, for it was not the season for figs.

translations.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto it, No man eat fruit of thee hereafter for ever. And his disciples heard it.
translations.ylt: and Jesus answering said to it, `No more from thee--to the age--may any eat fruit;' and his disciples were hearing.
translations.web: Jesus told it, “May no one ever eat fruit from you again!” and his disciples heard it.

translations.kjv: And they come to Jerusalem: and Jesus went into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves;
translations.ylt: And they come to Jerusalem, and Jesus having gone into the temple, began to cast forth those selling and buying in the temple, and the tables of the money-changers and the seats of those selling the doves, he overthrew,
translations.web: They came to Jerusalem, and Jesus entered into the temple and began to throw out those who sold and those who bought in the temple, and overthrew the money changers’ tables and the seats of those who sold the doves.

translations.kjv: And would not suffer that any man should carry any vessel through the temple.
translations.ylt: and he did not suffer that any might bear a vessel through the temple,
translations.web: He would not allow anyone to carry a container through the temple.

translations.kjv: And he taught, saying unto them, Is it not written, My house shall be called of all nations the house of prayer? but ye have made it a den of thieves.
translations.ylt: and he was teaching, saying to them, `Hath it not been written--My house a house of prayer shall be called for all the nations, and ye did make it a den of robbers?'
translations.web: He taught, saying to them, “Isn’t it written, ‘My house will be called a house of prayer for all the nations’? But you have made it a den of robbers!”

translations.kjv: And the scribes and chief priests heard it, and sought how they might destroy him: for they feared him, because all the people was astonished at his doctrine.
translations.ylt: And the scribes and the chief priests heard, and they were seeking how they shall destroy him, for they were afraid of him, because all the multitude was astonished at his teaching;
translations.web: The chief priests and the scribes heard it, and sought how they might destroy him. For they feared him, because all the multitude was astonished at his teaching.

translations.kjv: And when even was come, he went out of the city.
translations.ylt: and when evening came, he was going forth without the city.
translations.web: When evening came, he went out of the city.

translations.kjv: And in the morning, as they passed by, they saw the fig tree dried up from the roots.
translations.ylt: And in the morning, passing by, they saw the fig-tree having been dried up from the roots,
translations.web: As they passed by in the morning, they saw the fig tree withered away from the roots.

translations.kjv: And Peter calling to remembrance saith unto him, Master, behold, the fig tree which thou cursedst is withered away.
translations.ylt: and Peter having remembered saith to him, `Rabbi, lo, the fig-tree that thou didst curse is dried up.'
translations.web: Peter, remembering, said to him, “Rabbi, look! The fig tree which you cursed has withered away.”

translations.kjv: And Jesus answering saith unto them, Have faith in God.
translations.ylt: And Jesus answering saith to them, `Have faith of God;
translations.web: Jesus answered them, “Have faith in God.

translations.kjv: For verily I say unto you, That whosoever shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; and shall not doubt in his heart, but shall believe that those things which he saith shall come to pass; he shall have whatsoever he saith.
translations.ylt: for verily I say to you, that whoever may say to this mount, Be taken up, and be cast into the sea, and may not doubt in his heart, but may believe that the things that he saith do come to pass, it shall be to him whatever he may say.
translations.web: For most certainly I tell you, whoever may tell this mountain, ‘Be taken up and cast into the sea,’ and doesn’t doubt in his heart, but believes that what he says is happening, he shall have whatever he says.

translations.kjv: Therefore I say unto you, What things soever ye desire, when ye pray, believe that ye receive them, and ye shall have them.
translations.ylt: Because of this I say to you, all whatever--praying--ye do ask, believe that ye receive, and it shall be to you.
translations.web: Therefore I tell you, all things whatever you pray and ask for, believe that you have received them, and you shall have them.

translations.kjv: And when ye stand praying, forgive, if ye have ought against any: that your Father also which is in heaven may forgive you your trespasses.
translations.ylt: `And whenever ye may stand praying, forgive, if ye have anything against any one, that your Father also who is in the heavens may forgive you your trespasses;
translations.web: Whenever you stand praying, forgive, if you have anything against anyone; so that your Father, who is in heaven, may also forgive you your transgressions.

translations.kjv: And they come again to Jerusalem: and as he was walking in the temple, there come to him the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders,
translations.ylt: And they come again to Jerusalem, and in the temple, as he is walking, there come unto him the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders,
translations.web: They came again to Jerusalem, and as he was walking in the temple, the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders came to him,

translations.kjv: And say unto him, By what authority doest thou these things? and who gave thee this authority to do these things?
translations.ylt: and they say to him, `By what authority dost thou these things? and who gave thee this authority that these things thou mayest do?'
translations.web: and they began saying to him, “By what authority do you do these things? Or who gave you this authority to do these things?”

translations.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto them, I will also ask of you one question, and answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.
translations.ylt: And Jesus answering said to them, `I will question you--I also--one word; and answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things;
translations.web: Jesus said to them, “I will ask you one question. Answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.

translations.kjv: The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or of men? answer me.
translations.ylt: the baptism of John--from heaven was it? or from men? answer me.'
translations.web: The baptism of John—was it from heaven, or from men? Answer me.”

translations.kjv: And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then did ye not believe him?
translations.ylt: And they were reasoning with themselves, saying, `If we may say, From heaven, he will say, Wherefore, then, did ye not believe him?
translations.web: They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we should say, ‘From heaven;’ he will say, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’

translations.kjv: But if we shall say, Of men; they feared the people: for all men counted John, that he was a prophet indeed.
translations.ylt: But if we may say, From men,' --they were fearing the people, for all were holding John that he was indeed a prophet;
translations.web: If we should say, ‘From men’”—they feared the people, for all held John to really be a prophet.

translations.kjv: And they answered and said unto Jesus, We cannot tell. And Jesus answering saith unto them, Neither do I tell you by what authority I do these things.
translations.ylt: and answering they say to Jesus, `We have not known;' and Jesus answering saith to them, `Neither do I tell you by what authority I do these things.'
translations.web: They answered Jesus, “We don’t know.” Jesus said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.”

translations.kjv: And he began to speak unto them by parables. A certain man planted a vineyard, and set an hedge about it, and digged a place for the winefat, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country.
translations.ylt: And he began to speak to them in similes: `A man planted a vineyard, and put a hedge around, and digged an under-wine-vat, and built a tower, and gave it out to husbandmen, and went abroad;
translations.web: He began to speak to them in parables. “A man planted a vineyard, put a hedge around it, dug a pit for the wine press, built a tower, rented it out to a farmer, and went into another country.

translations.kjv: And at the season he sent to the husbandmen a servant, that he might receive from the husbandmen of the fruit of the vineyard.
translations.ylt: and he sent unto the husbandmen at the due time a servant, that from the husbandmen he may receive from the fruit of the vineyard,
translations.web: When it was time, he sent a servant to the farmer to get from the farmer his share of the fruit of the vineyard.

translations.kjv: And they caught him, and beat him, and sent him away empty.
translations.ylt: and they, having taken him, did severely beat him, and did send him away empty.
translations.web: They took him, beat him, and sent him away empty.

translations.kjv: And again he sent unto them another servant; and at him they cast stones, and wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully handled.
translations.ylt: `And again he sent unto them another servant, and at that one having cast stones, they wounded him in the head, and sent away--dishonoured.
translations.web: Again, he sent another servant to them; and they threw stones at him, wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully treated.

translations.kjv: And again he sent another; and him they killed, and many others; beating some, and killing some.
translations.ylt: `And again he sent another, and that one they killed; and many others, some beating, and some killing.
translations.web: Again he sent another, and they killed him, and many others, beating some, and killing some.

translations.kjv: Having yet therefore one son, his wellbeloved, he sent him also last unto them, saying, They will reverence my son.
translations.ylt: `Having yet therefore one son--his beloved--he sent also him unto them last, saying--They will reverence my son;
translations.web: Therefore still having one, his beloved son, he sent him last to them, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’

translations.kjv: But those husbandmen said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and the inheritance shall be ours.
translations.ylt: and those husbandmen said among themselves--This is the heir, come, we may kill him, and ours shall be the inheritance;
translations.web: But those farmers said among themselves, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.’

translations.kjv: And they took him, and killed him, and cast him out of the vineyard.
translations.ylt: and having taken him, they did kill, and cast him forth without the vineyard.
translations.web: They took him, killed him, and cast him out of the vineyard.

translations.kjv: What shall therefore the lord of the vineyard do? he will come and destroy the husbandmen, and will give the vineyard unto others.
translations.ylt: `What therefore shall the lord of the vineyard do? he will come and destroy the husbandmen, and will give the vineyard to others.
translations.web: What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do? He will come and destroy the farmers, and will give the vineyard to others.

translations.kjv: And have ye not read this scripture; The stone which the builders rejected is become the head of the corner:
translations.ylt: And this Writing did ye not read: A stone that the builders rejected, it did become the head of a corner:
translations.web: Haven’t you even read this Scripture: ‘The stone which the builders rejected was made the head of the corner.

translations.kjv: This was the Lord’s doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?
translations.ylt: from the Lord was this, and it is wonderful in our eyes.'
translations.web: This was from the Lord. It is marvelous in our eyes’?”

translations.kjv: And they sought to lay hold on him, but feared the people: for they knew that he had spoken the parable against them: and they left him, and went their way.
translations.ylt: And they were seeking to lay hold on him, and they feared the multitude, for they knew that against them he spake the simile, and having left him, they went away;
translations.web: They tried to seize him, but they feared the multitude; for they perceived that he spoke the parable against them. They left him and went away.

translations.kjv: And they send unto him certain of the Pharisees and of the Herodians, to catch him in his words.
translations.ylt: and they send unto him certain of the Pharisees and of the Herodians, that they may ensnare him in discourse,
translations.web: They sent some of the Pharisees and the Herodians to him, that they might trap him with words.

translations.kjv: And when they were come, they say unto him, Master, we know that thou art true, and carest for no man: for thou regardest not the person of men, but teachest the way of God in truth: Is it lawful to give tribute to Cesar, or not?
translations.ylt: and they having come, say to him, `Teacher, we have known that thou art true, and thou art not caring for any one, for thou dost not look to the face of men, but in truth the way of God dost teach; is it lawful to give tribute to Caesar or not? may we give, or may we not give?'
translations.web: When they had come, they asked him, “Teacher, we know that you are honest, and don’t defer to anyone; for you aren’t partial to anyone, but truly teach the way of God. Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?

translations.kjv: Shall we give, or shall we not give? But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said unto them, Why tempt ye me? bring me a penny, that I may see it.
translations.ylt: And he, knowing their hypocrisy, said to them, `Why me do ye tempt? bring me a denary, that I may see;'
translations.web: Shall we give, or shall we not give?” But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said to them, “Why do you test me? Bring me a denarius, that I may see it.”

translations.kjv: And they brought it. And he saith unto them, Whose is this image and superscription? And they said unto him, Cesar’s.
translations.ylt: and they brought, and he saith to them, `Whose is this image, and the inscription?' and they said to him, `Caesar's;'
translations.web: They brought it. He said to them, “Whose is this image and inscription?” They said to him, “Caesar’s.”

translations.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto them, Render to Cesar the things that are Cesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s. And they marvelled at him.
translations.ylt: and Jesus answering said to them, `Give back the things of Caesar to Caesar, and the things of God to God;' and they did wonder at him.
translations.web: Jesus answered them, “Give to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.” They marveled greatly at him.

translations.kjv: Then come unto him the Sadducees, which say there is no resurrection; and they asked him, saying,
translations.ylt: And the Sadducees come unto him, who say there is not a rising again, and they questioned him, saying,
translations.web: Some Sadducees, who say that there is no resurrection, came to him. They asked him, saying,

translations.kjv: Master, Moses wrote unto us, If a man’s brother die, and leave his wife behind him, and leave no children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.
translations.ylt: `Teacher, Moses wrote to us, that if any one's brother may die, and may leave a wife, and may leave no children, that his brother may take his wife, and raise up seed to his brother.
translations.web: “Teacher, Moses wrote to us, ‘If a man’s brother dies and leaves a wife behind him, and leaves no children, that his brother should take his wife and raise up offspring for his brother.’

translations.kjv: Now there were seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and dying left no seed.
translations.ylt: `There were then seven brothers, and the first took a wife, and dying, he left no seed;
translations.web: There were seven brothers. The first took a wife, and dying left no offspring.

translations.kjv: And the second took her, and died, neither left he any seed: and the third likewise.
translations.ylt: and the second took her, and died, neither left he seed, and the third in like manner,
translations.web: The second took her, and died, leaving no children behind him. The third likewise;

translations.kjv: And the seven had her, and left no seed: last of all the woman died also.
translations.ylt: and the seven took her, and left no seed, last of all died also the woman;
translations.web: and the seven took her and left no children. Last of all the woman also died.

translations.kjv: In the resurrection therefore, when they shall rise, whose wife shall she be of them? for the seven had her to wife.
translations.ylt: in the rising again, then, whenever they may rise, of which of them shall she be wife--for the seven had her as wife?'
translations.web: In the resurrection, when they rise, whose wife will she be of them? For the seven had her as a wife.”

translations.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto them, Do ye not therefore err, because ye know not the scriptures, neither the power of God?
translations.ylt: And Jesus answering said to them, `Do ye not because of this go astray, not knowing the Writings, nor the power of God?
translations.web: Jesus answered them, “Isn’t this because you are mistaken, not knowing the Scriptures nor the power of God?

translations.kjv: For when they shall rise from the dead, they neither marry, nor are given in marriage; but are as the angels which are in heaven.
translations.ylt: for when they may rise out of the dead, they neither marry nor are they given in marriage, but are as messengers who are in the heavens.
translations.web: For when they will rise from the dead, they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are like angels in heaven.

translations.kjv: And as touching the dead, that they rise: have ye not read in the book of Moses, how in the bush God spake unto him, saying, I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob?
translations.ylt: `And concerning the dead, that they rise: have ye not read in the Book of Moses (at The Bush), how God spake to him, saying, I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob;
translations.web: But about the dead, that they are raised, haven’t you read in the book of Moses about the Bush, how God spoke to him, saying, ‘I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’?

translations.kjv: He is not the God of the dead, but the God of the living: ye therefore do greatly err.
translations.ylt: he is not the God of dead men, but a God of living men; ye then go greatly astray.'
translations.web: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living. You are therefore badly mistaken.”

translations.kjv: And one of the scribes came, and having heard them reasoning together, and perceiving that he had answered them well, asked him, Which is the first commandment of all?
translations.ylt: And one of the scribes having come near, having heard them disputing, knowing that he answered them well, questioned him, `Which is the first command of all?'
translations.web: One of the scribes came and heard them questioning together, and knowing that he had answered them well, asked him, “Which commandment is the greatest of all?”

translations.kjv: And Jesus answered him, The first of all the commandments is, Hear, O Israel; The Lord our God is one Lord:
translations.ylt: and Jesus answered him--`The first of all the commands is, Hear, O Israel, the Lord is our God, the Lord is one;
translations.web: Jesus answered, “The greatest is: ‘Hear, Israel, the Lord our God, the Lord is one.

translations.kjv: And thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind, and with all thy strength: this is the first commandment.
translations.ylt: and thou shalt love the Lord thy God out of all thy heart, and out of thy soul, and out of all thine understanding, and out of all thy strength--this is the first command;
translations.web: You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your mind, and with all your strength.’ This is the first commandment.

translations.kjv: And the second is like, namely this, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself. There is none other commandment greater than these.
translations.ylt: and the second is like it, this, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself; --greater than these there is no other command.'
translations.web: The second is like this: ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’ There is no other commandment greater than these.”

translations.kjv: And the scribe said unto him, Well, Master, thou hast said the truth: for there is one God; and there is none other but he:
translations.ylt: And the scribe said to him, `Well, Teacher, in truth thou hast spoken that there is one God, and there is none other but He;
translations.web: The scribe said to him, “Truly, teacher, you have said well that he is one, and there is none other but he;

translations.kjv: And to love him with all the heart, and with all the understanding, and with all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbour as himself, is more than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.
translations.ylt: and to love Him out of all the heart, and out of all the understanding, and out of all the soul, and out of all the strength, and to love one's neighbour as one's self, is more than all the whole burnt-offerings and the sacrifices.'
translations.web: and to love him with all the heart, with all the understanding, all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbor as himself, is more important than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.”

translations.kjv: And when Jesus saw that he answered discreetly, he said unto him, Thou art not far from the kingdom of God. And no man after that durst ask him any question.
translations.ylt: And Jesus, having seen him that he answered with understanding, said to him, `Thou art not far from the reign of God;' and no one any more durst question him.
translations.web: When Jesus saw that he answered wisely, he said to him, “You are not far from God’s Kingdom.” No one dared ask him any question after that.

translations.kjv: And Jesus answered and said, while he taught in the temple, How say the scribes that Christ is the Son of David?
translations.ylt: And Jesus answering said, teaching in the temple, `How say the scribes that the Christ is son of David?
translations.web: Jesus responded, as he taught in the temple, “How is it that the scribes say that the Christ is the son of David?

translations.kjv: For David himself said by the Holy Ghost, The Lord said to my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, till I make thine enemies thy footstool.
translations.ylt: for David himself said in the Holy Spirit, The Lord said to my lord, Sit thou on My right hand, till I place thine enemies--thy footstool;
translations.web: For David himself said in the Holy Spirit, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet.”’

translations.kjv: David therefore himself calleth him Lord; and whence is he then his son? And the common people heard him gladly.
translations.ylt: therefore David himself saith of him Lord, and whence is he his son?' And the great multitude were hearing him gladly,
translations.web: Therefore David himself calls him Lord, so how can he be his son?” The common people heard him gladly.

translations.kjv: And he said unto them in his doctrine, Beware of the scribes, which love to go in long clothing, and love salutations in the marketplaces,
translations.ylt: and he was saying to them in his teaching, `Beware of the scribes, who will in long robes to walk, and love salutations in the market-places,
translations.web: In his teaching he said to them, “Beware of the scribes, who like to walk in long robes, and to get greetings in the marketplaces,

translations.kjv: And the chief seats in the synagogues, and the uppermost rooms at feasts:
translations.ylt: and first seats in the synagogues, and first couches in suppers,
translations.web: and to get the best seats in the synagogues and the best places at feasts,

translations.kjv: Which devour widows’ houses, and for a pretence make long prayers: these shall receive greater damnation.
translations.ylt: who are devouring the widows' houses, and for a pretence are making long prayers; these shall receive more abundant judgment.'
translations.web: those who devour widows’ houses, and for a pretense make long prayers. These will receive greater condemnation.”

translations.kjv: And Jesus sat over against the treasury, and beheld how the people cast money into the treasury: and many that were rich cast in much.
translations.ylt: And Jesus having sat down over-against the treasury, was beholding how the multitude do put brass into the treasury, and many rich were putting in much,
translations.web: Jesus sat down opposite the treasury and saw how the multitude cast money into the treasury. Many who were rich cast in much.

translations.kjv: And there came a certain poor widow, and she threw in two mites, which make a farthing.
translations.ylt: and having come, a poor widow did put in two mites, which are a farthing.
translations.web: A poor widow came and she cast in two small brass coins, which equal a quadrans coin.

translations.kjv: And he called unto him his disciples, and saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, That this poor widow hath cast more in, than all they which have cast into the treasury:
translations.ylt: And having called near his disciples, he saith to them, `Verily I say to you, that this poor widow hath put in more than all those putting into the treasury;
translations.web: He called his disciples to himself and said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, this poor widow gave more than all those who are giving into the treasury,

translations.kjv: For all they did cast in of their abundance; but she of her want did cast in all that she had, even all her living.
translations.ylt: for all, out of their abundance, put in, but she, out of her want, all that she had put in--all her living.'
translations.web: for they all gave out of their abundance, but she, out of her poverty, gave all that she had to live on.”

translations.kjv: And as he went out of the temple, one of his disciples saith unto him, Master, see what manner of stones and what buildings are here!
translations.ylt: And as he is going forth out of the temple, one of his disciples saith to him, `Teacher, see! what stones! and what buildings!'
translations.web: As he went out of the temple, one of his disciples said to him, “Teacher, see what kind of stones and what kind of buildings!”

translations.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto him, Seest thou these great buildings? there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.
translations.ylt: and Jesus answering said to him, `Seest thou these great buildings? there may not be left a stone upon a stone, that may not be thrown down.'
translations.web: Jesus said to him, “Do you see these great buildings? There will not be left here one stone on another, which will not be thrown down.”

translations.kjv: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives over against the temple, Peter and James and John and Andrew asked him privately,
translations.ylt: And as he is sitting at the mount of the Olives, over-against the temple, Peter, and James, and John, and Andrew, were questioning him by himself,
translations.web: As he sat on the Mount of Olives opposite the temple, Peter, James, John, and Andrew asked him privately,

translations.kjv: Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign when all these things shall be fulfilled?
translations.ylt: `Tell us when these things shall be? and what is the sign when all these may be about to be fulfilled?'
translations.web: “Tell us, when will these things be? What is the sign that these things are all about to be fulfilled?”

translations.kjv: And Jesus answering them began to say, Take heed lest any man deceive you:
translations.ylt: And Jesus answering them, began to say, `Take heed lest any one may lead you astray,
translations.web: Jesus, answering, began to tell them, “Be careful that no one leads you astray.

translations.kjv: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.
translations.ylt: for many shall come in my name, saying--I am he, and many they shall lead astray;
translations.web: For many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am he!’ and will lead many astray.

translations.kjv: And when ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars, be ye not troubled: for such things must needs be; but the end shall not be yet.
translations.ylt: and when ye may hear of wars and reports of wars, be not troubled, for these behove to be, but the end is not yet;
translations.web: “When you hear of wars and rumors of wars, don’t be troubled. For those must happen, but the end is not yet.

translations.kjv: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be earthquakes in divers places, and there shall be famines and troubles: these are the beginnings of sorrows.
translations.ylt: for nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom, and there shall be earthquakes in divers places, and there shall be famines and troubles; beginnings of sorrows are these.
translations.web: For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be earthquakes in various places. There will be famines and troubles. These things are the beginning of birth pains.

translations.kjv: But take heed to yourselves: for they shall deliver you up to councils; and in the synagogues ye shall be beaten: and ye shall be brought before rulers and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them.
translations.ylt: `And take ye heed to yourselves, for they shall deliver you up to sanhedrims, and to synagogues, ye shall be beaten, and before governors and kings ye shall be set for my sake, for a testimony to them;
translations.web: “But watch yourselves, for they will deliver you up to councils. You will be beaten in synagogues. You will stand before rulers and kings for my sake, for a testimony to them.

translations.kjv: And the gospel must first be published among all nations.
translations.ylt: and to all the nations it behoveth first that the good news be proclaimed.
translations.web: The Good News must first be preached to all the nations.

translations.kjv: But when they shall lead you, and deliver you up, take no thought beforehand what ye shall speak, neither do ye premeditate: but whatsoever shall be given you in that hour, that speak ye: for it is not ye that speak, but the Holy Ghost.
translations.ylt: `And when they may lead you, delivering up, be not anxious beforehand what ye may speak, nor premeditate, but whatever may be given to you in that hour, that speak ye, for it is not ye who are speaking, but the Holy Spirit.
translations.web: When they lead you away and deliver you up, don’t be anxious beforehand or premeditate what you will say, but say whatever will be given you in that hour. For it is not you who speak, but the Holy Spirit.

translations.kjv: Now the brother shall betray the brother to death, and the father the son; and children shall rise up against their parents, and shall cause them to be put to death.
translations.ylt: `And brother shall deliver up brother to death, and father child, and children shall rise up against parents, and shall put them to death,
translations.web: “Brother will deliver up brother to death, and the father his child. Children will rise up against parents and cause them to be put to death.

translations.kjv: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name’s sake: but he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.
translations.ylt: and ye shall be hated by all because of my name, but he who hath endured to the end--he shall be saved.
translations.web: You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake, but he who endures to the end will be saved.

translations.kjv: But when ye shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not, (let him that readeth understand,) then let them that be in Judea flee to the mountains:
translations.ylt: `And when ye may see the abomination of the desolation, that was spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not, (whoever is reading let him understand), then those in Judea, let them flee to the mountains;
translations.web: “But when you see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not” (let the reader understand), “then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains,

translations.kjv: And let him that is on the housetop not go down into the house, neither enter therein, to take any thing out of his house:
translations.ylt: and he upon the house-top, let him not come down to the house, nor come in to take anything out of his house;
translations.web: and let him who is on the housetop not go down, nor enter in, to take anything out of his house.

translations.kjv: And let him that is in the field not turn back again for to take up his garment.
translations.ylt: and he who is in the field, let him not turn to the things behind, to take up his garment.
translations.web: Let him who is in the field not return back to take his cloak.

translations.kjv: But woe to them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!
translations.ylt: `And woe to those with child, and to those giving suck, in those days;
translations.web: But woe to those who are with child and to those who nurse babies in those days!

translations.kjv: And pray ye that your flight be not in the winter.
translations.ylt: and pray ye that your flight may not be in winter,
translations.web: Pray that your flight won’t be in the winter.

translations.kjv: For in those days shall be affliction, such as was not from the beginning of the creation which God created unto this time, neither shall be.
translations.ylt: for those days shall be tribulation, such as hath not been from the beginning of the creation that God created, till now, and may not be;
translations.web: For in those days there will be oppression, such as there has not been the like from the beginning of the creation which God created until now, and never will be.

translations.kjv: And except that the Lord had shortened those days, no flesh should be saved: but for the elect’s sake, whom he hath chosen, he hath shortened the days.
translations.ylt: and if the Lord did not shorten the days, no flesh had been saved; but because of the chosen, whom He did choose to Himself, He did shorten the days.
translations.web: Unless the Lord had shortened the days, no flesh would have been saved; but for the sake of the chosen ones, whom he picked out, he shortened the days.

translations.kjv: And then if any man shall say to you, Lo, here is Christ; or, lo, he is there; believe him not:
translations.ylt: `And then, if any may say to you, Lo, here is the Christ, or, Lo, there, ye may not believe;
translations.web: Then if anyone tells you, ‘Look, here is the Christ!’ or, ‘Look, there!’ don’t believe it.

translations.kjv: For false Christs and false prophets shall rise, and shall shew signs and wonders, to seduce, if it were possible, even the elect.
translations.ylt: for there shall rise false Christs and false prophets, and they shall give signs and wonders, to seduce, if possible, also the chosen;
translations.web: For false christs and false prophets will arise and will show signs and wonders, that they may lead astray, if possible, even the chosen ones.

translations.kjv: But take ye heed: behold, I have foretold you all things.
translations.ylt: and ye, take heed; lo, I have foretold you all things.
translations.web: But you watch. “Behold, I have told you all things beforehand.

translations.kjv: But in those days, after that tribulation, the sun shall be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light,
translations.ylt: `But in those days, after that tribulation, the sun shall be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light,
translations.web: But in those days, after that oppression, the sun will be darkened, the moon will not give its light,

translations.kjv: And the stars of heaven shall fall, and the powers that are in heaven shall be shaken.
translations.ylt: and the stars of the heaven shall be falling, and the powers that are in the heavens shall be shaken.
translations.web: the stars will be falling from the sky, and the powers that are in the heavens will be shaken.

translations.kjv: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in the clouds with great power and glory.
translations.ylt: `And then they shall see the Son of Man coming in clouds with much power and glory,
translations.web: Then they will see the Son of Man coming in clouds with great power and glory.

translations.kjv: And then shall he send his angels, and shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from the uttermost part of the earth to the uttermost part of heaven.
translations.ylt: and then he shall send his messengers, and gather together his chosen from the four winds, from the end of the earth unto the end of heaven.
translations.web: Then he will send out his angels, and will gather together his chosen ones from the four winds, from the ends of the earth to the ends of the sky.

translations.kjv: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When her branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer is near:
translations.ylt: `And from the fig-tree learn ye the simile: when the branch may already become tender, and may put forth the leaves, ye know that nigh is the summer;
translations.web: “Now from the fig tree, learn this parable. When the branch has now become tender and produces its leaves, you know that the summer is near;

translations.kjv: So ye in like manner, when ye shall see these things come to pass, know that it is nigh, even at the doors.
translations.ylt: so ye, also, when these ye may see coming to pass, ye know that it is nigh, at the doors.
translations.web: even so you also, when you see these things coming to pass, know that it is near, at the doors.

translations.kjv: Verily I say unto you, that this generation shall not pass, till all these things be done.
translations.ylt: Verily I say to you, that this generation may not pass away till all these things may come to pass;
translations.web: Most certainly I say to you, this generation will not pass away until all these things happen.

translations.kjv: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.
translations.ylt: the heaven and the earth shall pass away, but my words shall not pass away.
translations.web: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.

translations.kjv: But of that day and that hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels which are in heaven, neither the Son, but the Father.
translations.ylt: `And concerning that day and the hour no one hath known--not even the messengers who are in the heaven, not even the Son--except the Father.
translations.web: “But of that day or that hour no one knows—not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.

translations.kjv: Take ye heed, watch and pray: for ye know not when the time is.
translations.ylt: Take heed, watch and pray, for ye have not known when the time is;
translations.web: Watch, keep alert, and pray; for you don’t know when the time is.

translations.kjv: For the Son of man is as a man taking a far journey, who left his house, and gave authority to his servants, and to every man his work, and commanded the porter to watch.
translations.ylt: as a man who is gone abroad, having left his house, and given to his servants the authority, and to each one his work, did command also the porter that he may watch;
translations.web: “It is like a man traveling to another country, having left his house and given authority to his servants, and to each one his work, and also commanded the doorkeeper to keep watch.

translations.kjv: Watch ye therefore: for ye know not when the master of the house cometh, at even, or at midnight, or at the cockcrowing, or in the morning:
translations.ylt: watch ye, therefore, for ye have not known when the lord of the house doth come, at even, or at midnight, or at cock-crowing, or at the morning;
translations.web: Watch therefore, for you don’t know when the lord of the house is coming—whether at evening, or at midnight, or when the rooster crows, or in the morning;

translations.kjv: Lest coming suddenly he find you sleeping.
translations.ylt: lest, having come suddenly, he may find you sleeping;
translations.web: lest, coming suddenly, he might find you sleeping.

translations.kjv: And what I say unto you I say unto all, Watch.
translations.ylt: and what I say to you, I say to all, Watch.'
translations.web: What I tell you, I tell all: Watch!”

translations.kjv: After two days was the feast of the passover, and of unleavened bread: and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might take him by craft, and put him to death.
translations.ylt: And the passover and the unleavened food were after two days, and the chief priests and the scribes were seeking how, by guile, having taken hold of him, they might kill him;
translations.web: It was now two days before the Passover and the Feast of Unleavened Bread, and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might seize him by deception and kill him.

translations.kjv: But they said, Not on the feast day, lest there be an uproar of the people.
translations.ylt: and they said, `Not in the feast, lest there shall be a tumult of the people.'
translations.web: For they said, “Not during the feast, because there might be a riot among the people.”

translations.kjv: And being in Bethany in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at meat, there came a woman having an alabaster box of ointment of spikenard very precious; and she brake the box, and poured it on his head.
translations.ylt: And he, being in Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper, at his reclining (at meat), there came a woman having an alabaster box of ointment, of spikenard, very precious, and having broken the alabaster box, did pour on his head;
translations.web: While he was at Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at the table, a woman came having an alabaster jar of ointment of pure nard—very costly. She broke the jar and poured it over his head.

translations.kjv: And there were some that had indignation within themselves, and said, Why was this waste of the ointment made?
translations.ylt: and there were certain much displeased within themselves, and saying, `For what hath this waste of the ointment been made?
translations.web: But there were some who were indignant among themselves, saying, “Why has this ointment been wasted?

translations.kjv: For it might have been sold for more than three hundred pence, and have been given to the poor. And they murmured against her.
translations.ylt: for this could have been sold for more than three hundred denaries, and given to the poor;' and they were murmuring at her.
translations.web: For this might have been sold for more than three hundred denarii and given to the poor.” So they grumbled against her.

translations.kjv: And Jesus said, Let her alone; why trouble ye her? she hath wrought a good work on me.
translations.ylt: And Jesus said, `Let her alone; why are ye giving her trouble? a good work she wrought on me;
translations.web: But Jesus said, “Leave her alone. Why do you trouble her? She has done a good work for me.

translations.kjv: For ye have the poor with you always, and whensoever ye will ye may do them good: but me ye have not always.
translations.ylt: for the poor always ye have with you, and whenever ye may will ye are able to do them good, but me ye have not always;
translations.web: For you always have the poor with you, and whenever you want to, you can do them good; but you will not always have me.

translations.kjv: She hath done what she could: she is come aforehand to anoint my body to the burying.
translations.ylt: what she could she did, she anticipated to anoint my body for the embalming.
translations.web: She has done what she could. She has anointed my body beforehand for the burying.

translations.kjv: Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached throughout the whole world, this also that she hath done shall be spoken of for a memorial of her.
translations.ylt: Verily I say to you, wherever this good news may be proclaimed in the whole world, what also this woman did shall be spoken of--for a memorial of her.'
translations.web: Most certainly I tell you, wherever this Good News may be preached throughout the whole world, that which this woman has done will also be spoken of for a memorial of her.”

translations.kjv: And Judas Iscariot, one of the twelve, went unto the chief priests, to betray him unto them.
translations.ylt: And Judas the Iscariot, one of the twelve, went away unto the chief priests that he might deliver him up to them,
translations.web: Judas Iscariot, who was one of the twelve, went away to the chief priests, that he might deliver him to them.

translations.kjv: And when they heard it, they were glad, and promised to give him money. And he sought how he might conveniently betray him.
translations.ylt: and having heard, they were glad, and promised to give him money, and he was seeking how, conveniently, he might deliver him up.
translations.web: They, when they heard it, were glad, and promised to give him money. He sought how he might conveniently deliver him.

translations.kjv: And the first day of unleavened bread, when they killed the passover, his disciples said unto him, Where wilt thou that we go and prepare that thou mayest eat the passover?
translations.ylt: And the first day of the unleavened food, when they were killing the passover, his disciples say to him, `Where wilt thou, that, having gone, we may prepare, that thou mayest eat the passover?'
translations.web: On the first day of unleavened bread, when they sacrificed the Passover, his disciples asked him, “Where do you want us to go and prepare that you may eat the Passover?”

translations.kjv: And he sendeth forth two of his disciples, and saith unto them, Go ye into the city, and there shall meet you a man bearing a pitcher of water: follow him.
translations.ylt: And he sendeth forth two of his disciples, and saith to them, `Go ye away to the city, and there shall meet you a man bearing a pitcher of water, follow him;
translations.web: He sent two of his disciples and said to them, “Go into the city, and there a man carrying a pitcher of water will meet you. Follow him,

translations.kjv: And wheresoever he shall go in, say ye to the goodman of the house, The Master saith, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?
translations.ylt: and wherever he may go in, say ye to the master of the house--The Teacher saith, Where is the guest-chamber, where the passover, with my disciples, I may eat?
translations.web: and wherever he enters in, tell the master of the house, ‘The Teacher says, “Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?”’

translations.kjv: And he will shew you a large upper room furnished and prepared: there make ready for us.
translations.ylt: and he will shew you a large upper room, furnished, prepared--there make ready for us.'
translations.web: He will himself show you a large upper room furnished and ready. Get ready for us there.”

translations.kjv: And his disciples went forth, and came into the city, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.
translations.ylt: And his disciples went forth, and came to the city, and found as he said to them, and they made ready the passover.
translations.web: His disciples went out, and came into the city, and found things as he had said to them, and they prepared the Passover.

translations.kjv: And in the evening he cometh with the twelve.
translations.ylt: And evening having come, he cometh with the twelve,
translations.web: When it was evening he came with the twelve.

translations.kjv: And as they sat and did eat, Jesus said, Verily I say unto you, One of you which eateth with me shall betray me.
translations.ylt: and as they are reclining, and eating, Jesus said, `Verily I say to you--one of you, who is eating with me--shall deliver me up.'
translations.web: As they sat and were eating, Jesus said, “Most certainly I tell you, one of you will betray me—he who eats with me.”

translations.kjv: And they began to be sorrowful, and to say unto him one by one, Is it I? and another said, Is it I?
translations.ylt: And they began to be sorrowful, and to say to him, one by one, `Is it I?' and another, `Is it I?'
translations.web: They began to be sorrowful, and to ask him one by one, “Surely not I?” And another said, “Surely not I?”

translations.kjv: And he answered and said unto them, It is one of the twelve, that dippeth with me in the dish.
translations.ylt: And he answering said to them, `One of the twelve who is dipping with me in the dish;
translations.web: He answered them, “It is one of the twelve, he who dips with me in the dish.

translations.kjv: The Son of man indeed goeth, as it is written of him: but woe to that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! good were it for that man if he had never been born.
translations.ylt: the Son of Man doth indeed go, as it hath been written concerning him, but woe to that man through whom the Son of Man is delivered up; good were it to him if that man had not been born.'
translations.web: For the Son of Man goes as it is written about him, but woe to that man by whom the Son of Man is betrayed! It would be better for that man if he had not been born.”

translations.kjv: And as they did eat, Jesus took bread, and blessed, and brake it, and gave to them, and said, Take, eat: this is my body.
translations.ylt: And as they are eating, Jesus having taken bread, having blessed, brake, and gave to them, and said, `Take, eat; this is my body.'
translations.web: As they were eating, Jesus took bread, and when he had blessed it, he broke it and gave to them, and said, “Take, eat. This is my body.”

translations.kjv: And he took the cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave it to them: and they all drank of it.
translations.ylt: And having taken the cup, having given thanks, he gave to them, and they drank of it--all;
translations.web: He took the cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave to them. They all drank of it.

translations.kjv: And he said unto them, This is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many.
translations.ylt: and he said to them, `This is my blood of the new covenant, which for many is being poured out;
translations.web: He said to them, “This is my blood of the new covenant, which is poured out for many.

translations.kjv: Verily I say unto you, I will drink no more of the fruit of the vine, until that day that I drink it new in the kingdom of God.
translations.ylt: verily I say to you, that no more may I drink of the produce of the vine till that day when I may drink it new in the reign of God.'
translations.web: Most certainly I tell you, I will no more drink of the fruit of the vine until that day when I drink it anew in God’s Kingdom.”

translations.kjv: And when they had sung an hymn, they went out into the mount of Olives.
translations.ylt: And having sung an hymn, they went forth to the mount of the Olives,
translations.web: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.

translations.kjv: And Jesus saith unto them, All ye shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered.
translations.ylt: and Jesus saith to them--`All ye shall be stumbled at me this night, because it hath been written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered abroad,
translations.web: Jesus said to them, “All of you will be made to stumble because of me tonight, for it is written, ‘I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered.’

translations.kjv: But after that I am risen, I will go before you into Galilee.
translations.ylt: but after my having risen I will go before you to Galilee.'
translations.web: However, after I am raised up, I will go before you into Galilee.”

translations.kjv: But Peter said unto him, Although all shall be offended, yet will not I.
translations.ylt: And Peter said to him, `And if all shall be stumbled, yet not I;'
translations.web: But Peter said to him, “Although all will be offended, yet I will not.”

translations.kjv: And Jesus saith unto him, Verily I say unto thee, That this day, even in this night, before the cock crow twice, thou shalt deny me thrice.
translations.ylt: And Jesus said to him, `Verily I say to thee, that to-day, this night, before a cock shall crow twice, thrice thou shalt deny me.'
translations.web: Jesus said to him, “Most certainly I tell you that you today, even this night, before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times.”

translations.kjv: But he spake the more vehemently, If I should die with thee, I will not deny thee in any wise. Likewise also said they all.
translations.ylt: And he spake the more vehemently, `If it may be necessary for me to die with thee--I will in no wise deny thee;' and in like manner also said they all.
translations.web: But he spoke all the more, “If I must die with you, I will not deny you.” They all said the same thing.

translations.kjv: And they came to a place which was named Gethsemane: and he saith to his disciples, Sit ye here, while I shall pray.
translations.ylt: And they come to a spot, the name of which is Gethsemane, and he saith to his disciples, `Sit ye here till I may pray;'
translations.web: They came to a place which was named Gethsemane. He said to his disciples, “Sit here while I pray.”

translations.kjv: And he taketh with him Peter and James and John, and began to be sore amazed, and to be very heavy;
translations.ylt: and he taketh Peter, and James, and John with him, and began to be amazed, and to be very heavy,
translations.web: He took with him Peter, James, and John, and began to be greatly troubled and distressed.

translations.kjv: And saith unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful unto death: tarry ye here, and watch.
translations.ylt: and he saith to them, `Exceeding sorrowful is my soul--to death; remain here, and watch.'
translations.web: He said to them, “My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Stay here and watch.”

translations.kjv: And he went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that, if it were possible, the hour might pass from him.
translations.ylt: And having gone forward a little, he fell upon the earth, and was praying, that, if it be possible the hour may pass from him,
translations.web: He went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that if it were possible, the hour might pass away from him.

translations.kjv: And he said, Abba, Father, all things are possible unto thee; take away this cup from me: nevertheless not what I will, but what thou wilt.
translations.ylt: and he said, `Abba, Father; all things are possible to Thee; make this cup pass from me; but, not what I will, but what Thou.'
translations.web: He said, “Abba, Father, all things are possible to you. Please remove this cup from me. However, not what I desire, but what you desire.”

translations.kjv: And he cometh, and findeth them sleeping, and saith unto Peter, Simon, sleepest thou? couldest not thou watch one hour?
translations.ylt: And he cometh, and findeth them sleeping, and saith to Peter, `Simon, thou dost sleep! thou wast not able to watch one hour!
translations.web: He came and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, “Simon, are you sleeping? Couldn’t you watch one hour?

translations.kjv: Watch ye and pray, lest ye enter into temptation. The spirit truly is ready, but the flesh is weak.
translations.ylt: Watch ye and pray, that ye may not enter into temptation; the spirit indeed is forward, but the flesh weak.'
translations.web: Watch and pray, that you may not enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.”

translations.kjv: And again he went away, and prayed, and spake the same words.
translations.ylt: And again having gone away, he prayed, the same word saying;
translations.web: Again he went away and prayed, saying the same words.

translations.kjv: And when he returned, he found them asleep again, (for their eyes were heavy,) neither wist they what to answer him.
translations.ylt: and having returned, he found them again sleeping, for their eyes were heavy, and they had not known what they might answer him.
translations.web: Again he returned and found them sleeping, for their eyes were very heavy; and they didn’t know what to answer him.

translations.kjv: And he cometh the third time, and saith unto them, Sleep on now, and take your rest: it is enough, the hour is come; behold, the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
translations.ylt: And he cometh the third time, and saith to them, `Sleep on henceforth, and rest--it is over; the hour did come; lo, the Son of Man is delivered up to the hands of the sinful;
translations.web: He came the third time and said to them, “Sleep on now, and take your rest. It is enough. The hour has come. Behold, the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

translations.kjv: Rise up, let us go; lo, he that betrayeth me is at hand.
translations.ylt: rise, we may go, lo, he who is delivering me up hath come nigh.'
translations.web: Arise! Let’s get going. Behold, he who betrays me is at hand.”

translations.kjv: And immediately, while he yet spake, cometh Judas, one of the twelve, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and the scribes and the elders.
translations.ylt: And immediately--while he is yet speaking--cometh near Judas, one of the twelve, and with him a great multitude, with swords and sticks, from the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders;
translations.web: Immediately, while he was still speaking, Judas, one of the twelve, came—and with him a multitude with swords and clubs, from the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders.

translations.kjv: And he that betrayed him had given them a token, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that same is he; take him, and lead him away safely.
translations.ylt: and he who is delivering him up had given a token to them, saying, `Whomsoever I shall kiss, he it is, lay hold on him, and lead him away safely,'
translations.web: Now he who betrayed him had given them a sign, saying, “Whomever I will kiss, that is he. Seize him, and lead him away safely.”

translations.kjv: And as soon as he was come, he goeth straightway to him, and saith, Master, master; and kissed him.
translations.ylt: and having come, immediately, having gone near him, he saith, `Rabbi, Rabbi,' and kissed him.
translations.web: When he had come, immediately he came to him and said, “Rabbi! Rabbi!” and kissed him.

translations.kjv: And they laid their hands on him, and took him.
translations.ylt: And they laid on him their hands, and kept hold on him;
translations.web: They laid their hands on him and seized him.

translations.kjv: And one of them that stood by drew a sword, and smote a servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.
translations.ylt: and a certain one of those standing by, having drawn the sword, struck the servant of the chief priest, and took off his ear.
translations.web: But a certain one of those who stood by drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.

translations.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Are ye come out, as against a thief, with swords and with staves to take me?
translations.ylt: And Jesus answering said to them, `As against a robber ye came out, with swords and sticks, to take me!
translations.web: Jesus answered them, “Have you come out, as against a robber, with swords and clubs to seize me?

translations.kjv: I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and ye took me not: but the scriptures must be fulfilled.
translations.ylt: daily I was with you in the temple teaching, and ye did not lay hold on me--but that the Writings may be fulfilled.'
translations.web: I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and you didn’t arrest me. But this is so that the Scriptures might be fulfilled.”

translations.kjv: And they all forsook him, and fled.
translations.ylt: And having left him they all fled;
translations.web: They all left him, and fled.

translations.kjv: And there followed him a certain young man, having a linen cloth cast about his naked body; and the young men laid hold on him:
translations.ylt: and a certain young man was following him, having put a linen cloth about his naked body, and the young men lay hold on him,
translations.web: A certain young man followed him, having a linen cloth thrown around himself over his naked body. The young men grabbed him,

translations.kjv: And he left the linen cloth, and fled from them naked.
translations.ylt: and he, having left the linen cloth, did flee from them naked.
translations.web: but he left the linen cloth and fled from them naked.

translations.kjv: And they led Jesus away to the high priest: and with him were assembled all the chief priests and the elders and the scribes.
translations.ylt: And they led away Jesus unto the chief priest, and come together to him do all the chief priests, and the elders, and the scribes;
translations.web: They led Jesus away to the high priest. All the chief priests, the elders, and the scribes came together with him.

translations.kjv: And Peter followed him afar off, even into the palace of the high priest: and he sat with the servants, and warmed himself at the fire.
translations.ylt: and Peter afar off did follow him, to the inside of the hall of the chief priest, and he was sitting with the officers, and warming himself near the fire.
translations.web: Peter had followed him from a distance, until he came into the court of the high priest. He was sitting with the officers, and warming himself in the light of the fire.

translations.kjv: And the chief priests and all the council sought for witness against Jesus to put him to death; and found none.
translations.ylt: And the chief priests and all the sanhedrim were seeking against Jesus testimony--to put him to death, and they were not finding,
translations.web: Now the chief priests and the whole council sought witnesses against Jesus to put him to death, and found none.
