translations.kjv: For many bare false witness against him, but their witness agreed not together.
translations.ylt: for many were bearing false testimony against him, and their testimonies were not alike.
translations.web: For many gave false testimony against him, and their testimony didn’t agree with each other.

translations.kjv: And there arose certain, and bare false witness against him, saying,
translations.ylt: And certain having risen up, were bearing false testimony against him, saying--
translations.web: Some stood up and gave false testimony against him, saying,

translations.kjv: We heard him say, I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and within three days I will build another made without hands.
translations.ylt: `We heard him saying--I will throw down this sanctuary made with hands, and by three days, another made without hands I will build;'
translations.web: “We heard him say, ‘I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and in three days I will build another made without hands.’”

translations.kjv: But neither so did their witness agree together.
translations.ylt: and neither so was their testimony alike.
translations.web: Even so, their testimony didn’t agree.

translations.kjv: And the high priest stood up in the midst, and asked Jesus, saying, Answerest thou nothing? what is it which these witness against thee?
translations.ylt: And the chief priest, having risen up in the midst, questioned Jesus, saying, `Thou dost not answer anything! what do these testify against thee?'
translations.web: The high priest stood up in the middle, and asked Jesus, “Have you no answer? What is it which these testify against you?”

translations.kjv: But he held his peace, and answered nothing. Again the high priest asked him, and said unto him, Art thou the Christ, the Son of the Blessed?
translations.ylt: and he was keeping silent, and did not answer anything. Again the chief priest was questioning him, and saith to him, `Art thou the Christ--the Son of the Blessed?'
translations.web: But he stayed quiet, and answered nothing. Again the high priest asked him, “Are you the Christ, the Son of the Blessed?”

translations.kjv: And Jesus said, I am: and ye shall see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.
translations.ylt: and Jesus said, `I am; and ye shall see the Son of Man sitting on the right hand of the power, and coming with the clouds, of the heaven.'
translations.web: Jesus said, “I am. You will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power, and coming with the clouds of the sky.”

translations.kjv: Then the high priest rent his clothes, and saith, What need we any further witnesses?
translations.ylt: And the chief priest, having rent his garments, saith, `What need have we yet of witnesses?
translations.web: The high priest tore his clothes and said, “What further need have we of witnesses?

translations.kjv: Ye have heard the blasphemy: what think ye? And they all condemned him to be guilty of death.
translations.ylt: Ye heard the evil speaking, what appeareth to you?' and they all condemned him to be worthy of death,
translations.web: You have heard the blasphemy! What do you think?” They all condemned him to be worthy of death.

translations.kjv: And some began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to buffet him, and to say unto him, Prophesy: and the servants did strike him with the palms of their hands.
translations.ylt: and certain began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to buffet him, and to say to him, `Prophesy;' and the officers were striking him with their palms.
translations.web: Some began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to beat him with fists, and to tell him, “Prophesy!” The officers struck him with the palms of their hands.

translations.kjv: And as Peter was beneath in the palace, there cometh one of the maids of the high priest:
translations.ylt: And Peter being in the hall beneath, there doth come one of the maids of the chief priest,
translations.web: As Peter was in the courtyard below, one of the maids of the high priest came,

translations.kjv: And when she saw Peter warming himself, she looked upon him, and said, And thou also wast with Jesus of Nazareth.
translations.ylt: and having seen Peter warming himself, having looked on him, she said, `And thou wast with Jesus of Nazareth!'
translations.web: and seeing Peter warming himself, she looked at him and said, “You were also with the Nazarene, Jesus!”

translations.kjv: But he denied, saying, I know not, neither understand I what thou sayest. And he went out into the porch; and the cock crew.
translations.ylt: and he denied, saying, `I have not known him, neither do I understand what thou sayest;' and he went forth without to the porch, and a cock crew.
translations.web: But he denied it, saying, “I neither know nor understand what you are saying.” He went out on the porch, and the rooster crowed.

translations.kjv: And a maid saw him again, and began to say to them that stood by, This is one of them.
translations.ylt: And the maid having seen him again, began to say to those standing near--`This is of them;'
translations.web: The maid saw him and began again to tell those who stood by, “This is one of them.”

translations.kjv: And he denied it again. And a little after, they that stood by said again to Peter, Surely thou art one of them: for thou art a Galilean, and thy speech agreeth thereto.
translations.ylt: and he was again denying. And after a little again, those standing near said to Peter, `Truly thou art of them, for thou also art a Galilean, and thy speech is alike;'
translations.web: But he again denied it. After a little while again those who stood by said to Peter, “You truly are one of them, for you are a Galilean, and your speech shows it.”

translations.kjv: But he began to curse and to swear, saying, I know not this man of whom ye speak.
translations.ylt: and he began to anathematize, and to swear--`I have not known this man of whom ye speak;'
translations.web: But he began to curse and to swear, “I don’t know this man of whom you speak!”

translations.kjv: And the second time the cock crew. And Peter called to mind the word that Jesus said unto him, Before the cock crow twice, thou shalt deny me thrice. And when he thought thereon, he wept.
translations.ylt: and a second time a cock crew, and Peter remembered the saying that Jesus said to him--`Before a cock crow twice, thou mayest deny me thrice;' and having thought thereon--he was weeping.
translations.web: The rooster crowed the second time. Peter remembered the words that Jesus said to him, “Before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times.” When he thought about that, he wept.

translations.kjv: And straightway in the morning the chief priests held a consultation with the elders and scribes and the whole council, and bound Jesus, and carried him away, and delivered him to Pilate.
translations.ylt: And immediately, in the morning, the chief priests having made a consultation, with the elders, and scribes, and the whole sanhedrim, having bound Jesus, did lead away, and delivered him to Pilate;
translations.web: Immediately in the morning the chief priests, with the elders, scribes, and the whole council, held a consultation, bound Jesus, carried him away, and delivered him up to Pilate.

translations.kjv: And Pilate asked him, Art thou the King of the Jews? And he answering said unto him, Thou sayest it.
translations.ylt: and Pilate questioned him, `Art thou the king of the Jews?' and he answering said to him, `Thou dost say it.'
translations.web: Pilate asked him, “Are you the King of the Jews?” He answered, “So you say.”

translations.kjv: And the chief priests accused him of many things: but he answered nothing.
translations.ylt: And the chief priests were accusing him of many things, but he answered nothing.
translations.web: The chief priests accused him of many things.

translations.kjv: And Pilate asked him again, saying, Answerest thou nothing? behold how many things they witness against thee.
translations.ylt: And Pilate again questioned him, saying, `Thou dost not answer anything! lo, how many things they do testify against thee!'
translations.web: Pilate again asked him, “Have you no answer? See how many things they testify against you!”

translations.kjv: But Jesus yet answered nothing; so that Pilate marvelled.
translations.ylt: and Jesus did no more answer anything, so that Pilate wondered.
translations.web: But Jesus made no further answer, so that Pilate marveled.

translations.kjv: Now at that feast he released unto them one prisoner, whomsoever they desired.
translations.ylt: And at every feast he was releasing to them one prisoner, whomsoever they were asking;
translations.web: Now at the feast he used to release to them one prisoner, whomever they asked of him.

translations.kjv: And there was one named Barabbas, which lay bound with them that had made insurrection with him, who had committed murder in the insurrection.
translations.ylt: and there was one named Barabbas, bound with those making insurrection with him, who had in the insurrection committed murder.
translations.web: There was one called Barabbas, bound with his fellow insurgents, men who in the insurrection had committed murder.

translations.kjv: And the multitude crying aloud began to desire him to do as he had ever done unto them.
translations.ylt: And the multitude having cried out, began to ask for themselves as he was always doing to them,
translations.web: The multitude, crying aloud, began to ask him to do as he always did for them.

translations.kjv: But Pilate answered them, saying, Will ye that I release unto you the King of the Jews?
translations.ylt: and Pilate answered them, saying, `Will ye that I shall release to you the king of the Jews?'
translations.web: Pilate answered them, saying, “Do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?”

translations.kjv: For he knew that the chief priests had delivered him for envy.
translations.ylt: for he knew that because of envy the chief priests had delivered him up;
translations.web: For he perceived that for envy the chief priests had delivered him up.

translations.kjv: But the chief priests moved the people, that he should rather release Barabbas unto them.
translations.ylt: and the chief priests did move the multitude, that he might rather release Barabbas to them.
translations.web: But the chief priests stirred up the multitude, that he should release Barabbas to them instead.

translations.kjv: And Pilate answered and said again unto them, What will ye then that I shall do unto him whom ye call the King of the Jews?
translations.ylt: And Pilate answering, again said to them, `What, then, will ye that I shall do to him whom ye call king of the Jews?'
translations.web: Pilate again asked them, “What then should I do to him whom you call the King of the Jews?”

translations.kjv: And they cried out again, Crucify him.
translations.ylt: and they again cried out, `Crucify him.'
translations.web: They cried out again, “Crucify him!”

translations.kjv: Then Pilate said unto them, Why, what evil hath he done? And they cried out the more exceedingly, Crucify him.
translations.ylt: And Pilate said to them, `Why--what evil did he?' and they cried out the more vehemently, `Crucify him;'
translations.web: Pilate said to them, “Why, what evil has he done?” But they cried out exceedingly, “Crucify him!”

translations.kjv: And so Pilate, willing to content the people, released Barabbas unto them, and delivered Jesus, when he had scourged him, to be crucified.
translations.ylt: and Pilate, wishing to content the multitude, released to them Barabbas, and delivered up Jesus--having scourged him --that he might be crucified.
translations.web: Pilate, wishing to please the multitude, released Barabbas to them, and handed over Jesus, when he had flogged him, to be crucified.

translations.kjv: And the soldiers led him away into the hall, called Pretorium; and they call together the whole band.
translations.ylt: And the soldiers led him away into the hall, which is Praetorium, and call together the whole band,
translations.web: The soldiers led him away within the court, which is the Praetorium; and they called together the whole cohort.

translations.kjv: And they clothed him with purple, and platted a crown of thorns, and put it about his head,
translations.ylt: and clothe him with purple, and having plaited a crown of thorns, they put it on him,
translations.web: They clothed him with purple; and weaving a crown of thorns, they put it on him.

translations.kjv: And began to salute him, Hail, King of the Jews!
translations.ylt: and began to salute him, `Hail, King of the Jews.'
translations.web: They began to salute him, “Hail, King of the Jews!”

translations.kjv: And they smote him on the head with a reed, and did spit upon him, and bowing their knees worshipped him.
translations.ylt: And they were smiting him on the head with a reed, and were spitting on him, and having bent the knee, were bowing to him,
translations.web: They struck his head with a reed and spat on him, and bowing their knees, did homage to him.

translations.kjv: And when they had mocked him, they took off the purple from him, and put his own clothes on him, and led him out to crucify him.
translations.ylt: and when they had mocked him, they took the purple from off him, and clothed him in his own garments, and they led him forth, that they may crucify him.
translations.web: When they had mocked him, they took the purple cloak off him, and put his own garments on him. They led him out to crucify him.

translations.kjv: And they compel one Simon a Cyrenian, who passed by, coming out of the country, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to bear his cross.
translations.ylt: And they impress a certain one passing by--Simon, a Cyrenian, coming from the field, the father of Alexander and Rufus--that he may bear his cross,
translations.web: They compelled one passing by, coming from the country, Simon of Cyrene, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to go with them that he might bear his cross.

translations.kjv: And they bring him unto the place Golgotha, which is, being interpreted, The place of a skull.
translations.ylt: and they bring him to the place Golgotha, which is, being interpreted, `Place of a skull;'
translations.web: They brought him to the place called Golgotha, which is, being interpreted, “The place of a skull.”

translations.kjv: And they gave him to drink wine mingled with myrrh: but he received it not.
translations.ylt: and they were giving him to drink wine mingled with myrrh, and he did not receive.
translations.web: They offered him wine mixed with myrrh to drink, but he didn’t take it.

translations.kjv: And when they had crucified him, they parted his garments, casting lots upon them, what every man should take.
translations.ylt: And having crucified him, they were dividing his garments, casting a lot upon them, what each may take;
translations.web: Crucifying him, they parted his garments among them, casting lots on them, what each should take.

translations.kjv: And it was the third hour, and they crucified him.
translations.ylt: and it was the third hour, and they crucified him;
translations.web: It was the third hour when they crucified him.

translations.kjv: And the superscription of his accusation was written over, THE KING OF THE JEWS.
translations.ylt: and the inscription of his accusation was written above--`The King of the Jews.'
translations.web: The superscription of his accusation was written over him: “THE KING OF THE JEWS.”

translations.kjv: And with him they crucify two thieves; the one on his right hand, and the other on his left.
translations.ylt: And with him they crucify two robbers, one on the right hand, and one on his left,
translations.web: With him they crucified two robbers, one on his right hand, and one on his left.

translations.kjv: And they that passed by railed on him, wagging their heads, and saying, Ah, thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest it in three days,
translations.ylt: And those passing by were speaking evil of him, shaking their heads, and saying, `Ah, the thrower down of the sanctuary, and in three days the builder!
translations.web: Those who passed by blasphemed him, wagging their heads and saying, “Ha! You who destroy the temple and build it in three days,

translations.kjv: Save thyself, and come down from the cross.
translations.ylt: save thyself, and come down from the cross!'
translations.web: save yourself, and come down from the cross!”

translations.kjv: Likewise also the chief priests mocking said among themselves with the scribes, He saved others; himself he cannot save.
translations.ylt: And in like manner also the chief priests, mocking with one another, with the scribes, said, `Others he saved; himself he is not able to save.
translations.web: Likewise, also the chief priests mocking among themselves with the scribes said, “He saved others. He can’t save himself.

translations.kjv: Let Christ the King of Israel descend now from the cross, that we may see and believe. And they that were crucified with him reviled him.
translations.ylt: The Christ! the king of Israel--let him come down now from the cross, that we may see and believe;' and those crucified with him were reproaching him.
translations.web: Let the Christ, the King of Israel, now come down from the cross, that we may see and believe him.” Those who were crucified with him also insulted him.

translations.kjv: And when the sixth hour was come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.
translations.ylt: And the sixth hour having come, darkness came over the whole land till the ninth hour,
translations.web: When the sixth hour had come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.

translations.kjv: And at the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani? which is, being interpreted, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?
translations.ylt: and at the ninth hour Jesus cried with a great voice, saying, `Eloi, Eloi, lamma sabachthani?' which is, being interpreted, `My God, my God, why didst Thou forsake me?'
translations.web: At the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani?” which is, being interpreted, “My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?”

translations.kjv: And some of them that stood by, when they heard it, said, Behold, he calleth Elias.
translations.ylt: And certain of those standing by, having heard, said, `Lo, Elijah he doth call;'
translations.web: Some of those who stood by, when they heard it, said, “Behold, he is calling Elijah.”

translations.kjv: And one ran and filled a spunge full of vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him to drink, saying, Let alone; let us see whether Elias will come to take him down.
translations.ylt: and one having run, and having filled a spunge with vinegar, having put it also on a reed, was giving him to drink, saying, `Let alone, let us see if Elijah doth come to take him down.'
translations.web: One ran, and filling a sponge full of vinegar, put it on a reed and gave it to him to drink, saying, “Let him be. Let’s see whether Elijah comes to take him down.”

translations.kjv: And Jesus cried with a loud voice, and gave up the ghost.
translations.ylt: And Jesus having uttered a loud cry, yielded the spirit,
translations.web: Jesus cried out with a loud voice, and gave up the spirit.

translations.kjv: And the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom.
translations.ylt: and the veil of the sanctuary was rent in two, from top to bottom,
translations.web: The veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom.

translations.kjv: And when the centurion, which stood over against him, saw that he so cried out, and gave up the ghost, he said, Truly this man was the Son of God.
translations.ylt: and the centurion who was standing over-against him, having seen that, having so cried out, he yielded the spirit, said, `Truly this man was Son of God.'
translations.web: When the centurion, who stood by opposite him, saw that he cried out like this and breathed his last, he said, “Truly this man was the Son of God!”

translations.kjv: There were also women looking on afar off: among whom was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses, and Salome;
translations.ylt: And there were also women afar off beholding, among whom was also Mary the Magdalene, and Mary of James the less, and of Joses, and Salome,
translations.web: There were also women watching from afar, among whom were both Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses, and Salome;

translations.kjv: (Who also, when he was in Galilee, followed him, and ministered unto him;) and many other women which came up with him unto Jerusalem.
translations.ylt: (who also, when he was in Galilee, were following him, and were ministering to him,) and many other women who came up with him to Jerusalem.
translations.web: who, when he was in Galilee, followed him and served him; and many other women who came up with him to Jerusalem.

translations.kjv: And now when the even was come, because it was the preparation, that is, the day before the sabbath,
translations.ylt: And now evening having come, seeing it was the preparation, that is, the fore-sabbath,
translations.web: When evening had now come, because it was the Preparation Day, that is, the day before the Sabbath,

translations.kjv: Joseph of Arimathea, an honourable counsellor, which also waited for the kingdom of God, came, and went in boldly unto Pilate, and craved the body of Jesus.
translations.ylt: Joseph of Arimathea, an honourable counsellor, who also himself was waiting for the reign of God, came, boldly entered in unto Pilate, and asked the body of Jesus.
translations.web: Joseph of Arimathaea, a prominent council member who also himself was looking for God’s Kingdom, came. He boldly went in to Pilate, and asked for Jesus’ body.

translations.kjv: And Pilate marvelled if he were already dead: and calling unto him the centurion, he asked him whether he had been any while dead.
translations.ylt: And Pilate wondered if he were already dead, and having called near the centurion, did question him if he were long dead,
translations.web: Pilate was surprised to hear that he was already dead; and summoning the centurion, he asked him whether he had been dead long.

translations.kjv: And when he knew it of the centurion, he gave the body to Joseph.
translations.ylt: and having known it from the centurion, he granted the body to Joseph.
translations.web: When he found out from the centurion, he granted the body to Joseph.

translations.kjv: And he bought fine linen, and took him down, and wrapped him in the linen, and laid him in a sepulchre which was hewn out of a rock, and rolled a stone unto the door of the sepulchre.
translations.ylt: And he, having brought fine linen, and having taken him down, wrapped him in the linen, and laid him in a sepulchre that had been hewn out of a rock, and he rolled a stone unto the door of the sepulchre,
translations.web: He bought a linen cloth, and taking him down, wound him in the linen cloth and laid him in a tomb which had been cut out of a rock. He rolled a stone against the door of the tomb.

translations.kjv: And Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses beheld where he was laid.
translations.ylt: and Mary the Magdalene, and Mary of Joses, were beholding where he is laid.
translations.web: Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses, saw where he was laid.

translations.kjv: And when the sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome, had bought sweet spices, that they might come and anoint him.
translations.ylt: And the sabbath having past, Mary the Magdalene, and Mary of James, and Salome, bought spices, that having come, they may anoint him,
translations.web: When the Sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome bought spices, that they might come and anoint him.

translations.kjv: And very early in the morning the first day of the week, they came unto the sepulchre at the rising of the sun.
translations.ylt: and early in the morning of the first of the sabbaths, they come unto the sepulchre, at the rising of the sun,
translations.web: Very early on the first day of the week, they came to the tomb when the sun had risen.

translations.kjv: And they said among themselves, Who shall roll us away the stone from the door of the sepulchre?
translations.ylt: and they said among themselves, `Who shall roll away for us the stone out of the door of the sepulchre?'
translations.web: They were saying among themselves, “Who will roll away the stone from the door of the tomb for us?”

translations.kjv: And when they looked, they saw that the stone was rolled away: for it was very great.
translations.ylt: And having looked, they see that the stone hath been rolled away--for it was very great,
translations.web: for it was very big. Looking up, they saw that the stone was rolled back.

translations.kjv: And entering into the sepulchre, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, clothed in a long white garment; and they were affrighted.
translations.ylt: and having entered into the sepulchre, they saw a young man sitting on the right hand, arrayed in a long white robe, and they were amazed.
translations.web: Entering into the tomb, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, dressed in a white robe; and they were amazed.

translations.kjv: And he saith unto them, Be not affrighted: Ye seek Jesus of Nazareth, which was crucified: he is risen; he is not here: behold the place where they laid him.
translations.ylt: And he saith to them, `Be not amazed, ye seek Jesus the Nazarene, the crucified: he did rise--he is not here; lo, the place where they laid him!
translations.web: He said to them, “Don’t be amazed. You seek Jesus, the Nazarene, who has been crucified. He has risen! He is not here. See the place where they laid him!

translations.kjv: But go your way, tell his disciples and Peter that he goeth before you into Galilee: there shall ye see him, as he said unto you.
translations.ylt: and go, say to his disciples, and Peter, that he doth go before you to Galilee; there ye shall see him, as he said to you.'
translations.web: But go, tell his disciples and Peter, ‘He goes before you into Galilee. There you will see him, as he said to you.’”

translations.kjv: And they went out quickly, and fled from the sepulchre; for they trembled and were amazed: neither said they any thing to any man; for they were afraid.
translations.ylt: And, having come forth quickly, they fled from the sepulchre, and trembling and amazement had seized them, and to no one said they anything, for they were afraid.
translations.web: They went out, and fled from the tomb, for trembling and astonishment had come on them. They said nothing to anyone; for they were afraid.

translations.kjv: Now when Jesus was risen early the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, out of whom he had cast seven devils.
translations.ylt: And he, having risen in the morning of the first of the sabbaths, did appear first to Mary the Magdalene, out of whom he had cast seven demons;
translations.web: Now when he had risen early on the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, from whom he had cast out seven demons.

translations.kjv: And she went and told them that had been with him, as they mourned and wept.
translations.ylt: she having gone, told those who had been with him, mourning and weeping;
translations.web: She went and told those who had been with him, as they mourned and wept.

translations.kjv: And they, when they had heard that he was alive, and had been seen of her, believed not.
translations.ylt: and they, having heard that he is alive, and was seen by her, did not believe.
translations.web: When they heard that he was alive and had been seen by her, they disbelieved.

translations.kjv: After that he appeared in another form unto two of them, as they walked, and went into the country.
translations.ylt: And after these things, to two of them, as they are going into a field, walking, he was manifested in another form,
translations.web: After these things he was revealed in another form to two of them as they walked, on their way into the country.

translations.kjv: And they went and told it unto the residue: neither believed they them.
translations.ylt: and they having gone, told to the rest; not even them did they believe.
translations.web: They went away and told it to the rest. They didn’t believe them, either.

translations.kjv: Afterward he appeared unto the eleven as they sat at meat, and upbraided them with their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they believed not them which had seen him after he was risen.
translations.ylt: Afterwards, as they are reclining (at meat), he was manifested to the eleven, and did reproach their unbelief and stiffness of heart, because they believed not those having seen him being raised;
translations.web: Afterward he was revealed to the eleven themselves as they sat at the table; and he rebuked them for their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they didn’t believe those who had seen him after he had risen.

translations.kjv: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
translations.ylt: and he said to them, `Having gone to all the world, proclaim the good news to all the creation;
translations.web: He said to them, “Go into all the world and preach the Good News to the whole creation.

translations.kjv: He that believeth and is baptized shall be saved; but he that believeth not shall be damned.
translations.ylt: he who hath believed, and hath been baptized, shall be saved; and he who hath not believed, shall be condemned.
translations.web: He who believes and is baptized will be saved; but he who disbelieves will be condemned.

translations.kjv: And these signs shall follow them that believe; In my name shall they cast out devils; they shall speak with new tongues;
translations.ylt: `And signs shall accompany those believing these things; in my name demons they shall cast out; with new tongues they shall speak;
translations.web: These signs will accompany those who believe: in my name they will cast out demons; they will speak with new languages;

translations.kjv: They shall take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing, it shall not hurt them; they shall lay hands on the sick, and they shall recover.
translations.ylt: serpents they shall take up; and if any deadly thing they may drink, it shall not hurt them; on the ailing they shall lay hands, and they shall be well.'
translations.web: they will take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing, it will in no way hurt them; they will lay hands on the sick, and they will recover.”

translations.kjv: So then after the Lord had spoken unto them, he was received up into heaven, and sat on the right hand of God.
translations.ylt: The Lord, then, indeed, after speaking to them, was received up to the heaven, and sat on the right hand of God;
translations.web: So then the Lord, after he had spoken to them, was received up into heaven and sat down at the right hand of God.

translations.kjv: And they went forth, and preached every where, the Lord working with them, and confirming the word with signs following. Amen.
translations.ylt: and they, having gone forth, did preach everywhere, the Lord working with them, and confirming the word, through the signs following. Amen.
translations.web: They went out and preached everywhere, the Lord working with them and confirming the word by the signs that followed. Amen.
